jobs.title: KI-Dozent:in in Teilzeit (20h) (m/w/d) | 100% remote
jobs.excerpt: Viele Menschen fragen sich aktuell: "Welche Aufgaben übernehme ich morgen noch - und was brauche ich, um in Zukunft relevant zu bleiben?
jobs.description:
Viele Menschen fragen sich aktuell: "Welche Aufgaben übernehme ich morgen noch - und was brauche ich, um in Zukunft relevant zu bleiben?"

Das Institut für Zukunftsbildung (IZB) hat eine klare Antwort: Wir qualifizieren Menschen so, dass sie nicht von KI-Entwicklungen überrollt werden, sondern die Zukunft aktiv gestalten. Mit unserem zertifizierten Programm „KI Leader“ schaffen wir Orientierung, vermitteln praxisnahe Kompetenzen und eröffnen neue Perspektiven für die Arbeitswelt von morgen. Unser Leitsatz: Wenn Maschinen lernen, müssen Menschen wachsen.

Für einen festen Kurs suchen wir eine KI-Dozent:in in Teilzeit (20 Stunden/Woche, 100 % remote) – im Tandem mit einer Hauptdozentin oder einem Hauptdozenten.

Das gibt es konkret

  • 20 Stunden pro Woche, komplett remote
  • Start so schnell wie möglich – wir richten uns nach deiner Verfügbarkeit
  • Du läufst im Tandem mit einem Hauptdozenten in einem festen Kurs
  • Dein Schwerpunkt sind die Tutorien, inklusive 1:1-Zeit mit einzelnen Teilnehmenden
  • Dazu kommt das Einspringen, wenn in einem der Kurse jemand krank wird oder Urlaub hat

Warum Tandem und nicht allein?

Weil die meisten Weiterbildungen nicht am Stoff scheitern. Sie scheitern daran, dass niemand merkt, wenn jemand bei Modul 3 abgehängt wird und sich drei Wochen lang nicht traut, das zu sagen. Feste Tandems sind bei uns dafür da, dass die Teilnehmenden sich aufgehoben fühlen und über die vier Monate immer dieselben zwei Menschen vor sich haben – denen sie dann auch menschlich vertrauen.

Und: Ein Tandem soll ergänzen, nicht verdoppeln. Unser Hauptdozent wünscht sich ausdrücklich jemanden, der Change Management und Business Consulting tiefer mitdenkt als er selbst – also die Person, die in der 1:1-Zeit nicht nur die Prompt-Frage beantwortet, sondern mit der Teilnehmerin durchdenkt, wie der Rollout im eigenen Unternehmen an den Menschen scheitern könnte und was das für ihren KI-Fahrplan heißt.

So sieht die Woche im Kurs in der Regel aus

  • Mo Tutorium 09:30–17:00
  • Di Workshop 09:30–15:30
  • Mi Tutorium 13:15–17:15
  • Do Tutorium 09:30–12:45
  • Fr Feedback-Runde 09:00–10:30

Wer davon was übernimmt, sprichst du direkt mit dem Hauptdozenten ab. Wir geben da nichts vor. Uns ist nur wichtig, dass bei Ausfällen Flexibilität von deiner Seite möglich ist, damit der Lehrbetrieb normal weiterlaufen kann.

Aufgaben

  • Tutorien durchführen: Du begleitest die Teilnehmenden durch Übungs- und Vertiefungszeiten – nah dran, praxisnah, mit Raum für Fragen
  • Workflows mitbauen: Du sitzt mit den Teilnehmenden konkret an ihren eigenen Use Cases und hilfst beim Bauen – Automatisierungen, GPTs/Agents, Prompt-Ketten, Anbindungen an bestehende Tools. Nicht nur erklären, sondern mitbauen
  • 1:1-Begleitung: Du merkst früh, wenn jemand hängt, und gehst aktiv auf die Person zu, statt zu warten, bis sie sich meldet
  • Change- und Beratungsperspektive einbringen: Du hilfst den Teilnehmenden, ihre KI-Vorhaben organisational zu denken – Stakeholder, Widerstände, Prozesse, Business Case
  • Vermittlung der Lerninhalte: Inhalte, Ablaufplan und didaktische Konzepte sind von uns entwickelt und werden von dir umgesetzt
  • Vertretung & Einspringen: Bei Krankheit oder Urlaub übernimmst du kurzfristig Einheiten in anderen Kursen
  • Abstimmung im Tandem: Rollenverteilung, Übergaben und Teilnehmenden-Themen klärst du direkt mit deinem Tandempartner
  • Organisatorische Verlässlichkeit: Dokumentation, Lernzielkontrollen, Anwesenheitslisten

Qualifikation

  • Begeisterung für Menschen & Wissensvermittlung: Du hast Spaß an der Arbeit mit Erwachsenen und schaffst eine motivierende Lernatmosphäre – idealerweise mit Erfahrung in virtuellen Gruppen
  • Praxiserprobte KI-Kompetenz mit Bau-Erfahrung: Du hast selbst schon KI-Workflows gebaut – mit Sprachmodellen, Automatisierungs-Tools (z. B. n8n, Make, Zapier), APIs oder Custom GPTs/Agents. Du kannst dich neben eine Teilnehmerin setzen und ihren Workflow gemeinsam zum Laufen bringen
  • Change Management & Business Consulting: Erfahrung aus Beratung, Transformations- oder Organisationsprojekten ist ausdrücklich erwünscht – das ist die Ergänzung, die sich unser Hauptdozent im Tandem wünscht
  • Gespür für Lernende: Du erkennst, wenn jemand still abhängt, und sprichst es an – Nähe zur Gruppe ist bei uns kein Nice-to-have, sondern der Kern der Rolle
  • Ganzheitliche KI-Transformation: Bei uns lernen Menschen, mehrdimensionale KI-Fahrpläne für ihre Organisation zu entwickeln – dein Herz schlägt für Partizipation und durchdachte Change-Prozesse
  • Flexibilität: Du kannst bei Ausfällen kurzfristig einspringen und dich auf wechselnde Kurse einstellen
  • Verlässliche Persönlichkeit: Strukturiert, verantwortungsbewusst und kommunikationsstark
  • Standort: Wohnsitz in Deutschland

Du erfüllst noch nicht alle Punkte? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Uns interessiert nicht nur der Blick in deine Vergangenheit – sondern wohin du willst. Überzeug uns mit deiner Haltung, deiner KI-Neugier und deiner Lust, Menschen wirksam durch den Wandel zu begleiten.

Benefits

  • Sinnstiftende Mission: Du wirkst bei einem Bildungsträger mit klarer Vision mit – wir befähigen Menschen, KI-Transformation in ihren Organisationen zu gestalten
  • 100 % Remote & Teilzeit: 20 Stunden pro Woche, von wo du willst – mit Vertrauen und Eigenverantwortung
  • Echtes Tandem statt Einzelkämpfertum: Du stehst nie allein vor der Gruppe und hast eine feste Person an deiner Seite
  • Lernen von den Besten: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenem Gründer und Programmleitung, dazu unser Expert:innen-Netzwerk aus Recht, Technik und Organisationsentwicklung
  • Echte Entwicklungsperspektive: Eigene Schwerpunkte ausbauen ist ausdrücklich erwünscht #growthmindset
  • Werteorientiertes Umfeld: Zukunftsorientierung, Menschlichkeit und Neugier gehen bei uns Hand in Hand

Vielfalt im Team

Wir legen großen Wert auf ein diverses Team – unterschiedliche Perspektiven vor der Gruppe machen unsere Kurse spürbar besser. Frauen sind in unserem Dozent:innen-Team aktuell unterrepräsentiert; über Bewerbungen von Frauen freuen wir uns daher besonders. Ausgeschrieben ist die Stelle selbstverständlich für alle Geschlechter (m/w/d) – entschieden wird nach Eignung.

Wenn du Freude daran hast, Menschen durch den Wandel der Arbeitswelt zu begleiten und KI greifbar zu machen – dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Bitte sende uns:

  • Deinen Lebenslauf
  • Ein kurzes Motivationsschreiben (max. 1 Seite) – warum passt du zu uns? Kurzvideos sind ein Plus
  • Optional: Dein Persönlichkeitsprofil von 16Personalities – hilft uns, dich besser kennenzulernen.

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here:

We are seeking a customer-focused, detail-oriented Account Support Specialist to join our Account Support team. This role serves as a key point of contact for customers with non-technical account and operational needs, including billing inquiries, contract and plan questions, account updates, training coordination, administrative requests, and other account-related support.

The Account Support Specialist is responsible for owning customer requests from initial contact through resolution, providing timely, accurate, and empathetic support across multiple channels. This individual will work closely with Customer Success, Onboarding & Implementation, Technical Support, Finance, Sales, and Operations to resolve customer needs, coordinate cross-functional requests, and reduce friction throughout the customer journey.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving problems, navigating operational processes, working across teams, and creating positive customer experiences in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities:

Customer & Account Support

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for non-technical customer inquiries across email, ticketing systems, phone, chat, and other support channels.
  • Assist customers with billing questions, account updates, contract and plan inquiries, training coordination, and administrative requests.
  • Own assigned customer cases from intake through resolution, ensuring timely follow-up and clear communication throughout the process.
  • Research customer questions and provide accurate, complete, and easy-to-understand responses.
  • Demonstrate empathy, professionalism, and sound judgment in every customer interaction.
  • Identify the appropriate path for requests requiring assistance from another team and ensure effective handoffs.
  • Help reduce repeat contacts by addressing the customer's full need whenever possible.

Case Management & Operational Excellence

  • Manage an assigned queue of customer requests while meeting established service-level agreements (SLAs), response time expectations, and productivity goals.
  • Accurately document customer interactions, actions taken, and resolutions within CRM and support systems.
  • Follow established workflows, standard operating procedures (SOPs), escalation paths, and quality standards.
  • Prioritize requests based on urgency, customer impact, and established business processes.
  • Identify recurring customer issues, process gaps, and sources of friction and share insights with Account Support leadership.
  • Contribute to the development and improvement of internal processes, documentation, playbooks, and workflows.
  • Maintain strong attention to detail when completing account changes, billing-related requests, and other administrative activities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Customer Success, Onboarding & Implementation, Finance/Billing, Sales & Account Management, Technical Support, and Operations to resolve customer requests.
  • Coordinate customer needs that require action or information from multiple internal teams.
  • Follow established ownership and handoff processes to ensure requests reach the appropriate team without unnecessary delays or escalations.
  • Provide clear and complete context when escalating or transferring customer requests.
  • Participate in operational readiness efforts for process changes, launches, and other initiatives impacting Account Support.

Customer Experience & Quality

  • Deliver accurate, professional, and empathetic support experiences that build customer trust.
  • Consistently meet established case quality and documentation standards.
  • Take ownership of customer issues and proactively communicate status and next steps when immediate resolution is not possible.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the customer experience and reduce effort for common account-related needs.
  • Support customer adoption of available self-service resources when appropriate.
  • Incorporate coaching and quality feedback to continuously improve individual performance.

AI, Knowledge & Continuous Improvement

  • Effectively use approved AI-assisted support tools, knowledge resources, and automation to improve the speed and quality of customer support.
  • Provide feedback when knowledge content, automated workflows, or internal resources are incomplete or inaccurate.
  • Identify repetitive requests or manual processes that may be candidates for automation or process improvement.
  • Contribute to accurate, reusable knowledge by documenting new processes, common customer questions, and effective resolutions.
  • Adapt to evolving tools, processes, policies, and customer support models.

Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:

  • 2+ years of experience in Customer Support, Customer Operations, Account Services, Billing Operations, or a related customer-facing environment.
  • Experience managing customer inquiries or cases in a high-volume environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain information clearly and professionally.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently research and resolve customer questions.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple internal teams to resolve customer needs.
  • Experience working within CRM, ticketing, or customer support platforms.
  • Customer-focused with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Empathetic and professional when navigating challenging customer situations.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Analytical and solutions-oriented approach to problem solving.
  • Ability to effectively prioritize work in a high-volume environment.
  • Comfortable working with performance metrics, service-level expectations, and quality standards.
  • Collaborative and effective at working across teams and functions.
  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a rapidly evolving environment.
  • Process-oriented with a continuous improvement mindset.
  • Curious and willing to learn new tools, systems, products, and processes.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in healthcare technology, SaaS, or another highly regulated customer environment.
  • Experience supporting billing, contract, subscription, plan, or account-related customer inquiries.
  • Experience with platforms such as Salesforce (SFDC), Zendesk, Intercom, Jira, or knowledge management systems.
  • Experience using AI-assisted support platforms, automation tools, or AI-enabled workflows.
  • Familiarity with customer lifecycle operations, including onboarding, ongoing account support, and retention.

Where: Remote within the US

The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Jordan, New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States– if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.

Benefits and Perks

  • Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in-office, remote, or hybrid
  • Continued investment in your professional development
  • Day 1 access to a robust health and wellness benefits package, including an annual wellness stipend.

  • Desenvolver e implementar arquiteturas com foco na segurança, estabilidade, escalabilidade e confiabilidade;
  • Apoiar as equipes de desenvolvimento e de segurança com a definição da infraestrutura;
  • Monitorar os ambientes e prestar suporte operacional;
  • Participar do on-call rotation (plantões 18x7);
  • Manter a documentação da equipe atualizada;
  • Automatizar as atividades de infraestrutura e suporte;
  • Programar infraestrutura como serviço mantendo o código protegido, atualizado e documentado;
  • Atuar em conjunto com os desenvolvedores durante o ciclo de deploy de aplicações e em salas de crise;
  • Fornecer feedback, insights de métricas e análise de dados para as equipes de desenvolvimento;
  • Automatizar pipelines de integração contínua (CI) e entrega contínua (CD);
  • Gerar relatórios de métricas de desempenho, disponibilidade e confiabilidade dos serviços.
  • Experiência prática com nuvens públicas, como AWS e/ou GCP;
  • Experiência com contêiner engines, como Docker, containerd e/ou Podman;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de IaC e GitOps, como Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, AWS CDK, Ansible, Chef e/ou Puppet;
  • Experiência com pipelines de integração contínua (CI) e entrega contínua (CD), utilizando ferramentas como GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, CircleCI e/ou GitHub Actions;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em administração e troubleshooting de sistemas operacionais Linux e/ou Windows;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em scripting languages, principalmente Bash e PowerShell;
  • Bons conhecimentos em plataformas de observabilidade e monitoramento, como Prometheus, Grafana, Kibana, Fluentd e/ou Elastic Search;
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura de micro-serviços e sistemas distribuídos;
  • Conhecimentos em administração e troubleshooting de webservers, como NGINX, Apache e/ou IIS;
  • Conhecimentos em protocolos de rede, como TCP e HTTP;
  • Mentalidade voltada para automação e melhoria contínua (mindset de "automatizar tudo!").

Informações adicionais

Será um diferencial se você:

  • Tiver conhecimentos em gerir, monitorar e administrar serviços de orquestração de containers como GKE, AWS EKS ou AWS ECS;
  • Tiver vivência em ambientes que adotam a cultura e práticas DevOps;
  • Tiver proficiência em ao menos uma linguagem de programação como Python, Ruby ou Go;

jobs.description:
The Cross-Channel Performance Strategist is responsible for developing and executing strategies to drive the performance and effectiveness of paid marketing campaigns across Programmatic, Meta, and Google Ads. They are experts in cross-channel paid advertising and utilize their knowledge to optimize campaigns, increase conversion rates, and improve ROI (Return on Investment). The Cross-Channel Performance Strategist stays up to date with industry trends, platform algorithms, and best practices to ensure the success of campaigns across Search, Performance Max, YouTube, Meta, and Programmatic channels.

Note: This role requires working night shift hours from 6:30 PM to 3:30 AM.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute cross-channel strategies: Plan, create, and implement effective campaign strategies across Programmatic, Meta, and Google Ads to drive traffic, increase conversions, and achieve business goals.
  • Google Ads campaign management: Plan, build, and optimize Search, Performance Max (PMax), and YouTube campaigns, including keyword strategy, bidding, asset groups, audience signals, and creative variations to maximize ROAS and deliver against client KPIs.
  • Meta Ads campaign management: Plan, build, and optimize campaigns across Meta platforms (Facebook, Instagram) covering objectives from awareness to conversion, leveraging audience segmentation, lookalikes, custom audiences, dynamic creative, and Advantage+ campaigns.
  • Programmatic campaign management: Set up, run, and optimize programmatic campaigns across display, video, and native channels, including bid strategy, creative rotation, audience targeting, contextual targeting, inventory selection, and viewability monitoring.
  • Google Tag Manager implementation: Implement, configure, and maintain Google Tag Manager (GTM) deployments — including triggers, variables, tags, dataLayer configuration, and custom events — to ensure accurate data capture across all marketing channels and platforms.
  • Google Analytics 4 (GA4) management: Set up, audit, and maintain GA4 properties, including event configuration, conversion tracking, audience setup, custom dimensions, and cross-channel attribution to inform optimization decisions.
  • Keyword research and audience targeting: Conduct comprehensive keyword research, audience analysis, and targeting strategy across Search, social, and programmatic channels to identify relevant and high-performing opportunities.
  • Campaign optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize campaigns across all channels to improve performance metrics such as click-through rates (CTR), conversion rates, cost per acquisition (CPA), and return on ad spend (ROAS).
  • Ad copy and creative direction: Write compelling ad copy and provide creative direction that aligns with channel best practices and campaign objectives across Search, social, and programmatic placements.
  • Landing page and conversion optimization: Collaborate with the marketing and web development teams to optimize landing pages and conversion paths for better user experience and conversion rates.
  • A/B testing: Design and execute A/B tests to evaluate different ad variations, audience segments, creative assets, landing page layouts, and campaign strategies, and implement data-driven optimizations.
  • Performance analysis and reporting: Track and analyze campaign performance metrics across channels, generate regular reports, and provide insights and recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Stay up to date with industry trends: Keep abreast of the latest cross-channel paid media trends, platform updates (Google Ads, Meta, programmatic DSPs), algorithm changes, and industry best practices to ensure the use of cutting-edge strategies and techniques.
  • Budget management: Monitor and manage budgets effectively across Programmatic, Meta, and Google Ads, ensuring optimal allocation of resources to achieve desired results.
  • Collaboration and communication: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including marketing, design, development, and data analytics, to align cross-channel strategies with broader marketing initiatives.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or a related field with 3–8 years of working experience in cross-channel performance strategy and optimization.
  • Proven experience in managing and optimizing paid campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, YouTube), Meta Ads (Facebook, Instagram), and Programmatic DSPs.
  • Hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM) implementation — including container setup, tags, triggers, variables, and dataLayer configuration.
  • Proficiency with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) — including property setup, event tracking, conversion configuration, audience definition, and cross-channel attribution analysis.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven decisions across multiple channels.
  • Proficiency in using paid media tools and platforms, such as Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, programmatic DSPs, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and bid management software.
  • Excellent understanding of platform algorithms, audience targeting, bid strategies, and attribution models across Search, social, and programmatic.
  • Experience with A/B testing and conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex data and insights to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Detail-oriented and highly organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work within deadlines.
  • Knowledge of SEO principles and how they align with paid strategies is a plus.
  • Willingness to work night shift hours (6:30 PM – 3:30 AM).

jobs.title: Media Buyer / Creative Strategist
jobs.excerpt: Media buying is now the easy part. In 2026, the buying itself is piping.
jobs.description:
Media buying is now the easy part.

In 2026, the buying itself is piping. The levers that actually move a DTC account are creative, offer, and conversion rate, and the platform keeps getting better at rewarding whoever gets those right.

So we don't hire media buyers. We hire marketers who buy media.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands across our service lines, 20 to 25 of them on paid media, and we spend $6-9M a month on Meta. We're hiring one person to own a handful of those accounts end to end.

Here's what "end to end" actually means here.

You are the account manager. We don't have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership and accountability: when you're the person answering for the account, it's your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You are the creative strategist. You do the research, you find the angles, and you write the briefs and the scripts. You direct our editors and designers rather than filing requests with them. Creative isn't a ticket you submit. It's your job.

You build the things the account needs. If conversion rate is the bottleneck, you build the landing page. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You carry up to six accounts. That's the capacity we run at today, and the team averages about four and a half. You'll manage far fewer accounts than you would at most agencies. In exchange you get real ownership of the results and you get to work as an end to end marketer instead of one station on an assembly line.

You can live anywhere. We're a remote team and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you're the client's point of contact and there's nobody else to cover it. The rest of your day is yours.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we'll both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

Own 4 to 6 DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, the creative lead, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $30k/mo to $1M/mo.

Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you're the one who answers when something isn't working.

Run the research before the ads. Marketing is 80% research here. You mine customer reviews, ad comments, support tickets, and Reddit for the language and objections that become angles. You pull competitor ad libraries. You run our internal tooling that OCRs and transcribes the ads in your account and ties them to performance, so you know what winning and losing actually look like in this account.

Write the briefs and the scripts, and direct the work. Creative direction is yours. You run revision rounds with our editors and designers and you hold the quality bar.

Ship creative on a cadence. Roughly 8 to 10 new ad launches a week is where accounts hold, in batches every 1 to 1.5 weeks. Informed volume, not spray and pray. We want better hypotheses, not more randomness.

Build and test landing pages. Advertorials, comparison pages, PDPs. Built in Claude Code, deployed to Vercel, tested live on a subdomain before anything gets pushed into the client's theme.

Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.

Report on new customer economics. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended ROAS and not last click. You'll be expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it.

You're a fit if

You've done this with real money. Hands-on Meta at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them.

You're AI-native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude (or equivalent) as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it. If you can research, write, and build a converting page from scratch, we can teach you the buying.

You can write direct response in English at a native or near-native level. Hooks, scripts, ad copy, advertorial. In the customer's own words, not invented. This is the single biggest source of leverage in the role and the thing we screen hardest for. If writing persuasive English isn't a strength, this isn't the job.

You can communicate your ideas. This matters as much as anything else on this list. You'll be in front of clients constantly with nobody in between, so you need to be able to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire.

You have taste and you know when to hand off. You direct creative, you don't half-build it yourself. AI slop shipped to a client is a habit we break, not a shortcut we accept.

You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.

Bonus: you've built or operated your own Shopify store or eComm brand. Several of our team have, and it shows.

You're not a fit if

  • "That wasn't my role" is in your vocabulary. It's the fastest way to end an interview here. If creative was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the creative.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.

Benefits

Why This Role Is Exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You will be surrounded by people who move fast, care a lot, and take the work seriously.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

jobs.description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:

  • The Analytical Technical Lead (ATL) is the single global point of contact and accountable owner for analytical lifecycle management of assigned commercial products across major markets (US, EU, China, Australia, Canada) and supports Rest of World (RoW) expansion and post-approval maintenance.

  • At Director level, this role is responsible for making risk-based, inspection-defensible decisions on methods, specifications, stability, and analytical investigations across a distributed internal/external QC network for small molecule products.

  • This leader ensures the analytical control strategy remains robust over the product lifecycle, drives harmonization, and enables reliable supply while meeting GMP, pharmacopeial, and regulatory expectations.

  • The Analytical Technical Lead (ATL) may own relevant global business processes, ensure compliance and efficiency.

Essential Functions of the Job:

A. Global Analytical Point of Contact (PoC) for Approved Commercial Products

  • Act as the global PoC for all analytical-related matters for assigned products, to ensure analytical readiness.

  • Provide governance and technical leadership for analytical topics spanning drug substance (DS), drug product (DP), and critical raw materials/reagents as applicable.

  • Translate global product strategy into aligned expectations and deliverables for internal QC sites, external QC labs/CMOs, AST, and MST.

B. Analytical Lifecycle Management: Changes, Deviations, and Investigations

  • Lead and approve strategy for analytical investigations and performance issues (OOS/OOT/OOE, atypical results, invalidations), ensuring scientifically sound root cause analysis and effective CAPA, including method optimization.

  • Drive analytical change control impact assessments and execution plans, including method updates, revalidation/verification, reference standard changes, and instrument/software upgrades.

C. Global Business Process & Knowledge Owner: Methods, Specifications, Stability, Retest/Shelf Life

When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

Parexel are registering interest for Senior Clinical Research Associates for UK based sponsor dedicated roles. Experience in oncology trials and RECIST criteria is essential. A minimum of 4 years' experience in CRO or Pharma trials environments is also essential.

The Senior CRA will be responsible for data integrity, data quality and ensuring compliance with ICH GCP and local requirements at the site level. Monitoring will be conducted in line with the Study Monitoring Plan (SMP) and will be performed virtually for the majority of activities to supplement on site visit requirements. The Senior CRA will collaborate with the Site Manager to assure that the site complies with the protocol and is inspection ready and will coordinate with institutions and investigators at the local level.

Oversight of Monitoring Responsibilities and Study Conduct

  • Ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions;immediately communicates/escalates significantissues to the project team and develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)/processes.

  • Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject as required.

  • Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject and assesses factors that might affect subject safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator site such as protocol deviation and violations and pharmacovigilance issues.

  • Per the Clinical Monitoring Plan (CMP) or SMP: Ability to conduct monitoring activities using different methods, (e.g., both on site and remote) where allowed by country regulations.

  • Conducts source document review and verification of appropriate site source documents and medical records. Verifies required clinical data entered in the Case Report Form (CRF) is accurate and complete.

  • Manages reporting of protocol deviations and appropriate follow up.

  • Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines.

  • May perform Investigational Product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security.

  • Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects according to the protocol and verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP.

  • Applies knowledge of GCP and local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported, and released and returned.

  • Manages reporting of identified issues and manages follow up to resolution.

  • Documents activities via follow up letters, monitoring reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and CMP and SMP.

  • Ensures all activities are managed by site personnel who are appropriately delegated and trained.

  • Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution. For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages site level activities and communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met.  (Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals and targets).

  • Reviews data entry timeliness in line with outlined requirements, missing pages, outstanding data queries, timelines for database locks.

  • Reviews site signature sheet and delegation of duties log to confirm any newly added or removed site staff are documented appropriately and the log is up to date. Where the site or Site Signature Sheet and Delegation of Duties Log indicates site personnel are no longer active on a study, review and assess training compliance with any new and updated training requirements (i.e., protocol amendment(s), etc.)

  • Conducts follow up for escalated adverse event monitoring (AEM) report queries.

  • Checks the site and external facilities, equipment, and supplies (clinical and non-clinical) continue to be adequate to conduct the trial and with their expiry dates (as applicable).

  • Checks site specific logs are complete and up to date (e.g., Site Visit Log, Screening and Enrollment Log, Signature Sheet and Delegation of Duties Log, Subject Identification Code List, IP Accountability Log).

Collaboration

  • Collaborates with primary Site Manager who will act as the primary liaison with site personnel.

  • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and sponsor face to face meetings.

  • Participates in global clinical monitoring and project staff meetings (inclusive of client representation, as applicable) and attends clinic.

Who are Parexel?

Parexel supports clinical studies across the full range of therapeutic areas, and we have longstanding partnerships with a vast client base.

We supported the trials of most of today’s top 50 best-selling drugs, but equally we enable more niche drug developments that are critical to the well-being of many patients.

You’ll be an influential member of the wider team.

What we are looking for in this role

For every role, we look for professionals who have the determination and courage always to put patient well-being first. That to us is working with heart.

Here are a few requirements specific to this advertised role.

Skills

  • Networking and relationship building skills. Ability to communicate effectively and appropriately with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Ability to adapt to changing technologies and processes. Effectively overcoming barriers encountered during the implementation of new processes and systems.

  • Excellent communication (verbal and written), presentation, and interpersonal skills relating to colleagues and associates, both inside and outside of the organization.

  • Identifies and builds effective relationships with investigator site staff and other stakeholders.

  • Proficiency in local language is required.

  • Fluency in English is required.

Education

Bachelor’s degree or Registered Nurse (RN) in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.

jobs.title: Helpline Contact Center Supervisor
jobs.excerpt: Health Resources in Action, Inc.  (HRiA) is a non-profit organization working to improve and reimagine public health.
jobs.description:
Health Resources in Action, Inc. (HRiA) is a non-profit organization working to improve and reimagine public health. We connect, consult, and collaborate to solve complex challenges of access and equity in our health and social systems. Together with our partners, clients, and collaborators, we create actionable solutions so that all people can thrive.

In 1957, The Medical Foundation (TMF) was created to primarily fund biomedical research in Massachusetts. Since then, we’ve been on a journey of evolution. We changed our name to Health Resources in Action (HRiA) to reflect our impact in the field of public health. Today, HRiA works with individuals, organizations, and communities to drive a policy and systems change approach to advance health and racial equity.

HRiA seeks sustainable solutions for complex problems using an anti-racist approach. We aim to be adaptable and flexible in meeting clients and partners where they are, offering our decades of knowledge and resources to collectively realize our dream of equitable, sustainable health for all. The foundation of this work is centered on our values:

  • Health and racial equity by identifying and addressing the root causes of health inequities, intentionally working to shift narratives and power imbalances and disrupt all systems of oppression.
  • Leading with heart by demonstrating our passionate commitment to our work, continuously challenging ourselves with humility and vulnerability while pursuing and holding ourselves accountable to our mission.
  • Collaboration by intentionally and respectfully leading, partnering, and following to strengthen relationships, uplift different voices and build trust.
  • Innovation by driving toward new strategies, questioning norms, and continuously learning and evolving to support the needs of our clients and communities.

HRiA offers exciting, engaging, and challenging employment opportunities for facilitators, trainers, researchers, analysts, policy specialists, grant managers, and more. People come to HRiA because of our commitment to advancing health equity and inspiring work; they stay for our wonderful clients, partners, and dedicated and dynamic staff. With our growing portfolio of high-impact work, person-centered policies, and generous benefits, our team continually invests in making HRiA a great place to work. Our diverse staff of over 270 people hail from 30+ states, with a homebase in Boston’s Chinatown neighborhood.

As part of our Public Health Services, HRiA manages an extensive portfolio of behavioral health initiatives, including statewide substance use helplines in Vermont and Oregon and substance use and problem gambling helplines in Massachusetts and Illinois. The Illinois Helpline for Opioids and Other Substances (Illinois Department of Human Services, Division of Substance Use Prevention and Recovery) was launched in 2017, building upon our experience operating the MA Substance Use Helpline (Massachusetts Department of Public Health, Bureau of Substance Addiction Services) for over 23 years. HRiA launched the Vermont Helplink (Vermont Department of Health, Division of Substance Use Programs) in 2019. HRiA began operating the MA Problem Gambling Helpline (Massachusetts Department of Public Health, Office of Problem Gambling Services) in 2020 and the Illinois Problem Gambling Helpline (Illinois Department of Human Services, Division of Substance Use Prevention and Recovery) in 2022. In December 2023, HRiA launched the Oregon Recovery Center Hotline, now the Oregon Hopeline (Oregon Health Authority).

The Helpline contact center is the hub for the Helplines. Screening & Information Specialists (SIS) comprise most of the contact center team and respond to incoming Helpline inquiries. Four Contact Center Supervisors provide Helpline services and provide direct supervision to a portion of the SIS team. Three Masters-level Clinicians supervise a portion of the SIS, implement follow-up services, and provide additional coverage and support. Additional Helpline team members deliver and support program operations, marketing and communication, web management, and data analysis and management, supervision, and leadership. The larger team is overseen by the Managing Director, Behavioral Health.

To learn more about HRiA and our helplines, visit the following:

  • HRiA:
  • IL Problem Gambling Helpline:
  • MA Problem Gambling Helpline:
  • IL Helpline for Opioids and Other Substances:
  • VT Helplink: www.VTHelplink.org
  • MA Substance Use Helpline:
  • Oregon Hopeline:

Opportunity

We are seeking a full-time Helpline Contact Center Supervisor to join our team on the Oregon Recovery Center Hotline (Oregon Hopeline), Massachusetts Substance Use & Problem Gambling Helplines (MA Helpline), the Illinois Helpline for Opioids and Other Substances (IL Helpline), the Illinois Problem Gambling Helpline, and the Vermont Helplink (VT Helplink). This is an exciting opportunity to take on a newly developed position to support substance use treatment access across three states and supervise a diverse team of staff.

Position Description

We are seeking a full-time Helpline Contact Center Supervisor to join our team for the MA Helpines, the IL Helplines, and VT Helplink. We refer to these projects collectively as “the Helplines.” This is an exciting opportunity to support substance use treatment and problem gambling treatment access across three states and supervise a diverse team of staff.

The Contact Center Supervisors are responsible for handling incoming Helpline inquiries and providing supervisory support to the contact center team. A portion of their time is providing scheduled and as-needed Helpline coverage, in addition to our dedicated team of 22 Screening & Information Specialists (SIS). This includes responding to incoming calls, online chats, and SMS text messages from people seeking information about and help with accessing substance use and/or problem gambling services for themselves, a family member or friend, and/or a client. In this capacity, they assess Helpline users’ needs, determine the most appropriate substance use prevention, treatment, and/or recovery support service options, identify available options (through the Helplines’ databases), and refer callers to those services. They provide accurate information, education, support, and referrals in a non-judgmental, respectful, and culturally competent manner.

About half of their time, Contact Center Supervisors provide supervisory support to the SIS team. Each Supervisor acts as a shift supervisor for SIS while they are working. This includes monitoring SIS consumer interactions, consulting with SIS and intervening during difficult interactions, and addressing any urgent issues as well as supporting the social-emotional wellbeing of staff and fostering their skill-building and professional growth. The Contact Center Supervisor will provide on-going training to SIS through periodic in-service trainings on relevant topics and will assist in the onboarding of new SIS.

Each Supervisor also directly supervises up to six SIS team members. This includes providing bi-weekly supervision, processing timesheets, and assisting with schedule coordination. (SIS also receive regular, group-level supervision from one of our Clinicians.) Contact Center Supervisors are responsible for supporting contact center operations, including helping to coordinate a 24/7 coverage schedule, staffing, and technology needs. They are the liaisons between the contact center team and information technology (IT) support. The Contact Center Supervisor will also be called upon to contribute expertise to the development of policies, procedures, protocols, and curricula to support the Helplines, and may be engaged in providing this expertise to other HRiA teams and projects focused on substance use, problem gambling, and/or behavioral health equity.

This is a full-time, remote position with a salary range of $57,000 to $64,000 based on skills and experience. Supervisors will receive training to assess the needs of Helpline users, provide appropriate information and referrals to services, and engage with and motivate Helpline users to follow through on referrals. They will also receive training on Contact Center operations, supervision essentials, and addiction, screening, treatment services, and resources.

Benefits

HRiA offers strong benefits to its employees, including:

  • Competitive salaries
  • Health insurance
  • Retirement plan
  • Flexible summer hours
  • Vacation starting at four weeks
  • 13 paid holidays, and office closure at the end of December

Duties and Responsibilities

Management

  • Coordinate and implement projects related to contact center operations, including technology, equipment, onboarding & training, among others, as assigned.
  • Work with Helpline Management to coordinate Helpline staffing schedules to ensure continuous 24-hour staffing coverage.
  • Serve as liaison between SIS and other project and organizational teams, to ensure appropriate representation and facilitate team integration.
  • Supervise up to six SIS.
  • Participate in on-call rotation.

Project Work

  • Troubleshoot technical contact center issues, and serve as liaison to IT support.
  • Assist with coordination and implementation of onboarding and professional development activities.
  • Assess the needs of Helpline users by telephone, online chat, and SMS texting.
  • Provide appropriate information and referrals to substance use, problem gambling, and/or related services.
  • Engage and motivate Helpline users to follow through on referrals by using active listening and motivational interviewing techniques.
  • Obtain feedback on interactions with Helpline users.
  • Gather and record data from Helpline users in Helpline database.
  • Verify Helpline users’ insurance status, as applicable.
  • Escalate Helpline user interactions to Helpline Managers as needed.
  • Represent the Helpline at outreach events, meetings, and/or presentations as needed.

Thought Leadership

  • Continue to build and develop expertise in substance use disorders, problem gambling, and behavioral health equity.
  • Suggest ideas/improvements through participation in teams and committees.
  • Attend and actively participate in Helpline meetings and other activities to develop skills and make suggestions for project enhancements.

New Business Development

  • Maintain updated resume and bio for use in new business proposals.
  • Assist with technical components of new business proposals as needed.

Candidate Qualifications

  • Five years of related experience (lived or professional) in the fields of substance use, recovery, problem gambling, and/or harm reductions Services, and manage mentor bachelor’s degree in psychology, social work, human services, or related field in lieu of experience.
  • Certified Resource Specialist (through Inform USA) preferred or willingness to obtain certification (at HRiA expense) within one year of hire.
  • Demonstrated experience and ability to supervise staff, and provide appropriate guidance, feedback, mentorship, and support.
  • Experience in information and referral services, customer service, counseling, substance use, problem gambling, or human services required.
  • Ability to adapt to changes in work environment and expectations.
  • Customer/consumer focused with excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Good computer skills and experience and/or ability to use online systems and databases.
  • Openness to information that may be different from personal views.
  • Willingness to work with consumers who may be ambivalent, resistant, impaired or have psychological disorders.
  • Must be open to providing information about a variety of treatment options and paths to recovery based on a caller’s needs.
  • Must be respectful of cultural differences and value diversity of thought, backgrounds, and perspectives.
  • Must have high ethical standards and a willingness to comply with professional expectations.
  • Demonstrated history of dependability needed.
  • Two years of sobriety requested for people in recovery.
  • Fluency in a language other than English (e.g., Spanish, Portuguese, Mandarin) is a plus.

Hours for this position will be non-traditional, requiring either early morning or late evening and weekend availability. The position includes weekend or overnight on-call duties. The Helplines are open 24 hours/day, 7 days/week, 365 days a year.

This description is intended to indicate the kinds of work duties that will be required in this position. It is not intended to limit, or in any way modify, the rights of any supervisor to assign, direct, and contract work of staff under his/her supervision. The use of a particular illustration describing duties shall not be held to exclude other duties, not mentioned, that are of a similar level or difficulty.

Procedure for Candidacy

HRiA is actively seeking to build a diverse and experienced staff. The organization encourages multiple perspectives and experiences, supports a multicultural environment, and strives to hire and retain a diverse work force that reflects the populations we work with and the communities where we work. Diversity is a core value of HRiA resulting in culturally competent services, materials, resources, and programs. Our hiring and business practices appreciate the strengths offered through different backgrounds.

HRiA is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer and is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

To apply, submit your cover letter and resume online at

Generally, our interviews take place between 9am-5pm ET. If you are contacted for an interview, please let us know if this timeframe is a challenge, so we can work with the interview team to find alternatives.

jobs.excerpt: Real Estate Operations Coordinator (Property Management, Leasing & Tenant Coordination) – RemoteProperty Management | Leasing | Tenant Coordination | Operations Position Type: Full-Time, Remote Working Hours: U.
jobs.description:
Real Estate Operations Coordinator (Property Management, Leasing & Tenant Coordination) – Remote

Property Management | Leasing | Tenant Coordination | Operations

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours (flexibility required for leasing cycles, rent collections, and maintenance coordination)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Real Estate Operations Coordinator to support the day-to-day operations of residential and commercial property portfolios.

This is a fast-paced, operations-focused role where you’ll help ensure tenant communication remains organized, leasing processes stay compliant, maintenance requests are resolved efficiently, and property records remain accurate and up to date.

You’ll serve as the operational link between tenants, property owners, vendors, and internal property management teams to ensure smooth portfolio operations and an exceptional tenant experience.

If you’re highly organized, detail-oriented, experienced with property management systems, and enjoy coordinating multiple moving parts, this role is an excellent fit.

What You’ll Own

Tenant Communication & Support

  • Respond to tenant inquiries regarding rent payments, lease terms, maintenance requests, and property policies.
  • Maintain detailed communication records within property management platforms.
  • Send reminders for rent due dates, lease renewals, inspections, and compliance notices.
  • Deliver professional, timely, and customer-focused support throughout the tenant lifecycle.

Leasing & Documentation

  • Process new lease agreements, renewals, amendments, and tenant onboarding documentation.
  • Maintain organized tenant files, including applications, identification, inspection reports, and signed agreements.
  • Ensure leasing documentation remains complete, accurate, and compliant.
  • Assist with property listings across platforms such as Zillow, Apartments.com, MLS, and similar listing services.

Property Management Systems

  • Maintain accurate records within platforms such as Yardi, AppFolio, Buildium, or similar systems.
  • Track rent collections, delinquencies, occupancy changes, late fees, and lease expirations.
  • Generate operational reports including rent rolls, occupancy reports, delinquency summaries, and leasing activity.

Maintenance Coordination

  • Create and assign maintenance work orders to vendors.
  • Monitor maintenance requests from submission through completion.
  • Coordinate communication between tenants and vendors.
  • Verify completed work and reconcile vendor invoices against approved work orders.
  • Ensure maintenance issues are resolved promptly and professionally.

Owner Reporting & Operational Support

  • Prepare owner statements, cash flow summaries, vacancy reports, and occupancy updates.
  • Provide regular updates on rent collections, maintenance activity, leasing progress, and property performance.
  • Ensure reports are accurate, organized, and delivered on schedule.

Compliance & Quality Control

  • Maintain compliance with landlord-tenant regulations, Fair Housing standards, and internal company procedures.
  • Ensure all documentation remains organized, complete, and audit-ready.
  • Support operational consistency through accurate recordkeeping and process adherence.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in property management, leasing coordination, real estate operations, or property administration.
  • Hands-on experience using Yardi, AppFolio, Buildium, or similar property management software.
  • Experience with lease administration, tenant communication, rent collection tracking, and maintenance coordination.

Technical Skills

  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
  • Familiarity with lease documentation, property operations, and reporting.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a high-volume environment.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience managing portfolios of 100+ units.
  • Multi-state property management experience.
  • Familiarity with owner statements, trust accounting, and security deposit management.
  • Experience supporting residential, commercial, or mixed-use property portfolios.

Tools & Platforms

  • Yardi
  • AppFolio
  • Buildium
  • Microsoft Office
  • Google Workspace
  • Zillow
  • Apartments.com
  • MLS Platforms

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Excellent communicator with tenants, vendors, and property owners.
  • Highly organized with strong follow-through.
  • Detail-oriented and process-driven.
  • Comfortable managing multiple operational workflows simultaneously.
  • Solutions-focused with strong operational judgment.
  • Thrives in fast-paced property management environments.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Respond to tenant inquiries and maintenance requests.
  • Process leases, renewals, and tenant documentation.
  • Update rent payments and occupancy records.
  • Coordinate vendors and monitor maintenance work orders.
  • Prepare owner reports and operational summaries.
  • Maintain accurate records within property management systems.
  • Ensure compliance across leasing and operational processes.

In short: You keep property operations organized, compliant, and running efficiently by coordinating leasing, maintenance, tenant communication, and operational reporting.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Rent collection percentage
  • Vacancy fill time
  • Maintenance resolution turnaround time
  • Accuracy of lease and tenant documentation
  • Owner satisfaction with reporting and communication
  • Operational accuracy and system data integrity

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Fully remote opportunity supporting U.S. property portfolios.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Brand Creative Director

Reports to: VP of Marketing/CMO

Role Summary

The Brand Creative Director owns Triquetra’s brand identity end to end — how the brand looks, sounds, and shows up everywhere a customer or retail buyer encounters it, across Amazon, our DTC site, TikTok Shop, packaging, and a rapidly growing national retail footprint. This role is the internal owner of our rebrand, the guardian of brand consistency across 100+ SKUs, and the creative leader who raises the ceiling of the team we already have.

Triquetra has scaled past $100M on the strength of product, science, and performance marketing. The brand layer is now the gap between where we are and best-in-class. We are at the beginning stages of a rebrand with a hard debut date at Expo West in March 2027, and our retail expansion has made packaging and shelf presence business-critical. This person turns a strong company into a recognizable premium brand — and builds the standards and systems that make that consistency scalable, so quality no longer depends on any single designer or on executive review.

This is a brand leadership role, not a conversion specialist role. Performance and CRO fluency are valuable context, but this role is measured on brand coherence, recognition, and retail readiness: does Triquetra look, sound, and feel like one premium brand the whole way through the customer journey — from a TikTok ad to a DTC page to an Amazon listing to a shelf at Sprouts.

Key Responsibilities

Brand Identity System Ownership

  • Own, evolve, and enforce the complete brand identity system: design standards, brand kits, voice and

visual guidelines, and editorial review across 100+ products and every channel.

  • Build the repeatable visual language that makes quality scalable — templates, component libraries,

layout patterns, and type / color / iconography standards any designer on the team can execute against.

  • Serve as the final creative quality gate so brand consistency lives in a system the whole team follows,

not in any one person’s head.

Rebrand Leadership

  • Act as the internal owner of the rebrand: manage the agency relationship, drive decisions on identity,

brand architecture, and design system, and hold the timeline to the Expo West March 2027 debut.

  • Carry the new identity through every surface — packaging, website, Amazon listings, social, the Expo

West booth, and retail buyer materials.

Packaging & Retail Presence

  • Own packaging design and the retail shelf experience, including front-of-pack benefit language that

communicates what a product does in a three-second read.

  • Develop shelf-ready, buyer-tested design that earns placement and repeat purchase as we expand

across Sprouts, Whole Foods, Walmart, and Costco.

Brand Storytelling & Voice

  • Translate complex science (methylation, GLP, microbiome) into a warm, credible consumer brand

without losing accuracy or compliance.

Creative Team Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop the in-house creative team; our senior design lead reports into this role.
  • Set the bar and raise the floor: review, redline, and elevate the team’s work so direction means making other people’s work world-class, not just producing hero work yourself.
  • Build the feedback, critique, and review rhythms that transfer brand standards down through the team.

New Product Launch Brand Work

  • Own the brand workstream for our monthly launch cadence: naming, packaging, launch identity, and listing creative direction.

Cross-Channel Consistency & Compliance

  • Ensure a buyer who meets us on a TikTok ad, lands on a DTC page, and checks the Amazon listing

experiences one coherent premium brand throughout.

  • Keep all customer-facing brand work inside our regulatory guardrails, partnering with compliance on claims and voice in a claims-sensitive category.

Qualifications

Required

  • Brand design / creative leadership, with directing other creatives.
  • CPG background — supplements, wellness, beauty, or food — with work that lives on both digital

shelves and physical ones.

  • Has built or rebuilt a brand identity at scale, ideally through a rebrand, packaging system overhaul, or retail launch.
  • Portfolio demonstrates brand systems, packaging, and standards a team actually executed against — not just beautiful one-off work.
  • Proven people developer: real stories of taking designers whose work wasn’t good enough and getting them to world-class.
  • Player-coach who stays hands-on: at our velocity, the bar-setter still ships.

Preferred

  • Supplement or regulated-category experience; comfortable working within FDA/FTC claims constraints.
  • Retail packaging experience with national grocery or mass retailers.
  • Experience managing external brand or creative agencies through a major engagement.
  • Modern tooling fluency — high-level Figma plus genuine comfort directing AI image/video pipelines. We move fast and use these tools heavily.
  • Conversion / CRO literacy as supporting context for digital surfaces.

• US-based preferred.

Key Skills

  • Brand systems thinking — builds the guardrails that let a team execute a vision consistently at 100+ SKU scale, rather than hand-crafting every asset.
  • Taste and restraint — understands that premium often means knowing what to remove; the

fundamentals that separate “looks templated” from “looks like a brand worth the price.”

  • Message-to-visual translation — takes something abstract (a mechanism, a claim, a founder story) and

turns it into brand expression a consumer instantly understands and believes.

  • Creative direction — reviews and elevates others’ work; gives clear, actionable feedback that raises the

team’s ceiling.

  • Cross-functional diplomacy — partners effectively with marketing, retail sales, ops/packaging,

compliance, and external agency teams.

  • Retail shelf instinct — designs for the three-second read and the crowded set, not just the scrolling

feed.

Position Summary

Ironmark is seeking a strategic, analytical, and client-focused Senior Digital Marketing Strategist to lead integrated marketing strategy across a portfolio of client accounts.

This role serves as the strategic bridge between client business objectives and marketing execution, partnering with clients, account teams, and channel specialists to develop growth-focused strategies that drive measurable business outcomes. The Senior Digital Marketing Strategist is responsible for aligning marketing initiatives across the customer journey, translating performance data into actionable recommendations, and ensuring execution supports broader business goals.

The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen, marketing expertise, and analytical thinking with the ability to build trusted client relationships and influence cross-functional teams. This role does not directly manage personnel but plays a critical leadership role in shaping strategy, guiding execution, and driving client success.

Key Responsibilities

Client Strategy & Leadership

  • Serve as the primary strategic advisor for assigned client accounts.
  • Lead strategic planning initiatives, quarterly business reviews, growth discussions, and client consultations.
  • Translate business goals into integrated marketing strategies and actionable roadmaps.
  • Present strategic recommendations, performance insights, and growth opportunities to client stakeholders.
  • Build trusted relationships through proactive consultation and strategic guidance.

Integrated Marketing Strategy

  • Develop and oversee integrated marketing strategies across paid media, SEO, AEO, content marketing, email marketing, local marketing, analytics, and emerging digital channels.
  • Ensure channel initiatives work cohesively throughout the customer journey and support business objectives.
  • Collaborate with channel specialists to align tactical execution with strategic priorities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve performance through audience targeting, conversion optimization, content alignment, media mix adjustments, and cross-channel coordination.
  • Stay informed on emerging technologies, AI-driven search experiences, and evolving consumer behavior.

Performance & Growth Planning

  • Analyze marketing performance data to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and growth drivers.
  • Translate insights into actionable recommendations for clients and internal teams.
  • Develop testing roadmaps and optimization plans designed to improve business outcomes.
  • Recommend channel investment strategies and budget allocation.
  • Identify opportunities for account growth and expanded service adoption.
  • Lead strategic onboarding and discovery efforts for new client engagements.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Paid Media, SEO, Content, Creative, Analytics, Development, Local Marketing, and Account Management teams to ensure coordinated execution.
  • Provide strategic guidance while respecting channel ownership and subject matter expertise.
  • Support internal teams with market research, competitive insights, and strategic recommendations.
  • Contribute to agency thought leadership, process improvements, and strategic best practices.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 4–7 years of experience in digital marketing, growth marketing, account strategy, marketing consulting, or agency environments.
  • Experience presenting recommendations and performance insights to clients or business stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of integrated digital marketing strategy and how multiple channels work together to drive business outcomes.
  • Demonstrated expertise in multiple digital marketing disciplines and working knowledge across paid, organic, content, local, email, and analytics channels.
  • Experience analyzing marketing performance data and translating insights into strategic recommendations.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong organizational, project management, and problem-solving abilities.

Preferred

  • Agency experience managing multiple client accounts.
  • Experience supporting multi-location, healthcare, multifamily, higher education, franchise, or B2B marketing programs.
  • Familiarity with GA4, Looker Studio, CRM platforms, marketing automation platforms, and reporting tools.
  • Understanding of AI-powered search experiences, AEO, attribution frameworks, and conversion optimization.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

  • You naturally connect business goals to marketing strategy.
  • You enjoy solving complex marketing challenges and uncovering growth opportunities.
  • You can confidently communicate with clients, executives, and channel specialists.
  • You think beyond individual tactics and understand how channels work together throughout the customer journey.
  • You are comfortable using data to inform decisions and recommendations.
  • You balance strategic thinking with accountability and execution.
  • You stay curious about emerging trends in AI, search, media, and digital marketing.

Why Join Ironmark

At Ironmark, we combine strategy, creativity, technology, and data to help organizations grow. Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and delivering measurable results for clients across a wide range of industries.

As a Senior Digital Marketing Strategist, you’ll have the opportunity to influence meaningful client outcomes, collaborate with talented specialists, and help shape the future of integrated digital marketing.

jobs.description:
This role supports the large-scale modernization of legacy systems by leading the migration of documentation and records into a cloud-based environment. The position focuses on transforming document-heavy workflows into structured, digital processes, while enabling seamless data integration across systems using MuleSoft APIs. The work directly supports enhanced analytics, reporting, and operational efficiency for a mission-critical enterprise platform.

Responsibilities

  • Implement data quality processes (cleansing, deduplication, reconciliation) to ensure accuracy and completeness post-migration.

  • Support phased migration and system cutover with minimal operational disruption.

  • Design, build, and maintain MuleSoft integrations, including API development for real-time and batch data exchange.

  • Apply data transformation logic (e.g., DataWeave) and troubleshoot integration/data flow issues across systems.

  • Contribute to Salesforce Data 360 implementation, including data harmonization, identity resolution, and unified profiles.

  • Ensure proper data ingestion, lineage, metadata management, and traceability across the ecosystem.

  • Ensure compliance with data governance, privacy, and security requirements (e.g., PII).

  • Collaborate in Agile teams; support testing, documentation, and audit readiness across migration and integration efforts.

Required Qualifications

  • U.S. Citizenship required due to federal contract requirements

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance

  • Candidate must have lived in the U.S. for three (3) full years out of the last five (5) years

  • 6+ years of experience in data engineering, data migration, or data integration roles

  • Proven experience executing large-scale data migration efforts, including legacy system transformation

  • 2+ years hands-on experience with Salesforce data migrations, including data modeling, data loading (e.g., Data Loader, APIs), and managing relational datasets

  • 2+ years' experience implementing data quality, validation, and reconciliation processes during migration efforts

Preferred Qualifications

  • Current or recent Public Trust or active Secret clearance

  • Experience supporting DHS or other federal agencies

  • 1+ year Experience using Informatica (e.g., PowerCenter, IICS) for ETL/ELT development, data mapping, and pipeline orchestration

  • 2+ years proficiency in SQL and relational data modeling concepts

  • Experience working with both structured and unstructured data, including document-based records

  • 1+ year Experience supporting or developing MuleSoft integrations, including API development, data transformations, and system-to-system data flows

  • 1+ years experience with MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, including DataWeave and API-led connectivity patterns

  • Familiarity with cloud-based SaaS platforms and distributed data architectures

  • Familiarity with metadata management, data lineage, and audit frameworks

  • Experience working in federal or highly regulated environments

  • Experience supporting Agile delivery teams and cross-functional collaboration

  • Experience supporting large-scale, document-centric system migrations

  • Familiarity with Docusign eSignature and Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) products a plus

  • Experience with Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud), including data harmonization and identity resolution

  • Experience with Salesforce Document AI / Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) tools for extracting structured data from documents

Furthermore, RTG was recently named a "Best in Business" company and ranked among the Top Healthcare Development Companies by Modern Healthcare, solidifying our position as a leader in the industry.

In addition to our accolades, we currently manage a portfolio of over 26 million square feet of healthcare assetsand have successfully completed healthcare transactions totaling more than $3 billion, reinforcing our expertise and reputation in the industry.

With offices in Nashville, Knoxville, and Johnson City, TN; Atlanta, GA; Tampa, FL; Houston, TX; and Greensboro, NC, we are well-positioned to deliver exceptional services tailored to the diverse needs of our clients nationwide.

For more information about RTG and our innovative healthcare real estate services, visit . Stay connected with us on Facebook, YouTube, and LinkedIn for the latest industry insights and company updates.

JOB DESCRIPTION and RESPONSIBILITIES

The Lease Administrator assists in day-to-day lease administrative needs that will assure a well-managed, well-accounted building, placing maximum emphasis on positive response to concerns and needs of the customer and on increasing the value of the property being managed. Lease Administrator reports directly to the Property Accountant and indirectly to the Senior Operations Manager.

The Lease Administrator must be able to demonstrate attention to detail and exercise good judgment in handling sensitive information. Excellent communication and strong organizational skills are required. Successful candidate must be able to work collaboratively with multiple commercial property managers and real estate brokers.

Specific responsibilities include:

  • Abstract and input all leases and lease information into Property Management Software Program.
  • Track, maintain, and communicate all expirations, option exercise dates, and other critical information to the assigned Property and Leasing Managers.
  • Coordinate with the Property / Leasing Managers for the timely submission of tenant lease forms on a monthly basis.
  • Review commercial billing for accuracy, as well as for extra service chargers which require verification against the lease.
  • Assist in the review of the tenant rent, CAM, operating expense, tax or insurance reimbursement reconciliation as required.
  • Review, as well as update Consumer Price Index Adjustments as provided for in the leases.
  • Research and interpret lease language in consultation with attorneys and provide information and guidance related to real estate and lease matters as requested by Property Managers and real estate brokers.
  • Provide backup and/or assistance for various administrative duties as needed.
  • Maintain the integrity of the lease data file systems. Within the accounting software system, maintain a summary of critical dates and lease clauses.
  • Maintain and track all tenant COI’s in Property Management Software.
  • Prepare, review, and revise lease documents.
  • File, fax, scan and distribute lease documents and other correspondence for execution and delivery.
