jobs.description:
About Perle
Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises. Our partners include xAI, Samsung, ELM, and Unisys. Headquartered in San Francisco with experts across more than forty markets, we specialize in the work that requires real human judgment: domain expertise, linguistic nuance, and cultural fidelity that generic data vendors cannot deliver.

Apply here:

The Role
We are hiring expert Galician transcribers to convert audio recordings of native speakers into precise, conventionally formatted written transcripts. The work powers speech recognition, dialogue, and evaluation systems for major AI labs. Audio ranges from clean studio recordings to natural conversational speech in real-world acoustic conditions.

You will be working at the level of expert linguistic judgment. This is not data entry. Decisions about orthography, code-switching, speaker attribution, disfluencies, and non-speech events shape the quality of every model trained on your output.

Dialect and Scope

Galician (galego) as spoken across the autonomous community of Galicia, with variation between coastal and inland varieties. Project audio includes natural Galician-Spanish code-switching common in everyday speech.

Primary speaker regions: A Coruna, Santiago de Compostela, Vigo, Ourense, Lugo, Pontevedra.

What You Will Do

  • Transcribe audio recordings into accurate, time-aligned written text following Perle's project-specific style guide
  • Apply correct conventions for speaker identification, overlapping speech, disfluencies, fillers, false starts, and non-speech events such as laughter, background noise, and music
  • Make principled orthographic decisions for dialectal, colloquial, and code-switched speech
  • Flag ambiguous segments, uncertain speakers, and audio quality issues using project conventions
  • Self-review every submission against Perle's quality bar before delivery
  • Engage with QA reviewers on edge cases, calibration sessions, and style guide updates

Must Have

  • Native fluency in Galician with lifelong residence or deep immersion in Galicia
  • Mastery of Galician orthography per the Real Academia Galega guidelines
  • Ability to distinguish Galician from Portuguese and from Spanish in mixed audio
  • Comfortable transcribing Galician-Spanish code-switching as it occurs naturally
  • At least two years of professional transcription, captioning, court reporting, broadcast, translation, or linguistic annotation experience
  • Demonstrated accuracy at the word level under deadline pressure
  • Comfortable with web-based annotation platforms and variable-speed audio playback
  • Reliable high-speed internet, quality headphones, and a quiet workspace
  • Ability to commit to defined volume per week during active project phases

Nice To Have

  • Background in Galician linguistics, translation, journalism, or education
  • Prior experience annotating Romance-language speech data
  • Working knowledge of Portuguese or Spanish for cross-lingual audio
  • Familiarity with IPA or other phonetic transcription systems
  • Experience with verbatim versus clean-verbatim transcription conventions

How We Work With You

  • Paid pilot task before full onboarding so both sides can calibrate
  • Per-task or per-minute compensation, with rates tied to audio complexity and turnaround
  • Flexible scheduling, with volume scaling up and down based on active client projects
  • Direct working relationship with Perle's linguistic leads and QA team
  • Eligible for invitation to additional Perle expert projects across related domains

How To Apply

Apply through Winnow, Perle's job portal at winnow.perle.ai. Find the role for your language under Open Jobs, set up your candidate profile, and complete the fully automated interview, which takes about 25 minutes. We review applications within 24 hours and invite passing candidates straight to the project.

Apply here:

jobs.excerpt: Job DescriptionPosition OverviewReporting to the SVP, Software Engineering and AI Operations, the Director of AI Governance & Enterprise Solutions is Momentive's senior AI subject matter expert — the person who sets the technical bar for how the company designs, builds, deploys, and governs AI agents.
jobs.description:
Job Description

Position Overview

Reporting to the SVP, Software Engineering and AI Operations, the Director of AI Governance & Enterprise Solutions is Momentive's senior AI subject matter expert — the person who sets the technical bar for how the company designs, builds, deploys, and governs AI agents. This role owns the Momentive Context Library, defines and enforces the standards that all AI agents must meet, leads the review and approval of agents across the portfolio, and directly builds agents and skills for the AI Operations Hub. When business units need to build AI solutions, this leader will be a strategic technical partner.

Core Responsibilities

Context Library Ownership

  • Own the Momentive Context Library — the shared knowledge repository that AI agents across the company depend on for accurate, consistent, organization-specific context.
  • Define the library's architecture, taxonomy, and content standards, ensuring it is well-organized, current, and designed to be consumed reliably by agents across different use cases.
  • Define and maintain the standards for centrally-owned content — shared company knowledge, cross-functional reference material, and foundational context that spans business units — ensuring it remains accurate, current, and consistently structured.
  • Partner with AI Operations Hub spoke leads to help them build, structure, and maintain department-owned content — including converting existing documentation and institutional knowledge into library-ready context.

Agent Review & Standards

  • Define the technical review criteria and quality standards that all AI agents, skills, and connectors must meet for AI Operations Hub approval — covering design, architecture, data handling, accuracy, safety, and operational readiness.
  • Lead the technical review and approval process for all AI agents submitted through the AI Operations Hub intake process, making or formally endorsing go/no-go recommendations.
  • Develop agent development guidelines, design patterns, and templates that translate AI Operations Hub standards into practical, reusable building blocks for spoke teams.
  • Identify systemic quality issues, common failure modes, and emerging risks across the agent portfolio, and use those insights to continuously raise the technical bar.

Building for AI Operations

  • Directly design and build AI agents, skills, and connectors for the AI Operations team's own use — including tooling that supports AI Operations Hub functions like intake review, registry management, and performance monitoring.
  • Prototype and evaluate new agent architectures, orchestration frameworks, and tooling approaches before recommending them for broader organizational use.

Technical Consulting & Deployment Guidance

  • Serve as the primary technical advisor to spoke teams as they design and build AI solutions — providing hands-on architecture guidance, reviewing approach before build begins, and troubleshooting when things go wrong.
  • Own the AI Operations Hub's standards for how agents are deployed, monitored, and secured in production — including environment configuration, observability requirements, access controls, and incident response protocols.
  • Partner with Corporate IT on the platform and infrastructure decisions that affect how agents are deployed and maintained across the organization.
  • Assess and recommend AI platforms, tools, and vendor solutions as the technology landscape evolves, with a focus on what will actually serve Momentive's operational model.
  • Partner on how AI agents and automation intersect with the enterprise application portfolio — aligning platform strategy, tooling investments, and governance standards across both functions.

Enablement

  • Develop technical reference materials, design pattern libraries, and decision guides that help spoke teams make better architectural choices independently.
  • Deliver targeted technical training and workshops when spoke teams need to build a foundational capability — this is a supporting function, not a primary one.
  • Actively connect spoke teams to each other — surfacing shared use cases, reusable patterns, and prior work across business units so teams build on each other's progress instead of solving the same problems independently.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 7+ years of hands-on experience designing and building software or AI systems, with at least 3 years working directly with large language models, AI agents, and production AI deployments.
  • Deep practical expertise with AI agent architectures, LLM APIs, orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar), and the tradeoffs between them.
  • Expert-level knowledge of prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool use and function calling, context window management, and agent evaluation methodologies.
  • Demonstrated experience building and deploying AI agents in production environments — including decisions around deployment architecture, observability, access controls, and failure handling.
  • Experience designing or governing shared knowledge repositories, context management systems, or information architectures for AI systems.
  • Strong instincts for AI risk — understanding where agents fail, how to test for it, and how to build systems that degrade gracefully.
  • Experience with enterprise AI platforms such as Claude Enterprise, Azure OpenAI Service, Google Vertex AI, or similar.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to make complex technical positions clear and defensible to both engineering and non-technical leadership audiences.
  • Familiarity with AI governance frameworks (NIST AI RMF or similar) and responsible AI principles as they apply to production systems.
  • Experience operating in a cross-functional environment where you set standards others must follow, not just your own team.
  • Demonstrated growth mindset and commitment to staying ahead in a rapidly evolving field.

What Success Looks Like

  • Every AI agent that reaches production has been reviewed against a clear, defensible technical standard — and the review process makes agents better, not just slower.
  • The Momentive Context Library is the most trusted source of organizational knowledge available to AI agents — current, well-structured, and actively relied upon by spoke teams.
  • AI Operations' own agents are high-quality, well-maintained, and set the standard that spoke teams aspire to.
  • Spoke teams leave technical consultations with a clearer path forward and better architectural decisions than they would have made on their own.
  • Production agents are deployed consistently, monitored reliably, and secured according to a clear, documented standard.
  • The AI Operation’s Hub technical bar is high and rising — and the organization's AI portfolio reflects it.
  • New capabilities are evaluated and piloted by the AI Operations Hub before spoke teams start asking for them.

About Us

Momentive Software amplifies the impact of over 20,000 purpose-driven organizations in over 30 countries, with over $11 billion raised and 55 million members served to date. Mission-driven nonprofits and associations rely on Momentive’s cloud-based software and services to address their most pressing challenges – from engaging their communities to simplifying operations and growing revenue. Designed to help organizations connect more, manage more, and ultimately expect more, Momentive's solutions are built with reliability at the core and strategically focus on fundraising, learning, events, careers, volunteering, accounting, and association management. Momentive partners with organizations that believe "good enough" is never enough – so they can bring on better outcomes for everyone they serve. Learn more at momentivesoftware.com.

Why Work Here?

At Momentive Software, we’re a team of passionate problem-solvers, innovators, and volunteers who believe in using technology to make a real difference. We dream big, support each other, and take pride in creating solutions that help our customers drive meaningful change. If you’re looking for a place where your work matters and your ideas are valued, you’ll find it here.

Live Oak Bank is a digital bank that serves small business owners across the country. Our groundbreaking spin on service and technology has fueled our mission to be America’s Small Business Bank. How This Role Impacts Live Oak and its People

The Associate Director, Venture Banking will enable the success of the Venture Banking team by sourcing new client opportunities, winning those opportunities, onboarding new relationships, and taking ownership of the relationships post-loan closing/onboarding under the direction of the Managing Director. As the relationship manager for clients, the Associate Director owns the client relationship over its life cycle. The Director will also work with other LOB groups to ensure client relationships are appropriately onboarded and serviced over the life of the loan.

What You’ll Do at Live Oak

  • Develop and retain VB clients including loan and deposit opportunities with guidance from Managing Director

  • Oversee loan underwriting and origination

  • Maintain in-depth knowledge of the venture capital ecosystem and firm products and services

  • Present and negotiate term sheets with prospects; Compete to win the opportunity

  • Manage the final credit and loan document negotiation processes appropriately by working with other LOB teammates and outside counsel

  • Identify “non-lending” relationship opportunities using the Bank’s deposit and treasury management platform. Cross-sell products to existing customers

  • Take on strategic projects as needed for the benefit of the team

  • Take ownership of any issues, especially as related to company performance and compliance

  • When necessary and applicable, work with Credit and SAG to manage troubled credits

  • Be a strong teammate and enable the VB team’s long-term success

  • Maintain a high standard of regulatory awareness including BSA, AML, CIP, and OFAC

Deal Sourcing

  • Call on VC firms and their portfolio companies directly

  • Nurture long-term, mutually beneficial relationships with VC firms and other referral sources

  • Attend conferences and other networking events

  • Travel as needed to expand LOB brand and source new opportunities

  • Keep abreast of economic conditions and VC market trends

  • Work with team to develop broader marketing and networking efforts

Term Sheet Issuance & Negotiations

  • Take ownership of the relationship and negotiation process

  • Work directly with VBOs, PMs, and PAs to advise on underwriting, lead diligence calls, and take responsibility for the “final product” that goes to credit

  • Issue and negotiate term sheets with prospects with objective of winning the opportunity

  • Communicate clearly as process evolves and ask for guidance or assistance as needed

Loan Closing

  • Assist and advise PAs on final credit approval package and present to credit in accordance with bank policies and procedures

  • Take ownership of the loan documentation process by working with outside counsel to issue, negotiate, and finalize loan docs

  • Work in consultation with Borrower to achieve optimal outcomes for all parties while maintaining a focus on soundness and security for LOB

  • Once documents are in execution phase, be available as a resource to Closer and PA during closing and onboarding process

Relationship Management

  • Own the client relationship across the life cycle

  • Serve as primary contact for company post-closing

  • Collaborate with PMs and PAs as needed for regular portfolio management

  • Conduct client update calls and investor calls as needed

  • Identify new ways (credit or otherwise) to meet client needs and expand relationship

Required Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

  • Experience underwriting and servicing venture banking type credits

  • In-depth knowledge of Bank lending policies, procedures, and criteria

  • High degree of self-motivation, dedication, creativity, and perseverance

Preferred Experience

  • A minimum of 2 years Venture Banking/VC industry-specific experience

  • Additional team and portfolio management experience

  • Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills

  • Strong financial analysis and modeling skills

  • Sound judgment

  • Strong computer skills, including Word and Excel

Our Values

  • Dedication: Possess a deep commitment to Live Oak Bank’s mission and core values, exemplified through a strong work ethic, adaptability and pride in your work.

  • Ownership: Take initiative to deliver positive results by proactively and creatively solving problems, while maintaining a high degree of quality.

  • Respect: Treat everyone with courtesy, politeness, and kindness.

  • Innovation: Embrace fresh ideas and fearlessly contribute new solutions to emerging or existing problems.

jobs.excerpt: Forget boring manual testing!  Join our Synera team on the mission to reach 100% automation, working across web and desktop environments with various tech stacks.
jobs.description:
Forget boring manual testing! Join our Synera team on the mission to reach 100% automation, working across web and desktop environments with various tech stacks. 🚀


WHAT YOU WILL DO

We're looking for a QA Engineer who's passionate about test automation and loves solving technical challenges across different tech stacks. At Synera, you'll work on a unique mix of web and desktop applications that connect AI, engineering tools, and complex user workflows – and you'll have the freedom with unlimited AI tokens to automate the boring stuff and focus on what matters.

You’ll join the Marketplace team, led by Andrew (VP of Software Partnerships), is formalizing in 2026 with dedicated full-time roles. You'll work alongside Hussein (add-in evangelism & learning content), Mark and Baha (add-in reviews), and Niklas and Andrey (partner onboarding & add-in development). The team's mission is to provide ready-made connections to all major engineering software for our customers.

As part of the QA team, you'll be the advocate for software quality. You'll work with developers to share testing knowledge, work together with solution engineers to solve customer problems, build automated tests for new features, or let AI build them for you, and help us scale quality as we scale our platform. This isn't about finding bugs – it's about preventing them and making our entire engineering process faster and more reliable.

👉 Your tasks will be:

🤖 Build & maintain automated test pipelines

You extend our Playwright end-to-end test suite, reduce manual regression testing time, and keep our CI/CD pipelines running smoothly. Your goal: automate the repetitive stuff so the team can ship faster with confidence. This also extends to AI-assisted development.

🤝 Collaborate closely with internal & external developers

You will be responsible for testing in- and externally developed add-ins for our software. These can include integrations into other applications like CAD or Simulation tools and you will be point of contact.

🔍 Investigate & solve complex issues

You dig into bug reports from users and support, reproduce tricky issues, and work with the team to understand root causes. You design test scenarios for both new and existing functionality across different platforms.

🚀 Ship quality with every commit

You work in a fast-paced environment where QA isn't a separate phase – it's integrated into the AI-assisted development process. You validate features, monitor pipelines, and ensure that quality is built in from day one.

🌱 Learn & share knowledge

You participate in team initiatives to explore new tools, test LLM-powered features, and experiment with innovative approaches to quality.

⚡ In 3 months:

  • You become a reliable QA team member - testing changes to complete reviews and ensuring quality is built into every add-in release.

  • You’ve set up your first AI-first pipeline for testing updates to certain existing add-ins

⚡ In 6 months:

  • You'll extend our automated end-to-end Playwright pipeline to include test cases currently done manually, integrating seamlessly into our sprint workflows.

  • You also take ownership of the marketplace add-in review pipeline - prioritizing new add-in reviews based on feedback from the Head of Marketplace, and ensuring bugs are tracked and reported back to partners in a timely manner.

  • You’ve set up AI-first pipelines for testing updates to most existing and some new add-ins.

⚡ In 12 months:

  • Your AI automation work will reduce manual testing effort from 4 hours to 10 minutes, freeing the team to focus on innovation while maintaining high quality.

  • You can trace bugs back to the changes that caused them, helping us prevent similar issues in the future.

Here is our team at last year’s summer event - join us at the next one! 👋

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

  • Flexible working: you decide when & where to work (as long as you have a residency in Germany).

  • Flexible public holidays: swap days off according to your values and beliefs!

  • Home office setup support + access to our office in Bremen.

  • Personal development budget of €2,000 to attend conferences and trainings or buy interesting books to improve in an area of your choice.

  • We don't count your vacation days, as we trust all our team members to decide what's best for them and the company.

  • To support your personal and professional well-being, we offer company fitness with Wellpass and mental health platform nilo.

  • Regular team events, virtual coffee breaks, and spontaneous afterworks. We also get together as a whole company for 2-3 day off-sites twice a year! 🌈

Requirements

🌱 WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

Even if you don't meet these criteria perfectly but believe you have lots to bring to the role, we encourage you to apply. We know it's tough, but please keep in mind that you don't have to match all the listed requirements exactly to be considered for this role.

  • You resonate with Synera's Core Values - they're central to how we work, and we'll explore them together in your first interview.

  • You have demonstrated experience with testing methodologies and are comfortable with standard QA and development tools.

  • You have hands-on experience with Playwright or similar test automation tools (Selenium WebDriver, WebdriverIO, TestComplete).

  • You can write clean code in at least one high-level/script language (C#, Python, or JavaScript).

  • You have experience with state-of-the-art AI tools.

  • You can understand requirements and acceptance criteria from stakeholders and translate them into test scenarios.

  • You’re a confident English communicator.

P.S. Synera is a place where everyone can grow. So, however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come to work every day, and be prepared to share with us how your perspective will bring something unique and valuable to our R&D team.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Trainer
jobs.excerpt: Hi, I'm Lolitta Tucker, your Recruiter and guide to joining CSG!
jobs.description:
Hi, I'm Lolitta Tucker, your Recruiter and guide to joining CSG! We are excited to learn more about you and your unique background.

CSG is looking to hire a Senior Technical Trainer – SDLC Standards & Delivery Enablement who will play a critical role in strengthening our CDD’s delivery discipline, audit readiness, and consistency of execution across the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC). This is not a traditional classroom‑only trainer role.

This position operates as a delivery standards enablement partner, blending SDLC governance, process ownership, audit enablement, and applied learning. The role ensures that delivery standards are clearly defined, well understood, consistently applied, and effectively supported in modern, AI‑assisted development environments. The ideal candidate can translate complex delivery workflows into clear, role‑specific guidance; identify systemic execution gaps; and design training and enablement that measurably improves our delivery outcomes.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Recruiter who will:

  • Own the CDD SDLC Process Playbook as the authoritative source of delivery standards.
  • Define, document, and maintain SDLC workflows, controls, role responsibilities, decision points, and required artifacts.
  • Produce clear visual standards, including process diagrams, flowcharts, and role‑based views, to ensure consistent understanding.
  • Maintain documentation governance, version control, and approval workflows across SharePoint and Teams.
  • Ensure standards remain current as delivery practices, tooling, and organizational needs evolve.
  • Design and deliver role‑specific training aligned to required SDLC standards, quality expectations, and audit needs.
  • Translate SDLC standards and audit requirements into clear, actionable guidance for technical and cross‑functional roles.
  • Create and deliver training across multiple modalities and depths, including:
    • One‑point lessons
    • Focused micro‑learning modules
    • Full SDLC retraining or artifact‑specific deep dives
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, QA, Architecture, Operations, and Quality to ensure shared understanding of delivery expectations.
  • Incorporate audit findings, incident learnings, and operational feedback into targeted training and process improvements.
  • Facilitate feedback loops to identify recurring failure points, simplification opportunities, and error‑proofing strategies.
  • Track training completion, adoption, and compliance trends over time.
  • Evaluate training effectiveness using outcome‑based signals (e.g., audit improvement, reduction in repeat findings, artifact quality).
  • Continuously refresh enablement materials as standards, practices, and delivery tooling evolve.
  • Create training and standards materials using enterprise documentation and visualization tools (PowerPoint, Word, Visio, Miro, etc.).
  • Maintain structured, version‑controlled document libraries in SharePoint/OneDrive.
  • Use reporting tools (Excel, Power BI, or equivalent) to track training, corrective actions, and compliance metrics.
  • Navigate SDLC tooling and delivery systems to support audit evidence, traceability, and quality reviews.
  • Operate comfortably in environments where AI‑enabled development tools are part of standard delivery workflows, ensuring teams understand how SDLC controls and artifacts support safe, compliant, production‑ready AI use.
  • Improved SDLC audit outcomes and reduction in repeat or systemic findings.
  • Increased consistency and quality of required delivery artifacts.
  • Sustained training adoption and completion across delivery roles.
  • Observable improvement in role‑based SDLC execution and delivery discipline.
  • Deliver engaging technical training for classroom-based, virtual classroom-based, or blended learning in groups or individually using, applicable software.

Is this opportunity right for you? We are looking for candidates who:

  • Have a bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Education, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Has 5+ years of experience in technical training, delivery enablement, SDLC governance, quality/process management, or a closely related discipline.
  • Has strong written communication and structured documentation skills.
  • Can demonstrate the ability to translate complex technical workflows into clear, teachable guidance.
  • Has a solid working knowledge of SDLC concepts, delivery governance, and quality assurance practices.
  • Have proven facilitation and coaching skills with technical and cross‑functional audiences.
  • Have high organizational discipline, including version control and documentation of governance.
  • Have experience supporting or working within AI‑assisted software delivery environments.
  • Have a working knowledge of adult learning principles, instructional design, or curriculum development.
  • Have experience with structured delivery models (e.g., Specification‑Driven Development (SDD), Agile, or similar).
  • Have experience supporting compliance audits or regulated delivery environments.
  • Have familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, environments, and release processes.
  • Have experience working with or alongside Learning Management Systems (LMS) or structured training repositories.
  • Have relevant certifications such as:
    • ATD CPTD / APTD
    • CompTIA Certified Technical Trainer (CTT+)
    • CPTM or equivalent L&D certifications
  • Are proficient in English in a business environment

CSGer Perks & Benefits

  • Work from Home
  • Employee Belonging Groups
  • Healthcare: Dental, Medical
  • Birthday Day Off
  • Meal Allowance
  • Paid Vacation, Volunteer,

Location(s):

Brazil Remote

Accommodation:

If you would like to be considered for employment opportunities with CSG and need special assistance due to a disability or accommodation for a disability throughout any aspect of the application process, please call us at +1 (402) 431-7440 or email us at . CSG provides accommodations for persons with disabilities in employment, including during the hiring process and any interview and/or testing processes.

Our Guiding Principles:

Impact: Always help and empower others, whether they’re colleagues or customers. When our employees set their minds to something, great things happen.

Integrity: Do what’s right for our customers and our people while being authentic. We treat everyone with trust and respect—that’s just who we are.

Inspiration: Be bold in the way you think and passionate about the work you do. Test out innovative ideas without the fear of failure.

Our Story:

CSG empowers companies to build unforgettable experiences, making it easier for people and businesses to connect with, use and pay for the services they value most. For over 40 years, CSG's technologies and people have helped some of the world's most recognizable brands solve their toughest business challenges and evolve to meet the demands of today's digital economy.

By channeling the power of all, we make ordinary customer and employee experiences extraordinary. Our people [CSGers] are fearlessly committed and connected, high on integrity and low on ego, making us the easiest company to do business with and the best place to work. We power a culture of integrity, innovation, and impact across our locations, representing the most authentic version of ourselves to build a better future together. That's just who we are. Keyrus is an international group of 2,800 consultants and experts across 28 countries, built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.

For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalise intelligence.

AI does not replace humans. It repositions us to a place no system can follow: understanding, deciding, designing, and creating.

At Keyrus, you will not just develop skills — you will develop judgment. Your expertise sharpens with every system you architect, every client challenge you solve, and every deployment that compounds on the last.

Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a Keyrus Architect of Intelligence.

Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates. Industrial discipline connects the two.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Global Clinical Study Manager

Job Location: Remote (US)

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:

At BeOne, our Global Development SuperHighway — our integrated, end-to-end, wholly internal development capability — is a cornerstone of our R&D vision. It brings together a unique set of internal cross-functional capabilities from across the globe needed for efficient delivery of clinical trials to develop impactful medicines to accelerate access to innovation for patients around the world.

We are now opening this same delivery engine to the world’s most promising external science. Through SuperHighway partnerships, highly promising assets from leading biotech partners can access our development capabilities creating a true win-win ecosystem with the ultimate goal of helping more patients around the world. This is not a fee-for-service model; it is a bold new way to grow the company and expand what’s possible in oncology. This is a rare opportunity to help build something genuinely new — joining a high-caliber, agile team at the leading edge of clinical development innovation. If you are energized by building, by challenging the status quo, and by making a real impact on patients’ lives, this is where you belong.

Accountable for global study delivery within agreed timelines and budget with appropriate inspection readiness quality for studies within our partnership programs under the Clinical SuperHighway.

Leads all aspects of assigned clinical study(ies).

Leads global cross-functional study team (including oversight of external partners) and acts as point of escalation for resolution of issues within assigned study(ies).

Ensures alignment of study goals with clinical operations and corporate goals and objectives.

Contributes to development of global tools and standards, leads the development of work instructions and SOPs as required.

This role helps deliver the partnership studies that run on our Clinical SuperHighway, supporting seamless onboarding and high-quality execution of external partner projects in close partnership with the execution functions.

Essential Functions of the Job:

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Leads the global cross-functional study team effectively, ensures effective decision making, and acts as point of escalation for resolution of study related issues.
  • Leads external vendors management involved in study delivery.
  • Builds trust and relationship with regional subject matter experts and supports the delivery of their local study objectives.
  • Collaborates with key stakeholders across the organization and provides regular updates on study progress to senior management as required.
  • Represents the study team at internal meetings and leads the cross-functional Clinical Study Team (CST) meetings.
  • Participates and presents at various topics of Clinical Study Management.
  • Participates in Clinical Operations Process improvement initiative.

Planning and Execution

  • Leads planning and management of the assigned clinical study(ies) from feasibility through closeout activities.
  • Generates, manages, maintains, and communicates high quality study timelines and tracks progress towards these.
  • Ensures that the clinical studies are operationally feasible along with Global Clinical Program Lead, oversees trial feasibility, trial allocation and site selection process across all regions.
  • Ensures timely availability of high-quality study documents to allow study submission to regulatory authorities and ECs/IRBs.
  • Provides oversight to study start up and site activation plans.
  • Ensures study plans (eg project management plan, monitoring plan, Trial Master File plan, data monitoring plan, ...) are created, updated and distributed timely and implemented appropriately.
  • Ensures study systems and tools are set up timely, correctly and are functioning properly. Ensures study level information is updated on an ongoing basis in all systems.
  • Implements RBQM end-to-end processes on time within the allocated study (e.g., periodic reviews, centralized monitoring analyses, action items).
  • Ensures relevant study specific training is developed and implemented and ensures training records are well documented and filed.

Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises. THE ROLE

We are hiring expert Belarusian transcribers to convert audio recordings of native speakers into precise, conventionally formatted written transcripts. The work powers speech recognition, dialogue, and evaluation systems for major AI labs. Audio ranges from clean studio recordings to natural conversational speech in real-world acoustic conditions.

You will be working at the level of expert linguistic judgment. This is not data entry. Decisions about orthography, code-switching, speaker attribution, disfluencies, and non-speech events shape the quality of every model trained on your output.

DIALECT AND SCOPE

Belarusian as spoken across Belarus. Project audio reflects both formal and conversational registers, with awareness of the trasyanka register where Belarusian and Russian mix.

Primary speaker regions: Minsk, Brest, Gomel, Vitebsk, Grodno, Mogilev.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Transcribe audio recordings into accurate, time-aligned written text following Perle's project-specific style guide
  • Apply correct conventions for speaker identification, overlapping speech, disfluencies, fillers, false starts, and non-speech events such as laughter, background noise, and music
  • Make principled orthographic decisions for dialectal, colloquial, and code-switched speech
  • Flag ambiguous segments, uncertain speakers, and audio quality issues using project conventions
  • Self-review every submission against Perle's quality bar before delivery
  • Engage with QA reviewers on edge cases, calibration sessions, and style guide updates

MUST HAVE

  • Native fluency in Belarusian with lifelong residence or deep immersion in Belarus
  • High accuracy reading and writing in Belarusian Cyrillic
  • Ability to distinguish Belarusian from trasyanka and from Russian in mixed audio
  • Familiarity with both the official orthography and Tarashkevitsa where relevant
  • At least two years of professional transcription, captioning, court reporting, broadcast, translation, or linguistic annotation experience
  • Demonstrated accuracy at the word level under deadline pressure
  • Comfortable with web-based annotation platforms and variable-speed audio playback
  • Reliable high-speed internet, quality headphones, and a quiet workspace
  • Ability to commit to defined volume per week during active project phases

NICE TO HAVE

  • Background in East Slavic linguistics, translation, journalism, or media
  • Prior experience annotating Belarusian or East Slavic speech data
  • Working knowledge of Russian or Ukrainian for cross-lingual audio
  • Familiarity with IPA or other phonetic transcription systems
  • Experience with verbatim versus clean-verbatim transcription conventions

HOW WE WORK WITH YOU

  • Paid pilot task before full onboarding so both sides can calibrate
  • Per-task or per-minute compensation, with rates tied to audio complexity and turnaround
  • Flexible scheduling, with volume scaling up and down based on active client projects
  • Direct working relationship with Perle's linguistic leads and QA team
  • Eligible for invitation to additional Perle expert projects across related domains

HOW TO APPLY

Apply through Winnow, Perle's job portal at winnow.perle.ai. Find the role for your language under Open Jobs, set up your candidate profile, and complete the fully automated interview, which takes about 25 minutes. We review applications within 24 hours and invite passing candidates straight to the project.

Apply here:

Perle hires experts on the basis of skill, language proficiency, and demonstrated quality. We welcome applicants from every background and every region where our target languages are spoken.

jobs.title: Expert Audio Transcriber, Afrikaans
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT PERLE Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises.
locationRestrictions: Congo, The Democratic Republic of the
Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha
jobs.description:
ABOUT PERLE

Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises. Our partners include xAI, Samsung, ELM, and Unisys. Headquartered in San Francisco with experts across more than forty markets, we specialize in the work that requires real human judgment: domain expertise, linguistic nuance, and cultural fidelity that generic data vendors cannot deliver.

Apply here:

THE ROLE

We are hiring expert Afrikaans transcribers to convert audio recordings of native speakers into precise, conventionally formatted written transcripts. The work powers speech recognition, dialogue, and evaluation systems for major AI labs. Audio ranges from clean studio recordings to natural conversational speech in real-world acoustic conditions.

You will be working at the level of expert linguistic judgment. This is not data entry. Decisions about orthography, code-switching, speaker attribution, disfluencies, and non-speech events shape the quality of every model trained on your output.

DIALECT AND SCOPE

Afrikaans, a West Germanic language derived from Dutch, spoken across South Africa and Namibia with regional varieties including Cape, Orange River, and Eastern Border Afrikaans. Project audio reflects everyday speech with code-switching to English common in urban areas.

Primary speaker regions: Cape Town, Johannesburg, Pretoria, Bloemfontein, Stellenbosch, Windhoek.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Transcribe audio recordings into accurate, time-aligned written text following Perle's project-specific style guide
  • Apply correct conventions for speaker identification, overlapping speech, disfluencies, fillers, false starts, and non-speech events such as laughter, background noise, and music
  • Make principled orthographic decisions for dialectal, colloquial, and code-switched speech
  • Flag ambiguous segments, uncertain speakers, and audio quality issues using project conventions
  • Self-review every submission against Perle's quality bar before delivery
  • Engage with QA reviewers on edge cases, calibration sessions, and style guide updates

MUST HAVE

  • Native fluency in Afrikaans with lifelong residence or deep immersion in South Africa or Namibia
  • Mastery of standard Afrikaans orthography
  • Ability to distinguish Afrikaans from Dutch in mixed audio
  • Comfortable transcribing Afrikaans-English code-switching as it occurs naturally
  • At least two years of professional transcription, captioning, court reporting, broadcast, translation, or linguistic annotation experience
  • Demonstrated accuracy at the word level under deadline pressure
  • Comfortable with web-based annotation platforms and variable-speed audio playback
  • Reliable high-speed internet, quality headphones, and a quiet workspace
  • Ability to commit to defined volume per week during active project phases

NICE TO HAVE

  • Background in Germanic linguistics, translation, journalism, or media
  • Prior experience annotating Afrikaans or Dutch speech data
  • Working knowledge of Dutch, English, or regional South African languages
  • Familiarity with IPA or other phonetic transcription systems
  • Experience with verbatim versus clean-verbatim transcription conventions

HOW WE WORK WITH YOU

  • Paid pilot task before full onboarding so both sides can calibrate
  • Per-task or per-minute compensation, with rates tied to audio complexity and turnaround
  • Flexible scheduling, with volume scaling up and down based on active client projects
  • Direct working relationship with Perle's linguistic leads and QA team
  • Eligible for invitation to additional Perle expert projects across related domains

HOW TO APPLY

Apply through Winnow, Perle's job portal at winnow.perle.ai. Find the role for your language under Open Jobs, set up your candidate profile, and complete the fully automated interview, which takes about 25 minutes. We review applications within 24 hours and invite passing candidates straight to the project.

Apply here:

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Perle hires experts on the basis of skill, language proficiency, and demonstrated quality. We welcome applicants from every background and every region where our target languages are spoken.

Technical B2C Inbound Sales Representative

Position Summary

The Technical B2C Inbound Sales Representative owns the full sales cycle for inbound B2C sellers engaging with Maxsold. From first response to closed revenue, you are responsible for qualifying, consulting, handling objections, and converting prospects into active users of the platform.

This is a revenue-generating role, not a lead-routing position. You will manage your own pipeline, drive deal progression, and create measurable revenue impact. Speed, discipline, structured thinking, and strong closing ability are critical to success.

This role is ideal for a technically minded, analytically strong sales professional who is comfortable learning software platforms, understanding customer workflows, using data to improve performance, and adapting as Maxsold continues to evolve.

Key Responsibilities

1. Full Cycle Sales Ownership

  • Respond to inbound inquiries across phone, email, SMS, and chat with urgency and professionalism.
  • Qualify prospects by identifying motivation, timeline, inventory profile, technical comfort level, and fit.
  • Conduct consultative sales conversations that position Maxsold’s model clearly and confidently.
  • Translate customer needs into clear platform value, process expectations, and next steps.
  • Advance opportunities through discovery, objection handling, and close.
  • Own the deal until activation, onboarding, or first transaction is completed.

2. Pipeline Management and Revenue Execution

  • Maintain a structured and prioritized sales pipeline within the CRM.
  • Execute disciplined follow-up sequences to maximize conversion.
  • Re-engage stalled opportunities and revive dormant leads.
  • Forecast accurately and manage activity levels to consistently meet or exceed quota.
  • Use CRM data, conversion metrics, and lead insights to improve individual sales performance.

3. Objection Handling and Value Positioning

  • Confidently address objections related to commission, pricing, process, timing, competition, and platform adoption.
  • Clearly communicate Maxsold’s marketplace advantage, revenue potential, and seller experience.
  • Guide prospects toward commitment through clear recommendations, strong discovery, and direct closing questions.
  • Explain process and platform concepts in simple, customer-friendly language.

4. Cross Functional Handoff and Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Operations, Services, Sales, and Success teams as needed to support customer activation and revenue objectives.
  • Provide structured feedback to Marketing on lead quality, messaging effectiveness, customer questions, and conversion barriers.
  • Share common objections, competitive insights, customer workflow patterns, and process improvement opportunities to improve positioning.

5. Customer Experience and Brand Representation

  • Deliver a high-quality, consultative experience across all channels.
  • Build trust quickly and represent the Maxsold brand with confidence and clarity.
  • Balance responsiveness with professionalism, precision, and accurate expectation setting.
  • Help customers feel confident using a technology-enabled selling process.

Required Skills and Qualifications

Experience

  • 2 to 5 years of experience in a full cycle sales role, ideally in marketplace, SaaS, ecommerce, technology-enabled services, or high-velocity inbound environments.
  • Proven track record of closing deals and consistently achieving or exceeding quota.
  • Experience managing an entire sales cycle independently.
  • Proficiency in CRM systems and pipeline management tools.
  • Strong comfort with spreadsheets, reporting, dashboards, productivity tools, or AI-enabled work tools is an asset.

Core Competencies

  • Strong consultative selling skills.
  • Technically curious, with the ability to learn platforms, workflows, and process details quickly.
  • Confident closer who asks directly for commitment.
  • High urgency and responsiveness, with an understanding that speed increases win rates.
  • Strong objection handling and negotiation ability.
  • Organized, analytical, and metrics-driven.
  • Comfortable using data to prioritize leads, diagnose performance gaps, and improve conversion.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, performance-oriented environment.
  • Able to explain technical or process-oriented concepts clearly to non-technical customers.
  • Curious about systems, automation, AI tools, and continuous improvement.

Education

  • A post-secondary degree is required.
  • A degree in a technical, analytical, or STEM-related field is strongly preferred, including Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Economics, Operations, or another related discipline.
  • Candidates without a traditional STEM degree may be considered if they can demonstrate strong analytical ability, technical aptitude, structured problem-solving, and experience learning complex systems.

How You Operate

  • You own revenue outcomes, not just activity volume.
  • You are disciplined in follow-up and pipeline management.
  • You ask direct qualifying questions and guide conversations with confidence.
  • You are resilient and motivated by targets.
  • You use metrics such as conversion rate, average deal size, response time, and sales cycle length to improve performance.
  • You are curious about why deals are won or lost and use that insight to improve.
  • You are comfortable learning new tools, testing better workflows, and adapting as systems evolve.
  • You take responsibility for wins and losses.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Revenue generated
  • Quota attainment
  • Lead-to-close conversion rate
  • Average deal size
  • Sales cycle length
  • Inbound response time
  • Follow-up completion rate
  • CRM hygiene and forecast accuracy
  • Activation or first transaction completion rate

The PHN works closely with the provider(s) to ensure that services are provided in the most appropriate setting by the appropriate provider(s) by performing functions of Personal Health Management as well as some functions of Utilization Management. jobs.title: Team Lead Customer Support
jobs.excerpt: Supplax — це американська компанія з українським серцем, яка вже понад 5 років активно розвивається на ринку.
jobs.description:
Supplax — це американська компанія з українським серцем, яка вже понад 5 років активно розвивається на ринку. Ми виконуємо роль віддаленого бек-офісу для майстрів у США, що спеціалізуються на ремонтних роботах. Наша команда налічує понад 100 фахівців та повністю бере на себе всі організаційні та операційні процеси, окрім самих ремонтних робіт. Серед них: маркетинг, продажі, управління командами майстрів, контроль якості, збір відгуків, навчання технічного персоналу тощо. Працюємо у 30+ найбільших містах США та вже успішно реалізували понад 30 000 ремонтних проєктів.

Детальніше про компанію ти можеш дізнатися за посиланням . Ти ознайомишся з нашою метою, критеріями, перевагами, а також відеовідгуками про роботу в Supplax від наших співробітників.

У зв’язку з активним розвитком support команди ми шукаємо Team Lead, який може не лише керувати командою, розвивати напрямок, а й впливати на конверсію виконаних угод.

Що ти отримаєш, ставши частиною Supplax:

  • Стабільний дохід в $: ставка (обговорюється) + бонуси за виконання KPI.

  • Зручний формат: 100% віддалена робота з будь-якої точки світу.

  • Можливість працювати в стабільній компанії на ринку США, яка росте та розвивається разом зі своїми людьми.

  • Повну зайнятість, графік роботи: Сб-Нд-Пн + 2 дні в будні на вибір з 16:00 - 01:00 (за Київським часом).

  • Роботу в команді, де цінують ініціативність, розвиток і відкритість до нових ідей.

  • Простір для рішень і змін без зайвої бюрократії.

  • Систему навчання, підтримки та адаптації для ефективного старту.

Що потрібно буде робити:

  • планувати та організовувати роботу команди Customer Support;

  • контролювати та аналізувати ключові KPI й метрики команди;

  • проводити 1:1, давати конструктивний зворотний зв’язок та допомагати співробітникам розвиватися;

  • навчати нових співробітників та створювати навчальні матеріали;

  • аналізувати робочі процеси, знаходити слабкі місця та пропонувати рішення для їх покращення;

  • працювати зі скриптами: аналізувати їхню ефективність та ініціювати зміни;

  • взаємодіяти з керівниками інших відділів, зокрема Sales.

Ти точно наш, якщо…

  • маєш від 1 року досвіду управління командою до 5 людей;

  • працював у Customer Support / логістиці або суміжних сервісних нішах;

  • вмієш працювати з KPI, метриками та показниками ефективності;

  • маєш досвід навчання та адаптації нових співробітників;

  • вільно спілкуєшся англійською (рівень strong В2 або C1);

  • маєш конкретні професійні досягнення, які можна виміряти результатом.

Якщо ти вмієш не просто керувати людьми, а бачити за цифрами причини проблем і знаходити рішення — будемо раді познайомитися!

Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises. THE ROLE

We are hiring expert Sudanese Arabic transcribers to convert audio recordings of native speakers into precise, conventionally formatted written transcripts. The work powers speech recognition, dialogue, and evaluation systems for major AI labs. Audio ranges from clean studio recordings to natural conversational speech in real-world acoustic conditions.

You will be working at the level of expert linguistic judgment. This is not data entry. Decisions about orthography, code-switching, speaker attribution, disfluencies, and non-speech events shape the quality of every model trained on your output.

DIALECT AND SCOPE

Sudanese Arabic as spoken across central, northern, and eastern Sudan, with phonological and lexical influences from Nubian and other regional African languages. Project audio reflects everyday Sudanese speech with distinctive vocabulary and pronunciation.

Primary speaker regions: Khartoum, Omdurman, Port Sudan, El Obeid, Kassala, Wad Madani.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Transcribe audio recordings into accurate, time-aligned written text following Perle's project-specific style guide
  • Apply correct conventions for speaker identification, overlapping speech, disfluencies, fillers, false starts, and non-speech events such as laughter, background noise, and music
  • Make principled orthographic decisions for dialectal, colloquial, and code-switched speech
  • Flag ambiguous segments, uncertain speakers, and audio quality issues using project conventions
  • Self-review every submission against Perle's quality bar before delivery
  • Engage with QA reviewers on edge cases, calibration sessions, and style guide updates

MUST HAVE

  • Native fluency in Sudanese Arabic with lifelong residence or deep immersion in Sudan
  • Strong command of Modern Standard Arabic for orthographic decisions on dialectal speech
  • Familiarity with regional variation across Sudanese-speaking governorates
  • Comfortable transcribing Sudanese vocabulary that does not appear in MSA dictionaries
  • At least two years of professional transcription, captioning, court reporting, broadcast, translation, or linguistic annotation experience
  • Demonstrated accuracy at the word level under deadline pressure
  • Comfortable with web-based annotation platforms and variable-speed audio playback
  • Reliable high-speed internet, quality headphones, and a quiet workspace
  • Ability to commit to defined volume per week during active project phases

NICE TO HAVE

  • Background in Sudanese or Nile Valley Arabic linguistics, translation, or journalism
  • Prior experience annotating African Arabic speech data
  • Working knowledge of Nubian languages or Egyptian Arabic for cross-lingual audio
  • Familiarity with IPA or other phonetic transcription systems
  • Experience with verbatim versus clean-verbatim transcription conventions

Job Description

La conception de produits chez GoTo

En rejoignant notre équipe de conception de produits, vous contribuerez à créer des expériences exceptionnelles pour des millions d’utilisateurs dans le monde entier. En collaborant avec les équipes de développement logiciel et de gestion des produits, vous donnerez vie à des idées audacieuses, en tirant parti des technologies de pointe et de l’IA pour offrir une valeur réelle et concrète et résoudre des défis significatifs pour nos clients et nos équipes. Ici, innover signifie exploiter l’IA pour créer des expériences accessibles et véritablement centrées sur l’utilisateur, du début à la fin de chaque session. Faites équipe avec nous pour redéfinir la conception intuitive et guider l’avenir des produits basés sur l’IA.

Votre quotidien

En tant que designer d’expérience utilisateur votre travail inclura les tâches suivantes:

  • Collaborer étroitement avec votre trio (les partenaires en développement et en gestion de produit) ainsi qu’avec les principales parties prenantes de l’ensemble du portefeuille.

  • Exploiter les commentaires des utilisateurs et les données pour éclairer les décisions de conception, en collaborant avec la gestion de produit pour définir l’orientation stratégique.

  • Élaborer des concepts et des solutions de conception fondés sur les besoins des utilisateurs, la vision du produit et les capacités technologiques.

  • Utiliser des outils d’IA de pointe et adopter un état d’esprit curieux à l’égard de l’IA pour expérimenter et élaborer des solutions de conception innovantes axées sur les résultats des utilisateurs.

Ce que nous recherchons

En tant que designer d’expérience utilisateur, vous devriez avoir un profil similaire au suivant:

  • Une expérience dans les marchés spécialisés, comme la santé, l’automobile, l’éducation et l’assurance, est un atout.

Ce que nous offrons

Chez GoTo, nous croyons qu’il est important de soutenir nos employés avec une gamme complète d’avantages conçus pour s’adapter à votre vie, au travail comme ailleurs. Voici seulement quelques-uns des avantages auxquels vous pouvez vous attendre en rejoignant notre équipe :

About InAir

InAir is a forward-thinking, fully remote consulting firm with a stronghold in Texas. We are proud experts in Airtable consulting services, partnering with mid-sized to large enterprises. Our mission is to harness the power of low-code platforms, enabling businesses to optimize their workflows, foster collaboration, and achieve ambitious outcomes through Airtable.

At our company, we foster a culture of honesty, responsibility, and accountability. These core values create a successful, innovative, and transparent workplace. Our remote work setting is built on trust, respect, and open communication, allowing team members to shine and grow.

The Role

We're looking for an Implementation Consultant: a builder who turns real business problems into working systems, and who can sit in front of a client and own the conversation.

You'll lead implementations end to end — from discovery sessions where you map how a client's operation actually works, to designing and delivering the Airtable system that runs it. You won't be alone: a dedicated Engineer handles custom code, and you own the what, the when, and the client relationship.

What matters most is that you've built real, working systems — in Airtable, Bubble, Notion, Zapier/Make, Retool, or whatever tool got the job done — and that you understand why a system that works for 10 records falls apart at 100,000. A formal database background is a great asset here, but it's the building track record that makes the role.

What You'll Do

  • Build: Design and deliver Airtable systems — tables, automations, and interfaces — that clients rely on to run their operations.
  • Lead discovery: Run client sessions to uncover workflows, pain points, and what "success" actually looks like. Translate business language into a system design.
  • Own delivery: Manage scope, priorities, and timelines across multiple client projects, coordinating day-to-day execution with a dedicated Engineer.
  • Improve what exists: Evaluate clients' current Airtable setups and make them cleaner, faster, and more scalable.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of building. You've shipped working systems in low-code/no-code tools that real teams used — regardless of whether your background is engineering, operations, marketing, or something else entirely.
  • Relational data fundamentals. You understand linked records, one-to-many relationships, and why structure matters for scale. Deeper database experience (SQL, ERDs, schema design) is very welcome — it's just not the entry requirement; the instincts are.
  • Business-workflow fluency. You can look at how a mid-sized or large company operates — approvals, handoffs, data flowing between teams — and quickly form a mental model of it.
  • Client presence. You're comfortable leading meetings, managing expectations, and explaining technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ownership. You thrive when you own the outcome, not just a to-do list.

Nice to Have

  • Deep Airtable experience.
  • Background in consulting, agencies, RevOps, or business operations.
  • Familiarity with the broader low-code/no-code ecosystem.
  • Experience with ClickUp.

Structure & Availability

Full-time (40 hours/week), fully remote. You'll manage a portfolio of enterprise clients, so you'll need stable, dedicated availability aligned with US business hours.

THE ROLE

We are hiring expert Urdu transcribers to convert audio recordings of native speakers into precise, conventionally formatted written transcripts. The work powers speech recognition, dialogue, and evaluation systems for major AI labs. Audio ranges from clean studio recordings to natural conversational speech in real-world acoustic conditions.

You will be working at the level of expert linguistic judgment. This is not data entry. Decisions about orthography, code-switching, speaker attribution, disfluencies, and non-speech events shape the quality of every model trained on your output.

DIALECT AND SCOPE

Standard Urdu as spoken in Pakistan and India, with natural Urdu-English code-switching common in urban speech. Project audio captures formal registers, conversational Urdu, and regional variation across the major Urdu-speaking centers.

Primary speaker regions: Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Hyderabad, Lucknow, Delhi.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Transcribe audio recordings into accurate, time-aligned written text following Perle's project-specific style guide
  • Apply correct conventions for speaker identification, overlapping speech, disfluencies, fillers, false starts, and non-speech events such as laughter, background noise, and music
  • Make principled orthographic decisions for dialectal, colloquial, and code-switched speech
  • Flag ambiguous segments, uncertain speakers, and audio quality issues using project conventions
  • Self-review every submission against Perle's quality bar before delivery
  • Engage with QA reviewers on edge cases, calibration sessions, and style guide updates

MUST HAVE

  • Native fluency in Urdu with lifelong residence or deep immersion in Pakistan or an Urdu-speaking region of India
  • High accuracy reading and writing in Nastaliq script
  • Strong ear for regional Urdu accents and willingness to transcribe them following project conventions
  • Comfortable transcribing Urdu-English code-switching with consistent script-mixing or Romanization rules
  • At least two years of professional transcription, captioning, court reporting, broadcast, translation, or linguistic annotation experience
  • Demonstrated accuracy at the word level under deadline pressure
  • Comfortable with web-based annotation platforms and variable-speed audio playback
  • Reliable high-speed internet, quality headphones, and a quiet workspace
  • Ability to commit to defined volume per week during active project phases

NICE TO HAVE

  • Background in Urdu linguistics, journalism, translation, education, or literature
  • Prior experience annotating Urdu or Indic-language speech data

  • Familiarity with IPA or other phonetic transcription systems
  • Experience with verbatim versus clean-verbatim transcription conventions

HOW WE WORK WITH YOU

  • Paid pilot task before full onboarding so both sides can calibrate
  • Per-task or per-minute compensation, with rates tied to audio complexity and turnaround
  • Flexible scheduling, with volume scaling up and down based on active client projects
  • Direct working relationship with Perle's linguistic leads and QA team
  • Eligible for invitation to additional Perle expert projects across related domains

Apply through Winnow, Perle's job portal at winnow.perle.ai. jobs.title: Expert Audio Transcriber, Sa'idi Arabic
jobs.excerpt: About Perle Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises.
jobs.description:
About Perle
Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises. Our partners include xAI, Samsung, ELM, and Unisys. Headquartered in San Francisco with experts across more than forty markets, we specialize in the work that requires real human judgment: domain expertise, linguistic nuance, and cultural fidelity that generic data vendors cannot deliver.

Apply here:

The Role
We are hiring expert Sa'idi Arabic transcribers to convert audio recordings of native speakers into precise, conventionally formatted written transcripts. The work powers speech recognition, dialogue, and evaluation systems for major AI labs. Audio ranges from clean studio recordings to natural conversational speech in real-world acoustic conditions.

You will be working at the level of expert linguistic judgment. This is not data entry. Decisions about orthography, code-switching, speaker attribution, disfluencies, and non-speech events shape the quality of every model trained on your output.

Dialect and Scope

Sa'idi Arabic as spoken in Upper Egypt, distinct from Cairene Egyptian Arabic in phonology, vocabulary, and grammar. Project audio reflects authentic rural and urban Upper Egyptian speech with characteristic features including the [g] realization in certain environments.

Primary speaker regions: Asyut, Sohag, Qena, Luxor, Aswan, Minya.

What You Will Do

  • Transcribe audio recordings into accurate, time-aligned written text following Perle's project-specific style guide
  • Apply correct conventions for speaker identification, overlapping speech, disfluencies, fillers, false starts, and non-speech events such as laughter, background noise, and music
  • Make principled orthographic decisions for dialectal, colloquial, and code-switched speech
  • Flag ambiguous segments, uncertain speakers, and audio quality issues using project conventions
  • Self-review every submission against Perle's quality bar before delivery
  • Engage with QA reviewers on edge cases, calibration sessions, and style guide updates

Must Have

  • Native fluency in Sa'idi Arabic with lifelong residence or deep immersion in Upper Egypt
  • Strong command of Modern Standard Arabic for orthographic decisions on dialectal speech
  • Ability to distinguish Sa'idi from Cairene Egyptian Arabic in transcription
  • Familiarity with regional Sa'idi variation across Upper Egyptian governorates
  • At least two years of professional transcription, captioning, court reporting, broadcast, translation, or linguistic annotation experience
  • Demonstrated accuracy at the word level under deadline pressure
  • Comfortable with web-based annotation platforms and variable-speed audio playback
  • Reliable high-speed internet, quality headphones, and a quiet workspace
  • Ability to commit to defined volume per week during active project phases

Nice To Have

  • Background in Egyptian Arabic linguistics, translation, or journalism
  • Prior experience annotating Egyptian or other Arabic speech data
  • Working knowledge of Cairene Egyptian Arabic for cross-dialect audio
  • Familiarity with IPA or other phonetic transcription systems
  • Experience with verbatim versus clean-verbatim transcription conventions

How We Work With You

  • Paid pilot task before full onboarding so both sides can calibrate
  • Per-task or per-minute compensation, with rates tied to audio complexity and turnaround
  • Flexible scheduling, with volume scaling up and down based on active client projects
  • Direct working relationship with Perle's linguistic leads and QA team
  • Eligible for invitation to additional Perle expert projects across related domains

How To Apply

Apply through Winnow, Perle's job portal at winnow.perle.ai. Find the role for your language under Open Jobs, set up your candidate profile, and complete the fully automated interview, which takes about 25 minutes. We review applications within 24 hours and invite passing candidates straight to the project.

Apply here:

Equal Opportunity

Perle hires experts on the basis of skill, language proficiency, and demonstrated quality. We welcome applicants from every background and every region where our target languages are spoken.

Job Requisition ID #

26WD98239

Position Overview

Autodesk is seeking a Senior Manager, Technical Program Management, AEC Construction to lead the TPM organization supporting AEC Construction. This senior people leader will manage managers, senior TPMs, and distinguished-level TPMs across a globally distributed team spanning North America, EMEA, and APAC. This leader will report to the Chief of Staff for AEC Construction and partner closely with Engineering, Product, platform, Trust, and enterprise stakeholders to help TPMs move beyond coordination into measurable business impact.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop a globally distributed TPM organization across North America, EMEA, and APAC, including managers, senior TPMs, and distinguished-level TPMs. Establish clear operating rhythms across regions and time zones, with a focus on team health, individual growth, clear accountability, and execution quality

  • Guide the TPM organization through adoption of generative AI and AI-enabled software delivery practices to reduce toil, improve decision quality, and scale TPM coverage and effectiveness

  • Own TPM portfolio governance across AEC Construction, including request intake, prioritization, assignment, capacity management, resource tradeoffs, and alignment to strategic business priorities

  • Oversee TPM engagement across product delivery, enterprise transformation, and platform/infrastructure initiatives, ensuring programs have clear ownership, decision paths, risks, mitigations, and measurable outcomes

  • Partner with senior Engineering, Product, platform, Trust, PSET, ESE, and AEC Trust stakeholders to align priorities, manage dependencies, resolve escalations, and ensure TPM work is focused on business value

  • Define and track metrics that demonstrate TPM impact, improve intake and reporting mechanisms, and evolve TPM practices so the team operates as a strategic execution function rather than a coordination layer

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or higher degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or related fields

  • At least 15 years in technical program management within software or construction sectors, including 5+ years in a leadership role managing diverse teams

  • Exceptional leadership and communication skills with a proven ability to resolve conflicts and build high-performing teams

Aperçu du poste

Autodesk est à la recherche d’un(e) gestionnaire principal(e), gestion de programmes techniques (TPM), Construction AEC, pour diriger l’organisation TPM soutenant le secteur de la construction AEC. Ce poste de direction senior supervisera des gestionnaires, des TPM seniors et des TPM de niveau distingué au sein d’une équipe distribuée à l’échelle mondiale couvrant l’Amérique du Nord, l’EMEA et l’APAC.

La personne titulaire du poste sera responsable d’accroître l’impact des TPM dans les domaines de la livraison de produits, de la transformation organisationnelle et des programmes de plateformes/infrastructures; d’améliorer la gouvernance du portefeuille, la priorisation, la gestion des risques et les résultats de livraison; ainsi que d’aider l’organisation à adopter des méthodes de travail appuyées par l’IA tout au long du cycle de développement logiciel.

Cette personne relèvera du chef de cabinet (Chief of Staff) de l’organisation Construction AEC et travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d’ingénierie, de produit, de plateformes, de confiance (Trust) et les parties prenantes de l’entreprise afin d’aider les TPM à aller au-delà de la coordination pour générer un impact commercial mesurable.

Responsabilités

  • Diriger et développer une organisation TPM distribuée mondialement à travers l’Amérique du Nord, l’EMEA et l’APAC, comprenant des gestionnaires, des TPM seniors et des TPM de niveau distingué. Établir des cadences opérationnelles claires entre les régions et fuseaux horaires, avec un accent sur la santé de l’équipe, le développement individuel, l’imputabilité claire et la qualité d’exécution.

  • Guider l’organisation TPM dans l’adoption de l’IA générative et des pratiques de livraison logicielle assistées par l’IA afin de réduire les tâches répétitives, améliorer la qualité des décisions et accroître la portée et l’efficacité des TPM.

  • Assurer la gouvernance du portefeuille TPM pour l’organisation Construction AEC, y compris la gestion des demandes, la priorisation, l’attribution des ressources, la gestion de la capacité, les arbitrages de ressources et l’alignement avec les priorités stratégiques de l’entreprise.

  • Superviser l’implication des TPM dans les initiatives de livraison de produits, de transformation organisationnelle et de plateformes/infrastructures, en veillant à ce que les programmes disposent d’une responsabilité claire, de processus décisionnels définis, de risques identifiés, de plans d’atténuation et de résultats mesurables.

  • Collaborer avec les parties prenantes senior des équipes d’ingénierie, de produit, de plateformes, de Trust, de PSET, d’ESE et d’AEC Trust afin d’aligner les priorités, gérer les dépendances, résoudre les escalades et s’assurer que le travail des TPM demeure axé sur la valeur d’affaires.

  • Définir et suivre des indicateurs démontrant l’impact des TPM, améliorer les mécanismes de réception des demandes et de production de rapports, et faire évoluer les pratiques TPM afin que l’équipe fonctionne comme une fonction stratégique d’exécution plutôt qu’une simple couche de coordination.

  • Excellentes aptitudes en leadership et en communication, avec une capacité démontrée à résoudre les conflits et à bâtir des équipes hautement performantes.

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!
