jobs.description:
Senior Kotlin / KMP EngineerDesktop · Real-time · Ukrainian MilTech partner (GCF)

Наш партнер — український MilTech-стартап, що розробляє програмні рішення для перехоплення ворожих дронів. Місія — створювати технології, які захищають наше небо. Продукт — десктопний застосунок для наведення дронів-перехоплювачів: працює локально, в реальному часі, обробляє дані з радарів та інших сенсорів, стійкий до нестабільного/офлайн зв'язку.

Чому ця роль має місце зараз
Команда масштабується. Один з Senior Kotlin/KMP інженерів уже тримає значну частину складних архітектурних і real-time задач. Тепер, ми шукаємо другого сильного інженера-власника (не заступника і не Lead), який самостійно проєктує, реалізує і доводить до production складні ділянки продукту — і знімає залежність команди від однієї людини.

Технологічний стек
Kotlin Multiplatform, Compose Multiplatform, Decompose, Koin
Coroutines / Flow, структурована конкурентність
SQLDelight, Ktor
MAVLink
WorldWind — плюс, не вимога.

Що ви робитимете
Самостійно берете складну ділянку продукту (real-time потік, інтеграція, продуктивність або порівнянний за складністю архітектурний скоуп) від проблеми до production-релізу;
Приймаєте і документуєте архітектурні рішення (trade-offs, ADR де доречно);
Працюєте з даними реального часу: latency, reconnection, back-pressure, офлайн/retry-сценарії.
Розвиваєте UI на Compose Multiplatform і модульну архітектуру спільного коду;
За можливості та відповідно до security policy прагматично використовуєте AI/coding tools для прискорення роботи — з обов'язковою перевіркою та розумінням результату;
Працюєте в парі з іншим Senior-інженером команди: ділите скоуп, даєте і приймаєте рев'ю, без конкуренції за території.

Must-have
Сильний інженерний бекграунд і здатність самостійно занурюватись у складні предметні області — не лише знання Android API, фокус на Desktop;
Глибокий комерційний Kotlin: Coroutines/Flow, структурована конкурентність, cancellation — фундаментальне розуміння;
Production Kotlin Multiplatform досвід (production-реліз або серйозний, доведений PoC — точний поріг уточнюється, курси окремо не рахуються);
Production Compose for Desktop на Windows/Linux (або серйозний доведений PoC): білди/дистрибуція, Gradle targets, розуміння відмінностей desktop vs Android. macOS — плюс;
Архітектура/системний дизайн: модульність, спільний код, навігація/стан (Decompose або порівнянний підхід), Ktor/WebSockets, SQLDelight, явні trade-offs;
Ownership до production: самостійно приймає рішення, відповідає за наслідки, доводить фічу від нечіткої проблеми до релізу;
Продуктове мислення: розуміє кінцевого користувача, time-to-value, може здорово оскаржити "спеку" (читаємо-специфікацію)), якщо є простіше рішення з тим самим результатом;
Швидке навчання нового домену/стеку з власної ініціативи — темп ramp-up очікується високий;
Безпека/відповідальність/OPSEC: дисципліноване поводження з даними, логами, скріншотами; мінімум зайвого публічного розголошення.

Буде плюсом
Досвід з дронами на ArduPilot, MAVLink (heartbeat/sequence/message-rate, fail-safe, reconnect).
Досвід з радарними даними або даними інших сенсорів через стандартизовані протоколи.
Карти/GIS/геодані/трекінг; WorldWind — плюс, не вимога.
Досвід менторства, код-рев'ю, технічного ownership — це зона можливого зростання для цієї ролі, не стартова вимога.

Ми цінуємо
Відкритість і чесність у комунікації: «я не знаю, як це зробити» цінується вище за вдавану впевненість)
Ownership до кінця — доводить функціонал до готового стану і сам підіймає ризики.
Роботу в парі/командну роботу: ділиться контекстом, спокійно приймає рев'ю, не конкурує за території.
Прагматичне ставлення до AI-інструментів: прискорює роботу, перевіряє і розуміє результат, може захистити кожне важливе технічне рішення.
Темп і фокус на пріоритетах навіть за високої невизначеності.

Формат і умови
Full-time, віддалено, Україна (буде перевагою); синхронна робота в українських робочих годинах.
Робочий ноутбук від компанії.
Можливі періодичні офлайн-зустрічі/польові демо.
2–3 сінки/тиждень на ramp-up; buddy — інший Senior-інженер команди.
Контракт: ФОП 3 група. За потреби — можливе бронювання.
Компенсація для Senior-рівня: €4 000–5 000 gross / місяць; для Staff/Principal рівень і вилка калібруються окремо до офера.

Процес відбору
1. Скринінг із Lead TA (45–60 хв). Узгоджуємо мотивацію, релевантність досвіду Kotlin/KMP, очікування щодо ролі та формату співпраці.
2. Технічна співбесіда з наймаючими менеджерами - Ростиславом і Броніславом (60–90 хв). Обговорюємо системний дизайн і архітектурні підходи, real-time/офлайн-сценарії, практики якості; за потреби — коротка симуляція (~10 хв).
3. Фінальна співбесіда зі Стейкхолдерами (60–90 хв).
Фокус — цінності, відкрита комунікація, ownership і готовність працювати в місійному defense-контексті.
4. Перевірка бекграунду (за вашою згодою і узгодженим флоу).
Референси та базова верифікація інформації.
5. Офер і підсумкове узгодження з Lead TA.
Обговорюємо фінальні умови, дату старту та кроки онбордингу.

Без тестового завдання; за потреби — коротка симуляція (~10 хв) на технічному етапі.
Фідбек протягом 24 годин після кожного етапу.

Як податись

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer (UI/UX)
jobs.excerpt: SR.  PRODUCT DESIGNER (UI/UX) - SEEKING Product | Full-Time, Salaried | Reports to Head of Product We are not hiring another UI designer.
jobs.description:
SR. PRODUCT DESIGNER (UI/UX) - SEEKING

Product | Full-Time, Salaried | Reports to Head of Product

We are not hiring another UI designer. We are hiring the designer who will change how our members see, think about, and act on the information we put in front of them.

Company Seeking.com (Reflex Media)

Location Remote, anywhere in the USA

Compensation $80,000 to $170,000 base

Travel Required for team weeks, user research, and quarterly planning in Las Vegas

About the Role

Seeking.com is the world's largest premium dating platform, founded and led by an MIT alumnus and headquartered in Las Vegas. We work at the intersection of technology, consumer psychology, and product design at the highest level. Our mission is to help people foster genuine relationships and find love, and to rethink how social platforms can advance human connection.

We are hiring the Product Designer who is going to help us design the next generation of Seeking, and we are looking for a specific kind of designer. Not the designer who makes screens prettier. The designer who changes what a screen is for. We want someone who will rethink how we present information to our members so they can make better decisions, and faster ones: who to talk to, who to trust, what to say, when to act, when to hold back.

You will own the end-to-end design of the Seeking core experience across web and native mobile: onboarding, discovery, matching, messaging, profile, and subscription surfaces. You will be a true partner to the Product Manager, sharing the load on research, prototyping, spec, and instrumentation, and you will hold the visual and interaction bar for the whole platform.

This role is open at two levels: Product Designer and Sr. Product Designer. Level and placement in the salary band are determined by depth of shipping history, ownership scope, and demonstrated impact on real customers. The role is the same shape at both levels; the Sr. level carries broader scope, more autonomy, and higher expectations on systems thinking and mentorship.

This role may also be a fit for candidates whose current title is Product Designer, Sr. Product Designer, UX Designer, Interaction Designer, UX Architect, Design Engineer, Founding Designer, Staff Designer, or IC Design Lead. If your day-to-day is designing and shipping products that move real customer outcomes, you should apply regardless of title. If your idea of design ends at pixels and Figma comments, do not apply. If you think about design as a decision-making tool and can point to work that has changed how real users understand or act on information, keep reading.

What You'll Own

Information Design & Decision Support

  • Rethink how information is presented on Seeking so members can make better decisions and faster decisions. Every screen is an argument for what the member should do next; you own the argument.
  • Design for cognitive load. Decide what to show, what to hide, and what to defer. Kill decoration that costs comprehension.
  • Turn raw signal (profile data, verification state, activity, compatibility signals) into interfaces members can read at a glance.

End-to-End Product Design

  • Own the design of the Seeking core experience across web and native iOS and Android: onboarding, discovery, matching, messaging, profile, and subscription surfaces.
  • Move from insight to prototype to production. Wireframes, flows, interaction specs, high-fidelity design, and design QA at ship.
  • Set and evolve the design system so the platform reads as one product, not five.

Research, Prototype, Validate

  • Conduct or co-lead user research with the PM. Sit in on interviews, watch session recordings, read the tickets.
  • Prototype in Figma, Framer, or code (v0, Lovable, Cursor) to test ideas with real members before an engineer touches them.
  • Plan and run usability testing on the flows you own, and instrument the metrics that will tell you whether the design actually helped.

Agentic Operating Model

  • Use Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, and comparable tools every day to accelerate exploration, ideation, and production.
  • Build and refine agent workflows that take work off your plate and let you produce at scale on your own.
  • Contribute to a growing internal playbook so the whole design and product team compounds.

Required Qualifications (Both Levels)

  • A portfolio of shipped consumer product work with real users and referenceable outcomes. If your case studies do not name the metric your design moved and by how much, this is not the role for you.
  • A demonstrated point of view on information design. Not "here is a nicer version": "here is why the old version made the member think about the wrong thing."
  • Demonstrated ability to do the work, not just direct it. Recent design work where you personally drove the research, the flow, the prototype, and the design QA.
  • Expert Figma. Component systems, auto-layout, prototyping, tokens, and multi-file library management.
  • Fluency in modern prototyping tools that put working software in front of a user in hours, not weeks (Framer, v0, Lovable, Cursor, Replit, or comparable).
  • Daily, fluent use of agentic AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, Midjourney, MCP-based workflows, or comparable). You will be asked to demonstrate this in the interview.
  • Technical fluency. You read code, understand HTML, CSS, and component-based frontend, and can spec responsive and native behavior clearly.
  • Hands-on fluency with product analytics (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Firebase, or comparable), session recording tools, and A/B testing. You measure whether your work worked.
  • Systems thinking. You see the user motivation, the data event, the downstream retention impact, and three ways the same problem could be solved better.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication. You can defend a design decision to the CEO with the same conviction you can defend it to an engineer.

Level & Experience

Product Designer

  • Two to four years of product design experience, ideally in consumer B2C, mobile, or subscription businesses.
  • At least one feature or flow you personally designed end-to-end from concept through launch, with a measurable customer outcome you can quote.
  • Rising-star trajectory. You have been promoted quickly, taken on scope beyond your title, or shipped work that outpaces peers with more experience.
  • Comfortable owning a defined surface with mentorship from the Sr. Designer, PM, and Head of Product.

Sr. Product Designer

  • Five or more years of product design experience, with meaningful time as a Sr. Designer, Staff Designer, Founding Designer, or IC Design Lead. Title-flexible, output-strict.
  • Multiple shipped products or features you owned end-to-end, with measurable outcomes you can quote.
  • Owns both craft and direction. Sets the visual and interaction bar, drives design decisions across surfaces, and can defend a call to the Head of Product and CEO.
  • Comfortable being a mentor and reviewer for other designers as the design function scales.

Preferred Qualifications (Both Levels)

  • Prior work in dating, social, marketplace, subscription, or other consumer-focused product categories where engagement and retention are the primary levers.
  • Front-end fluency (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) sufficient to ship small changes yourself or to prototype in code.
  • Background in information architecture, data visualization, editorial design, or human-computer interaction.
  • Experience setting up local agent environments (custom orchestration, self-hosted MCP servers).
  • Public work we can see: portfolio, prototypes, case studies, Dribbble/Behance/personal site, or an agent toolkit you have shared.
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in design, human-computer interaction, or a related field. Not required. We value the work over the credential, but credentials help when the work is also there.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base salary: $80,000 to $170,000, commensurate with experience and level. The lower half of the band anchors the Product Designer level; the upper half anchors the Sr. Product Designer level.
  • Full-time, salaried, fully remote within the US. Strong preference for candidates open to relocating to Las Vegas, NV.
  • 99% coverage of our medical base plan, dental, and vision insurance. 65% coverage for qualified dependents. 100% coverage of short-term disability, long-term disability, and life insurance for qualified employees. 50% 401(k) match up to 6% per month. Flexible Spending Account. Flexible paid time off.
  • Direct exposure to the CEO from day one, and a clear growth path as design scope expands.

Bonus: include links. Case studies, prototypes, a Loom walking us through a project, an agent setup you have shared publicly. Anything that lets us see how you operate.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Reflex Media is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We strictly prohibit discrimination of any kind. Candidates are encouraged to apply for qualified positions regardless of race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristics as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Reflex Media's hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and the needs of the company. All offers of employment are contingent upon the completion of a full background and reference check.

jobs.description:
About Cardlytics
Founded in 2008, Cardlytics (NASDAQ: CDLX) is the industry-leading purchase intelligence and incentives platform. We make commerce smarter and more rewarding for everyone by helping businesses attract, understand, and incentivize consumers through our partners' digital reward programs. Join us on our mission to make commerce smarter and more rewarding for everyone!

About the Position

Cardlytics is looking for a Head of Security & IT to lead the team responsible for protecting and operating the technology that runs our business. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will set strategy and represent the program to executives, our board, and bank partners like Chase and Wells Fargo, while staying close enough to the work to step in when needed. You will lead a team of five covering security engineering, IT engineering, network engineering, security compliance, and end-user support, our identity and access management program, and the resilience of our AWS-hosted production environment.

Cardlytics is subject to strict compliance oversight from public-company (SOX) requirements and publishing partners (including major financial institutions). This role exists to make sure security and IT are never the reason the business slows down — and increasingly, to make sure the company is using AI to work faster and smarter.

You'll have real executive visibility — direct partnership with the CTO, exposure to the board, and a seat at the table on how Cardlytics adopts AI company-wide. It's a lean, high-trust team where your judgment matters more than process for process's sake, and where leadership is actively investing in modernizing how the function operates.

You Will:

  • Security & Compliance Leadership — own the SOX/SOC 2 control environment for engineering and GUARD (our internal security/compliance program); serve as the primary point of contact for external auditors, internal audit, and third-party risk assessments from bank partners.

  • Identity & Access Management — oversee and improve the identity and access management program across Google Workspace, Okta, and ConductorOne; ensure least-privilege access is enforced and evidenced for audit.

  • Cloud & Product Security — maintain the cloud security baseline across our 100% AWS production environment (EKS, Lambda, Terraform, GitHub Actions); partner with Engineering to triage and remediate findings surfaced through Wiz and Expel (our MDR provider covering CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Wiz Defend, SentinelOne, and Databricks).

  • Company-Wide AI Enablement — act as an internal champion for AI adoption beyond engineering — helping non-technical teams identify safe, effective use cases, and modeling how the security/IT function itself uses AI to move faster (e.g., in compliance evidence-gathering, access reviews, and incident response).

  • IT Operations — ensure reliable, secure device management for a hybrid Windows/macOS remote workforce, a healthy BYOD mobile posture, and responsive IT help desk support company-wide.

  • Certificate & Infrastructure Hygiene — ensure SSL/TLS certificate renewal, network resilience, and general network hygiene practices are proactive, not reactive.

  • Team Leadership — manage and develop a 5-person team; set priorities, review work, and be capable of personally covering any team function during absences.

  • Executive Partnership — work closely with the CTO to align security/IT priorities with business strategy; communicate risk and program status clearly to non-technical executives and the board.

You Have:

  • 8+ years in security and/or IT leadership, including 3+ years managing a team directly.

  • Deep, hands-on background in at least two of: security engineering, security architecture, identity & access management, or vulnerability management — you can read technical output and challenge it, even if you're not writing production code day to day.

  • Direct experience owning or heavily supporting SOX and/or SOC 2 compliance programs, including working with external auditors.

  • Experience with modern IAM tooling (Okta, Google Workspace, or similar) and cloud security platforms (Wiz or comparable CNAPP/CSPM).

  • Comfort operating in a fully remote, lean-team environment where you'll rely upon managed/third-party providers rather than building everything in-house.

  • Working knowledge of AWS and IaC concepts (Terraform) sufficient to have informed conversations with engineering — you don't need to write it yourself.

  • Executive-level communication skills: able to translate technical risk into business terms for a CTO, board, and bank auditors.

  • Genuine enthusiasm for applying AI tools to security, IT, and compliance workflows — and for helping non-technical teams do the same.

  • Experience in fintech, adtech, or another environment with heavy third-party/bank compliance scrutiny— valued, not required.

  • Familiarity with Databricks, EKS, or MDR/managed-SOC relationships (e.g., Expel or similar)— valued, not required..

  • A security or compliance certification (CISSP, CISM, or equivalent) — valued, not required.

Technical Environment

We primarily use macOS and Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides). While our preferred platform is macOS, we support both macOS and Windows. Familiarity with or willingness to work within this environment is required.

Core Values

Our shared values are the driving force behind everything we do. Across all roles, we are looking for teammates who embody these values:

  • Customer and partner first

  • Act with urgency and focus

  • Integrity with our partners and data

  • Accountability even when challenged

  • Empowerment over hierarchy

  • Growth over comfort

Benefits and Perks

  • Flexible paid time off plus company holidays

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance begins on your first day

  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match, plan also includes a student loan debt repayment option

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

  • Educational assistance for continuing education

  • Lifestyle Spending Account for physical, emotional, and financial wellness (like gym memberships, home down payments, art classes, park passes, and more!)

  • Complimentary Calm app subscriptions to support employee mental health and wellbeing

As an equal opportunity employer, Cardlytics is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our people bring our products and organization to life, and every unique perspective makes us better. If you can do the job and you’re excited about growing with us as we scale our best-in-class advertising platform, we’d love to hear from you. If you need accommodation in the recruiting process due to a disability, please email or inform your recruiter.

Are you passionate about building the data foundations that power modern AI systems?

This is not a traditional analytics-focused data engineering role. You'll work closely with AI, platform, and infrastructure teams to build the pipelines, data products, and integration layers that allow autonomous agents to securely access and use enterprise data in production.

If you're excited about combining modern data engineering with Agentic AI, cloud platforms, and large-scale systems, we'd love to hear from you.

Note: This role is limited to candidates based in LATAM. Candidates from other locations will not be considered for this role.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain scalable batch and streaming data pipelines that ingest and transform data from applications, databases, APIs, event streams, and third-party systems.

What We're Looking For

Data Engineering Foundations

  • 4+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Backend Engineering, or a related field.

  • Experience building and operating production data pipelines.
  • Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Microsoft Fabric, or similar.

Agentic AI Experience

Platform Engineering & Operations

Collaboration & Ways of Working

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced Agile (Kanban) environment.

ITX’s Compensation Philosophy

Equality in compensation has been our practice since ITX started in 1997.

At ITX, you’ll never discover that someone in the same job with the same experience makes more than you, or that there are pay gaps based on race, gender, disability, or age.

How do our team members experience market-based pay at ITX? We gather market data to benchmark each position in our candidates’ and team members’ locations and use these benchmarks for candidate offers and to perform regular compensation reviews for our team members. You’ll never have to worry about asking for a pay raise again. At least once a year ITX automatically adjusts pay when the benchmark is higher than our team member’s compensation.

In LATAM the pay range for theSenior Software Engineer (Data Platforms & AI Tooling)role is $5,400 to $7,900 monthly, depending on experience, specific skills and certifications, and education. Based on your location in LATAM pay ranges could be adjusted according to local market data, which can vary from country to country. This variation percentage could be 16% lower or 14% higher.

Do you have questions about ITX’s compensation practices? Let us know! We’re proud of how we do compensation at ITX and welcome the opportunity to share more.

About The Sales Factory

At The Sales Factory, we’re building the future of B2B sales! We partner with high-growth companies to help them connect with their ideal customers and build revenue pipelines that drive real results.
We’re proud to be ranked #2 in the world for outsourced sales (out of 160 companies globally) and we’re just getting started. Our clients include some of the largest tech, banking, and manufacturing companies in the world, and we have ranked on the Fastest Growing Companies list three years in a row.
Since our founding in 2018, we’ve grown into an award-winning, global team supporting some of the fastest-growing tech companies in the world. Our secret? A mix of data-driven strategy, cutting-edge AI technology, and a team of curious, motivated people who love to learn.
We’re a remote-first company, hiring across North America. Work wherever you’re happiest (as long as you’ve got strong Wi-Fi).

The Opportunity

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you’ll be at the front lines of growth — identifying potential customers, sparking conversations, and setting up meetings for our clients’ sales teams
.You don’t need to be a sales expert (yet). We’ll teach you everything you need to know through hands-on training and real-time coaching. This is the perfect place to kickstart your career in tech sales!

Training

  • You’ll go through comprehensive sales training that includes:
  • How to cold call, write compelling outreach messages, and qualify opportunities.
  • How to use modern sales tools (like CRMs and sales engagement platforms).
  • How to think strategically about business development and lead generation.
  • Ongoing mentorship, feedback, and opportunities to advance.
  • We’ll help you build a strong foundation for a long-term career in sales!

What You Bring To The Table

  • A growth mindset — you’re curious, coachable, and eager to learn.
  • Strong communication skills, you’re comfortable talking to people and building rapport quickly.
  • A self-starter attitude, you take initiative and enjoy solving problems.
  • Interest in technology, business, and sales — you want to understand how companies grow.
  • Post-secondary education.
  • No prior sales experience required, just a drive to succeed and a willingness to learn.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + performance bonuses
  • 100% remote, flexible work environment
  • Comprehensive employer-sponsored health benefits
  • Paid time off and flexible hours
  • Ongoing professional development and learning opportunities
  • A team culture built on growth, connection, and fun!

What You'll Do

  • Research and identify potential leads who fit our clients’ target markets
  • Reach out to prospects through email, phone, and LinkedIn to start meaningful conversations. Engage with both English- and French-speaking prospects across multiple markets.
  • Qualify leads and schedule meetings or demos for our clients’ Account Executives.
  • Learn to use industry-leading sales tools and CRMs.
  • Collaborate with your team to test new messaging, refine strategies, and celebrate wins together.
  • Bring energy, curiosity, and a positive attitude to every day — because we’re all about learning and improving.

Language Requirements

  • Professional fluency in English is required.
  • Fluency in French is strongly preferred. Preference will be given to fully bilingual candidates, as this role involves regular outreach and communication with Quebecois French-speaking prospects and clients, particularly in Quebec and Eastern Canada.
Thank you for considering a career with us. We can't wait to review your application!

jobs.description:
Role Summary

Nuuly is searching for a Senior AI Engineer to help build and evolve the AI-powered development harness our Product, UX, and Engineering teams use to move from initiative through design and into implementation. This role owns the harness spanning product definition, UX, design, coding and testing—the skills, templates, schemas, and gate logic that keep AI-assisted work traceable, consistent, and reliable as it hands off between teams and into engineering.

You'll design and maintain the agent instructions, validators, and lifecycle rules that power this system, partner with an AI Enablement Lead and engineering stakeholders on shared standards, and help the harness improve itself over time through structured feedback and output scoring. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who wants to build the tooling and process infrastructure behind applied AI, not just use AI coding assistants day to day.

Role Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain the artifact lifecycle system that governs how work moves between AI-assisted stages
  • Design schemas and traceability standards connecting requirements, use cases, and implementation
  • Author and maintain AI agent instructions and skills — not casual use of AI coding tools, but genuine prompt/agent design
  • Design, build, and deploy AI agents that automate or support steps in the development lifecycle
  • Write automation (Python/Bash) that enforces schema and quality gates across the system
  • Measure and score AI output quality against real usage, and build feedback loops so the system improves over time
  • Partner with Product, UX, and Engineering stakeholders on shared standards and handoffs

Role Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience building production software or internal platforms (APIs, workflow engines, developer tooling, or automation systems)
  • Hands-on experience designing agent instructions, prompt systems, or LLM-backed workflows
  • Experience with spec-driven or artifact-lifecycle systems with AI integrated into the development lifecycle
  • Experience building and deploying AI agents in production, including agent architectures and orchestration patterns
  • Interest in quality discipline: testing, rubrics, evaluation datasets, LLM-as-judge approaches, and observability for AI workflows
  • Experience designing structured data contracts (JSON Schema, YAML, or similar)
  • Comfort partnering with Product, UX, and engineering stakeholders; ability to translate between domain experts and technical constraints
  • Enthusiasm for exploring emerging AI capabilities, platforms, tooling, and techniques
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with an ability to explain complex AI concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Familiarity with multiple agentic coding platforms and cloud agent platforms (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini)
  • Strong scripting and automation ability in Python
  • Hands-on experience with agent development kits and agent platforms (e.g., Claude Agent SDK, Google ADK, LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI)
  • Git literacy: branching, PR workflows, coordinating cross-repo changes
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar automation platforms
  • Ability to build and operate agentic or automation integrations with project management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Monday)
  • Familiarity with tool-integration protocols for connecting agents to external systems (e.g., MCP, CLI-based tooling)

The Perks

URBN offers comprehensive Perks & Benefits to employees. Availability and eligibility to specific benefits may be subject to your location and employment status. Benefits include medical, dental, vision, PTO, generous employee discounts, retirement savings and much more! For additional information visit www.urbn.com/work-with-us/benefits

jobs.title: Expert Audio Transcriber, Bulgarian
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT PERLE Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises.
jobs.description:
ABOUT PERLE

Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises. Our partners include xAI, Samsung, ELM, and Unisys. Headquartered in San Francisco with experts across more than forty markets, we specialize in the work that requires real human judgment: domain expertise, linguistic nuance, and cultural fidelity that generic data vendors cannot deliver.

Apply here:

THE ROLE

We are hiring expert Bulgarian transcribers to convert audio recordings of native speakers into precise, conventionally formatted written transcripts. The work powers speech recognition, dialogue, and evaluation systems for major AI labs. Audio ranges from clean studio recordings to natural conversational speech in real-world acoustic conditions.

You will be working at the level of expert linguistic judgment. This is not data entry. Decisions about orthography, code-switching, speaker attribution, disfluencies, and non-speech events shape the quality of every model trained on your output.

DIALECT AND SCOPE

Standard Bulgarian and its regional dialects (Western and Eastern). Project audio includes formal and conversational registers in Cyrillic script with awareness of distinctions from Macedonian.

Primary speaker regions: Sofia, Plovdiv, Varna, Burgas, Ruse, Stara Zagora.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Transcribe audio recordings into accurate, time-aligned written text following Perle's project-specific style guide
  • Apply correct conventions for speaker identification, overlapping speech, disfluencies, fillers, false starts, and non-speech events such as laughter, background noise, and music
  • Make principled orthographic decisions for dialectal, colloquial, and code-switched speech
  • Flag ambiguous segments, uncertain speakers, and audio quality issues using project conventions
  • Self-review every submission against Perle's quality bar before delivery
  • Engage with QA reviewers on edge cases, calibration sessions, and style guide updates

MUST HAVE

  • Native fluency in Bulgarian with lifelong residence or deep immersion in Bulgaria
  • Mastery of Bulgarian Cyrillic orthography
  • Ability to distinguish Bulgarian from Macedonian and Serbian in mixed audio
  • Strong ear for Western and Eastern Bulgarian regional accents
  • At least two years of professional transcription, captioning, court reporting, broadcast, translation, or linguistic annotation experience
  • Demonstrated accuracy at the word level under deadline pressure
  • Comfortable with web-based annotation platforms and variable-speed audio playback
  • Reliable high-speed internet, quality headphones, and a quiet workspace
  • Ability to commit to defined volume per week during active project phases

NICE TO HAVE

  • Background in South Slavic linguistics, translation, journalism, or media
  • Prior experience annotating Bulgarian or neighboring Slavic speech data
  • Working knowledge of Macedonian, Russian, or Turkish for cross-lingual audio
  • Familiarity with IPA or other phonetic transcription systems
  • Experience with verbatim versus clean-verbatim transcription conventions

HOW WE WORK WITH YOU

  • Paid pilot task before full onboarding so both sides can calibrate
  • Per-task or per-minute compensation, with rates tied to audio complexity and turnaround
  • Flexible scheduling, with volume scaling up and down based on active client projects
  • Direct working relationship with Perle's linguistic leads and QA team
  • Eligible for invitation to additional Perle expert projects across related domains

HOW TO APPLY

Apply through Winnow, Perle's job portal at winnow.perle.ai. Find the role for your language under Open Jobs, set up your candidate profile, and complete the fully automated interview, which takes about 25 minutes. We review applications within 24 hours and invite passing candidates straight to the project.

Apply here:

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Perle hires experts on the basis of skill, language proficiency, and demonstrated quality. We welcome applicants from every background and every region where our target languages are spoken.

Why This Role Matters:

The hardest problem in operations data isn't producing the insight; it's the last mile: the gap between an insight existing and the operation acting on it. That gap closes only when someone inside operations owns the problem and the outcome, not just the analysis. This is that person. You bring the operational fluency, the relationships, and the judgment to turn data and AI capability into changes that show up in how the contact center and back-office run, while a central data and engineering team handles the build. You frame the problem and own whether it lands; they own production. Both names on the work, never thrown over a wall.

How You’ll Contribute:

What you Own

  • The portfolio. Translate the operations strategy into a prioritized set of the problems most worth solving with data, analytics, and AI. Separate a structural opportunity from quick win noise and own the call on what's worth doing.
  • The interpretation. Turn data into a narrative that changes a specific decision. Be the point of insight operations leadership turns to and hold your ground when the data contradicts the plan.
  • The last mile. Drive insight into the real workflow and the moment of decision; you own whether it gets adopted, not just whether it gets delivered.
  • The hand-off. Qualify what's worth putting into the build queue, write the specs that make a hand-off succeed (clear definitions, the rules a shared data dependency must hold, and what “done" means), and judge whether what comes back is right.
  • The AI agenda for ops data. As more of the work involves AI, help shape and qualify where it’s worth applying, and represent operations in how those capabilities get used and governed.
  • Success is measured on outcomes, not output- Decisions are changed and value is realized in the operation.
  • The right problems - the most important data problems are the ones being worked, in priority order.
  • Adoption – insight is embedded in real workflows and trusted by the people making the calls
  • Partnership health – use cases are co-owned with the central data team and land cleanly, with no work thrown over the wall. One operational decision changed for the better is the job working

What We’re Looking For:

  • 8+ years in a data product owner, analytics, or data-SME role, with a track record of data work that changed a business outcome, not just reports delivered.
  • Real fluency with operational data and reporting; you can read a messy data landscape and say what matters.
  • Analytical judgment: you can interrogate data and models critically and interpret them soundly without needing to build them yourself.
  • Comfortable partnering with a central data organization without turf friction; ideally, you’ve sat as the embedded data owner next to a central data team before.
  • Communication and influence: you turn analysis into decisions, earn the trust of senior stakeholders, and can hold a point of view, including an unpopular one.
  • Applied AI fluency: conversant in what AI and agentic capability can and can't do, and where it’s worth applying.
  • Working knowledge of the modern data stack (Snowflake and the tooling around it) so you can speak the builders' language.
  • Intellectual curiosity: you ask why the data looks the way it does, dig into discrepancies, and keep learning.
  • How you work with people matters as much as what you know: empathy and the instinct to read the room; you give feedback as a question and take it without ego; you stay flexible when plans shift, because they always

Preferred:

  • Insurance, financial services, or other regulated-industry background
  • Contact center or operations domain experience (Amazon Connect, Snowflake-based analytics
  • Hands-on experience defining dashboards or data products that teams use

Compensation: 

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets. The base pay for this position ranges from $130,000/year in our lowest geographic market up to $160,000/year plus bonus in our highest geographic market. Pay is based on a number of factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Employees who meet benefit eligibility guidelines and work 30 hours or more weekly, have the ability to enroll in Group 1001’s benefits package. Employees (and their families) are eligible to participate in the Company’s comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plan options. Employees are also eligible for Basic and Supplemental Life Insurance, Short and Long-Term Disability. All employees (regardless of hours worked) have immediate access to the Company’s Employee Assistance Program and wellness programs—no enrollment is required. Employees may also participate in the Company’s 401K plan, with matching contributions by the Company.

Group 1001, and its affiliated companies, is strongly committed to providing a supportive work environment where employee differences are valued. Diversity is an essential ingredient in making Group 1001 a welcoming place to work and is fundamental in building a high-performance team. Diversity embodies all the differences that make us unique individuals. All employees share the responsibility for maintaining a workplace culture of dignity, respect, understanding and appreciation of individual and group differences.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT PERLE Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises.
jobs.description:
ABOUT PERLE

Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises. Our partners include xAI, Samsung, ELM, and Unisys. Headquartered in San Francisco with experts across more than forty markets, we specialize in the work that requires real human judgment: domain expertise, linguistic nuance, and cultural fidelity that generic data vendors cannot deliver.

Apply here:

THE ROLE

We are hiring expert Najdi Arabic transcribers to convert audio recordings of native speakers into precise, conventionally formatted written transcripts. The work powers speech recognition, dialogue, and evaluation systems for major AI labs. Audio ranges from clean studio recordings to natural conversational speech in real-world acoustic conditions.

You will be working at the level of expert linguistic judgment. This is not data entry. Decisions about orthography, code-switching, speaker attribution, disfluencies, and non-speech events shape the quality of every model trained on your output.

DIALECT AND SCOPE

Najdi Arabic as spoken across central and northern Saudi Arabia, the prestige dialect of inland Saudi Arabia and distinct from Hijazi and Eastern Arabian varieties. Project audio reflects authentic Najdi speech including older Bedouin features and the urban Riyadhi standard.

Primary speaker regions: Riyadh, Buraidah, Hail, Qassim region, Sudair.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Transcribe audio recordings into accurate, time-aligned written text following Perle's project-specific style guide
  • Apply correct conventions for speaker identification, overlapping speech, disfluencies, fillers, false starts, and non-speech events such as laughter, background noise, and music
  • Make principled orthographic decisions for dialectal, colloquial, and code-switched speech
  • Flag ambiguous segments, uncertain speakers, and audio quality issues using project conventions
  • Self-review every submission against Perle's quality bar before delivery
  • Engage with QA reviewers on edge cases, calibration sessions, and style guide updates

MUST HAVE

  • Native fluency in Najdi Arabic with lifelong residence or deep immersion in central or northern Saudi Arabia
  • Strong command of Modern Standard Arabic for orthographic decisions on dialectal speech
  • Ability to distinguish Najdi from Hijazi, Khaleeji, and other Arabian varieties
  • Familiarity with both urban Riyadhi standard and Bedouin-influenced rural speech
  • At least two years of professional transcription, captioning, court reporting, broadcast, translation, or linguistic annotation experience
  • Demonstrated accuracy at the word level under deadline pressure
  • Comfortable with web-based annotation platforms and variable-speed audio playback
  • Reliable high-speed internet, quality headphones, and a quiet workspace
  • Ability to commit to defined volume per week during active project phases

NICE TO HAVE

  • Background in Gulf or Arabian Peninsula Arabic linguistics, translation, or media
  • Prior experience annotating Najdi, Hijazi, or pan-Gulf speech data
  • Working knowledge of neighboring Arabic varieties for cross-dialect audio
  • Familiarity with IPA or other phonetic transcription systems
  • Experience with verbatim versus clean-verbatim transcription conventions

HOW WE WORK WITH YOU

  • Paid pilot task before full onboarding so both sides can calibrate
  • Per-task or per-minute compensation, with rates tied to audio complexity and turnaround
  • Flexible scheduling, with volume scaling up and down based on active client projects
  • Direct working relationship with Perle's linguistic leads and QA team
  • Eligible for invitation to additional Perle expert projects across related domains

HOW TO APPLY

Apply through Winnow, Perle's job portal at winnow.perle.ai. Find the role for your language under Open Jobs, set up your candidate profile, and complete the fully automated interview, which takes about 25 minutes. We review applications within 24 hours and invite passing candidates straight to the project.

Apply here:

Perle hires experts on the basis of skill, language proficiency, and demonstrated quality. We welcome applicants from every background and every region where our target languages are spoken.

Medical Scribing, Patient Support & Practice Administration

Part-Time | Menopause Medicine | 30 Hours/Week | $5/Hour
Schedule: Monday to Friday, approximately 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and compassionate Virtual Medical Assistant (VMA) to support a boutique medical practice specializing in menopause medicine.

This is a low-volume, high-touch practice where patient consultations are highly personalized and may last approximately 1 to 1.5 hours. The VMA will work closely with the physician to support live clinical documentation, patient communication, scheduling, payments, and day-to-day administrative workflows.

The ideal candidate is an experienced medical scribe who communicates professionally with patients, follows structured processes accurately, and can become a dependable extension of the physician and practice.

Key Responsibilities

1. Live Medical Scribing & Clinical Documentation

  • Perform live medical scribing during detailed patient consultations and accurately document patient responses, symptoms, severity ratings, and relevant clinical information using established EMR templates.

  • Pre-populate intake and follow-up templates before appointments by reviewing previous patient documentation and preparing relevant historical information for the physician.

  • Become proficient in the practice's three primary visit workflows: Initial Intake/Consultation, Lab Follow-up, and Regular Follow-up.

  • Maintain concise, organized, and accurate documentation that follows the physician's established templates and documentation preferences.

2. Patient Communication & Scheduling

  • Manage incoming and outgoing patient communication through phone, text, and email while providing a warm, polished, and professional patient experience.

  • Conduct structured pre-screening calls with prospective patients, explain the practice's cash-pay model, and gather relevant information before scheduling.

  • Schedule, reschedule, and confirm appointments while managing reminder sequences to help reduce cancellations and no-shows.

  • Send patient education materials, forms, medication reminders, and next-step instructions based on established practice workflows.

3. Payments & Administrative Support

  • Coordinate upfront patient payments approximately 1 to 2 weeks before scheduled appointments according to the practice's payment policies.

  • Clearly and professionally communicate payment expectations and assist with occasional special payment arrangements based on the physician's instructions.

  • Maintain accurate records of payment-related communication, outstanding follow-ups, and administrative action items.

  • Support additional administrative workflows and established practice SOPs as responsibilities evolve.

4. Lab Results & Document Management

  • Access designated external laboratory portals to retrieve available patient laboratory results.

  • Download and accurately upload laboratory reports and other required documents into the appropriate patient record in the EMR.

  • Ensure patient documents are properly organized, filed, and available to the physician before scheduled appointments when needed.

  • Maintain strict confidentiality and follow HIPAA, information-security, and practice compliance requirements when handling patient information.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 1 year of experience supporting a US-based healthcare practice.

  • Proven experience with live medical scribing and documenting patient encounters using structured or customized EMR templates.

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication with the confidence to communicate directly with patients.

  • Strong listening skills, attention to detail, and ability to accurately document information during live consultations.

  • Strong organizational, follow-up, and time-management skills.

  • Comfortable handling appointment scheduling, patient outreach, and payment-related conversations.

  • Ability to learn physician-specific workflows, documentation preferences, and standard operating procedures.

  • Reliable availability for a dedicated 30-hour-per-week schedule.

Nice to Have

  • Experience using Practice Fusion.

  • Clinical background in nursing, medicine, or another healthcare profession.

  • Experience in women's health, gynecology, endocrinology, hormone management, or a related specialty.

  • Experience with patient intake, pre-screening, outbound outreach, or patient lead conversion.

  • Experience accessing laboratory portals and managing EMR document uploads.

  • Experience supporting a boutique, concierge, cash-pay, or other high-touch medical practice.

Tools & Systems

  • Practice Fusion EMR

  • Business Phone / VoIP System

  • SMS and Patient Communication Tools

  • External Laboratory Portals

  • Email and Scheduling Platforms

  • Private Secure Network

  • Productivity Tracking Software

  • HIPAA Training and Compliance Systems

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented and experienced Virtual Medical Assistant with strong live medical scribing skills who can confidently support both clinical documentation and patient-facing administrative workflows.

You should be comfortable working closely with a physician in a highly personalized practice, accurately following established templates and workflows, and communicating with patients in a warm, polished, and professional manner. You are proactive, organized, dependable, and able to learn physician-specific preferences quickly while maintaining accuracy, confidentiality, and consistency in everything you do.

About Command|Link

Command|Link is a global SaaS Platform providing network, voice services, and IT security solutions, helping corporations consolidate their core infrastructure into a single vendor and layering on a proprietary single pane of glass platform. Command|Link has revolutionized the IT industry by tackling the problems our competitors create. In recognition for our unprecedented innovation and dedication, Command|Link was recognized as the SD-WAN Product of the Year, ITSM Visionary Spotlight, UCaaS Product of the Year, NaaS Product of the Year, Supplier of the Year, and the AT&T Strategic Growth Partner. Command|Link has built the only IT platform for scale that solves ISP vendor sprawl and IT headaches. We make it easy for our customers to get more done, maximize uptime and improve the bottom line.

Learn more about us here!

This is a 100% remote position

About your new role:

CommandLink's vendor ecosystem is the backbone of how we deliver connectivity and services to our customers, and this role will own the relationship between CommandLink and our vendors from the data side up. Today our team manages a large volume of vendor information that constantly needs to be tracked, verified, and updated across our systems, starting with our Quote Tool, which holds the most complete picture we have of each vendor and client. Keeping that tool accurate and current is critical to how the whole business operates.

We're looking for a Vendor Operations Analyst who doesn't just plan around the data, but who gets into the platform and does the work: tracking down information, entering it into the system, and analyzing it to surface insights. You'll work hands on with vendor and platform data every day, and you'll be a key point of contact for vendors, Sales, and other internal stakeholders. This isn't a deeply technical role, but it does require someone analytical, comfortable navigating systems and tools, and confident enough to bring a commercial mindset to every conversation.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own and maintain the Quote Tool, rate cards, and building lists/zip codes, making sure they always hold the most complete and accurate vendor and client information possible, and work toward a single source of truth for all vendor data.
  • Acquire vendor information (building lists, rate cards, API capabilities, contact and escalation matrices), load it into the Platform, SharePoint, Quote Tool, and Executed Contracts folder, and keep budgetary versus firm quoting set up and up to date.
  • Analyze platform data to identify trends and generate insights (win rates, where and why we're losing deals by customer, region, or vendor), build vendor scorecards, report on quote tool results, and track KPIs.
  • Partner with Sales and Regional Pricing Analysts to shape strategy by region, for example onboarding more vendors, adjusting portfolio in a given country, or using budgetary quoting.
  • Work with the Dev team on vendor API onboarding and maintenance, test serviceability and pricing, run monthly proactive testing once new integrations go live, and make sure key vendors' APIs are running correctly.
  • Serve as the point of contact for US vendor escalations, platform escalations, and vendor portal access for new joiners, and support MSA revisions and adjustments as needed.
  • Lead the project to have vendors submit their own onboarding updates, building lists, and rate cards directly.
  • Takes on additional responsibilities and projects as needed to support the success of the team and organization.

What you'll need for success:

Required

  • Experience with Sales and/or purchasing/buyer functions; strong Excel skills.
  • A hands on, analytical profile: comfortable working directly with platform data, not just planning around it, but tracking it down and entering it into the system yourself.
  • A commercial mindset; you're just as comfortable talking to vendors as you are to Sales or other internal stakeholders.
  • Proactive by nature; you go get the information you need rather than waiting for it to come to you.
  • A self starter who thrives in fast paced environments; startup or high growth company experience is a plus.
  • Comfortable learning and navigating systems and tools quickly. No deep technical or engineering background required, but you should understand how the platform works and why.

Nice to Have

  • Background in telecom, IT services, or B2B SaaS pricing structures.

Why you'll love life at Command|Link

Join us at CommandLink, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of business communication. We value the innovative spirit and seek individuals ready to bring their unique vision and expertise to a team that values bold ideas and strategic thinking. Are you ready to make an impact?

  • Room to grow at a high-growth company
  • An environment that celebrates ideas and innovation
  • Your work will have a tangible impact
  • Flexible time off
  • Fun events at cool locations
  • Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team

At CommandLink, we’re committed to creating a fair, consistent, and efficient hiring experience. As part of our process, we use AI-assisted tools to help review and analyze applications. These tools support our recruiting team by identifying qualifications and experience that align with the requirements of each role.

AI tools are used only to assist in the evaluation process — they do not make final hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by a member of our recruiting or hiring team before any decisions are made.

Priority Commerce is a leading financial technology company on a mission to deliver a personalized, easy-to-adopt financial toolset that accelerates cash flow and optimizes working capital for businesses. Our vision is to eliminate the barriers to unlocking revenue - empowering businesses to grow faster and operate smarter.

We achieve this through the Priority Commerce Engine, an innovative platform that combines payables, acquiring, and banking and treasury solutions. This unified approach allows businesses to streamline financial operations, reduce unnecessary costs, and uncover new revenue opportunities.

At Priority Commerce, we're driven by results. We expect our people to be known for results - bringing expertise, momentum, and relentless focus to every challenge, helping our clients and each other thrive.

About the Role:

We are looking for a commercially minded Customer Success Manager to own and grow our portfolio of LetUs customers across Canada.

This role sits at the intersection of Customer Success, Account Management, and Sales. You will own relationships across a portfolio of 100+ customers, helping them maximize the value of their current partnership while proactively identifying opportunities to expand the products and services they use.

We are looking for someone who enjoys building relationships, uncovering customer needs, identifying revenue opportunities, and confidently guiding customers toward solutions that create additional value for their business.

You'll also play an important role in the future of these relationships. As our Prisma platform expands, you will help educate and prepare LetUs customers for an eventual transition to Prisma, ensuring they understand the broader value of the partnership and are positioned for a successful migration when the time is right.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the relationship and commercial success of approximately 100+ LetUs customers across Canada.

  • Develop strong relationships with customer stakeholders and become a trusted point of contact for their business.

  • Understand each customer's business, goals, current product usage, and opportunities for additional value.

  • Proactively identify, develop, and close expansion opportunities within the existing customer base.

  • Own expansion opportunities through the sales cycle, including discovery, product demonstrations, solution positioning, and close.

  • Introduce customers to additional products and services that align with their needs and business objectives.

  • Conduct strategic customer conversations and business reviews focused on adoption, outcomes, growth opportunities, and future priorities.

  • Maintain a healthy pipeline of expansion opportunities and accurately track activity, opportunities, and next steps in the CRM.

  • Develop scalable outreach and engagement strategies appropriate for a portfolio of 100+ customers.

  • Identify customers who may require additional attention based on engagement, adoption, growth potential, or risk.

  • Partner with Support and other internal teams to resolve customer service issues, while quarterbacking critical issues through resolution and maintaining ownership of the overall customer experience.

  • Serve as the voice of the LetUs customer internally, identifying recurring needs, friction points, and opportunities to improve the customer experience.

  • Educate customers on the evolving Prisma offering and build excitement and readiness for future migration opportunities.

  • Support future LetUs-to-Prisma migrations by helping customers understand the business value of moving to the broader platform.

  • Meet or exceed defined customer retention, engagement, adoption, and expansion goals.

What Success Looks Like:

Success in this role means customers don't simply stay with LetUs. They deepen their relationship with us. You'll know you're succeeding when you're building meaningful customer relationships across a large portfolio, increasing engagement and adoption, consistently uncovering and closing expansion opportunities, and developing customers who are excited and prepared for the broader Prisma relationship ahead.

  • Experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Sales, or a hybrid customer-facing growth role.

  • Demonstrated ability to identify and close expansion or upsell opportunities within an existing customer base.

  • Strong discovery skills, with the ability to uncover customer needs through thoughtful, consultative conversations and successfully sell them on aligned product offerings. .

  • Comfortable discussing value, pricing, products, and commercial opportunities directly with customers.

  • Able to build strong customer relationships while still asking for the business.

INDG is looking for a Freelance Fashion Retoucher to support high-volume image production for fashion and sportswear brands on a project basis.

INDG has spent 20+ years building visual production systems across CGI, 3D, product visualization, and enterprise content workflows. Today, that heritage extends into AI-assisted production, automated content pipelines, and large-scale visual output for brands that need consistency across thousands of assets.

This role exists because visual quality still depends on sharp human judgment. Automation can accelerate batches, routing, and repeatable production steps, but the final image still needs a retoucher who can see skin texture, fabric response, clipping edges, color drift, seams, reflections, and brand-specific visual standards.

You’ll work across on-model fashion imagery, sportswear campaigns, packshots, apparel/footwear, textiles, still life, and e-commerce image sets. The work is production-driven: clean files, consistent color, repeatable decisions, fast handoff, and images that hold up across channels.

You are not here to make one image perfect in isolation. You are here to help deliver large sets of production-grade images that feel consistent, sharp, and aligned with the brand’s visual identity.

What You Will Do

Retouch talent imagery with precision
Deliver expert-level Photoshop retouching across on-model fashion and sportswear imagery. You’ll handle skin cleanup, dodge & burn, frequency separation, body and garment refinement, flyaway hair, wrinkles, folds, and small distractions without flattening texture or over-processing the image.

Finish product and packshot assets at scale
Retouch product imagery including apparel, footwear, accessories, textiles, still life, and packshots. You’ll clean seams, dust, fabric pulls, glue marks, stitching issues, reflections, color inconsistencies, and shape distortions while preserving material character.

Maintain consistency across large batches
Work through high-volume image sets while keeping color, contrast, crops, masks, background treatment, skin tone, textile detail, and product representation aligned with brand guidelines. You’ll make decisions that scale across a full delivery, not just a single file.

Spot technical issues before they move downstream
Identify and correct color casts, uneven lighting, masking artifacts, texture loss, compression problems, moiré, poor clipping paths, inconsistent whites, edge contamination, and mismatched product color. You’ll prepare files for production handoff with clean layers, clear structure, and reliable output.

Requirements

Who You Are

You live at the intersection of image craft and production discipline. You can work quickly, but you do not confuse speed with roughness. You know when an image needs detailed handwork, when a batch rule can solve the problem, and when a visual issue should be escalated before it affects the full delivery.

You Have

Professional experience as a retoucher in fashion, sportswear, e-commerce, studio production, or visual content delivery.

Strong Photoshop command, including masking, clipping paths, compositing, dodge & burn, frequency separation, color correction, color grading, cleanup, and non-destructive file setup.

Experience working across both talent retouching and product retouching, with a portfolio that shows skin, garments, textiles, footwear, packshots, and still life.

Comfort working inside production workflows where deadlines, naming conventions, feedback rounds, brand standards, and image counts matter.

You Think

A retouching decision should improve the image without destroying the material, skin, garment, or product truth.

Consistency matters more than isolated perfection when delivering a full batch.

A clean mask, accurate product color, and believable fabric texture are production requirements, not finishing touches.

Automation, batch processing, presets, and AI-assisted tools are useful when they support quality and control.

Your Skills Are

Adobe Photoshop at expert level.

Skin retouching, dodge & burn, frequency separation, healing, cloning, masking, clipping, compositing, garment cleanup, and product cleanup.

Color correction for skin, fabric, footwear, backgrounds, whites, blacks, and brand-specific palettes.

File discipline: layered PSDs, non-destructive workflows, naming conventions, version control, and handoff-ready delivery.

Visual judgment: you can look at an image and identify whether the issue is lighting, color, material response, masking, texture, reflection, or compositing.

Why Join INDG

INDG combines CGI, 3D, photography, AI-assisted workflows, and production systems for brands that need visual content at scale.

Grip, INDG’s content orchestration platform, supports production workflows where images, assets, approvals, and outputs need to move reliably.

As a Freelance Fashion Retoucher, you’ll contribute directly to the final visual quality of brand content seen across e-commerce, campaigns, product pages, and enterprise content libraries.

This is hands-on image work inside a production environment that values craft, speed, consistency, and clean execution.

The work powers speech recognition, dialogue, and evaluation systems for major AI labs. Audio ranges from clean studio recordings to natural conversational speech in real-world acoustic conditions.

You will be working at the level of expert linguistic judgment. This is not data entry. Decisions about orthography, code-switching, speaker attribution, disfluencies, and non-speech events shape the quality of every model trained on your output.

DIALECT AND SCOPE

Standard Estonian (eesti keel) and its regional varieties (Northern and Southern Estonian, including Voro). Project audio reflects everyday speech with awareness of vowel quantity distinctions.

Primary speaker regions: Tallinn, Tartu, Narva, Parnu, Kohtla-Jarve.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Make principled orthographic decisions for dialectal, colloquial, and code-switched speech
  • Flag ambiguous segments, uncertain speakers, and audio quality issues using project conventions
  • Self-review every submission against Perle's quality bar before delivery
  • Engage with QA reviewers on edge cases, calibration sessions, and style guide updates

MUST HAVE

  • Native fluency in Estonian with lifelong residence or deep immersion in Estonia
  • Mastery of current Estonian orthography including vowel-length distinctions
  • Ability to distinguish Northern and Southern Estonian varieties

Headquartered in San Francisco with experts across more than forty markets, we specialize in the work that requires real human judgment: domain expertise, linguistic nuance, and cultural fidelity that generic data vendors cannot deliver.

THE ROLE

We are hiring expert Kazakh transcribers to convert audio recordings of native speakers into precise, conventionally formatted written transcripts. The work powers speech recognition, dialogue, and evaluation systems for major AI labs. Audio ranges from clean studio recordings to natural conversational speech in real-world acoustic conditions.

You will be working at the level of expert linguistic judgment. This is not data entry. Decisions about orthography, code-switching, speaker attribution, disfluencies, and non-speech events shape the quality of every model trained on your output.

DIALECT AND SCOPE

Kazakh as spoken across Kazakhstan, currently transitioning from Cyrillic to Latin script. Project audio reflects everyday speech with frequent code-switching to Russian, especially in urban areas.

Primary speaker regions: Almaty, Astana, Shymkent, Karaganda, Aktobe, Pavlodar.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Transcribe audio recordings into accurate, time-aligned written text following Perle's project-specific style guide
  • Apply correct conventions for speaker identification, overlapping speech, disfluencies, fillers, false starts, and non-speech events such as laughter, background noise, and music
  • Make principled orthographic decisions for dialectal, colloquial, and code-switched speech
  • Flag ambiguous segments, uncertain speakers, and audio quality issues using project conventions
  • Self-review every submission against Perle's quality bar before delivery
  • Engage with QA reviewers on edge cases, calibration sessions, and style guide updates

MUST HAVE

  • Native fluency in Kazakh with lifelong residence or deep immersion in Kazakhstan
  • High accuracy reading and writing in Kazakh Cyrillic and awareness of the new Latin script
  • Comfortable transcribing natural Kazakh-Russian code-switching
  • Strong ear for regional Kazakh accents
  • At least two years of professional transcription, captioning, court reporting, broadcast, translation, or linguistic annotation experience
  • Demonstrated accuracy at the word level under deadline pressure
  • Comfortable with web-based annotation platforms and variable-speed audio playback
  • Reliable high-speed internet, quality headphones, and a quiet workspace
  • Ability to commit to defined volume per week during active project phases

NICE TO HAVE

  • Background in Turkic linguistics, translation, journalism, or media
  • Prior experience annotating Kazakh or other Turkic speech data
  • Working knowledge of Russian, Uzbek, or Kyrgyz for cross-lingual audio
  • Familiarity with IPA or other phonetic transcription systems
  • Experience with verbatim versus clean-verbatim transcription conventions

HOW WE WORK WITH YOU

  • Paid pilot task before full onboarding so both sides can calibrate
  • Per-task or per-minute compensation, with rates tied to audio complexity and turnaround
  • Flexible scheduling, with volume scaling up and down based on active client projects
  • Direct working relationship with Perle's linguistic leads and QA team
  • Eligible for invitation to additional Perle expert projects across related domains

HOW TO APPLY

Apply through Winnow, Perle's job portal at winnow.perle.ai. We review applications within 24 hours and invite passing candidates straight to the project.

Location: Remote

Position Overview

We are seeking a contract writer to develop a rich, Christ-rooted Bible study on marriage.

Rather than relying on marital clichés or surface-level conflict tactics, this study will show how Christian marriage is fundamentally anchored in the person, work, and union of Jesus Christ with His Church.

The ideal project will combine substantive biblical exposition with practical, hopeful, and transformational application for any couple—from newlyweds to long-term spouses—desiring to understand and live out a Christ-centered marriage.

Scope of Work

  • Research, outline, and write a full-length manuscript (approximately 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Collaborate closely with the editorial team through multiple rounds of revision
  • Ensure theological alignment with The Daily Grace Co.’s doctrinal commitment

Commitment

Contract, per-project basis.

Compensation

Compensation is determined based on project scope and complexity.

Additional Information

Contractors are engaged based on the needs of specific projects and are not guaranteed ongoing or full-time work. Participation in meetings, workshops, or collaborative sessions may be requested depending on the project timeline.

Why Publish with The Daily Grace Co.?

With over a decade of publishing experience, The Daily Grace Co. creates Christ-centered resources marked by theological depth, biblical faithfulness, and practical encouragement. We value thoughtful, faithful writers and partner closely from concept development through launch. Our goal is not simply to publish books—but to serve readers with resources that meet real needs and help them treasure Christ.

Bible Study Proposal Requirements


Important:Proposals that do not include all required components listed below cannot be reviewed.

AI Use:We strongly discourage the use of generative AI in Bible study proposals, and we will not move forward with a Bible study proposal if generative AI is used to generate or refine sample study days.

Please submit all materials inasingle PDF(not a Word Doc or Google Doc) that includes:

1. Suggested title and subtitle.

2. Controlling idea of the Bible study: In one sentence, state the central theological message of the biblical text as this study will present it, and the transformation it aims to produce in the reader.
3. A summary of resources that will be used and how they will inform your theological approach: Describe the key sources that will inform your interpretation and application of this biblical text, including commentaries or theological works, and explain how these sources shape your approach and serve the intended reader.
4. A list of potential theological issues and interpretive issues: Provide a brief list of potential theological tensions, debated interpretive issues, or common application pitfalls that arise from this biblical text, and explain how you plan to address them faithfully and in accordance with TDGC’s ecumenical approach.
5. Target audience description:Explain who is this Bible study written for and why it matters to them.
6. Comparable titles:Include 2–3 comparable Bible studies and explain how this study is distinct from each one.
7. Author bio:Explain what makes you uniquely qualified to write this book.
8. Complete Bible study outline:For each day of the study, please include the passage to be studied and a one sentence summary of the the main idea of the passage. It should be clear how the outline supports the controlling idea. Except for year-long Bible studies, each week of the study should contain 5 days of study content and two rest days.
9. Three complete sample Bible study days:Please include at least three sample days of the study. Each day should provide 750–1000 words of commentary on one passage of Scripture. The commentary should be engaging, informational, Christ-centered, and should offer specific real-life points of application. It should also include two questions for reflection and application and one prayer prompt.
10. Front and back matter: describe any supplemental material the Bible study will include such as maps, charts, illustrations, timelines, etc.
11. Timeline and specifications:include current manuscript status (work in progress, complete, etc.), anticipated manuscript delivery date, and any other information that is relevant to provide.

Salary: Determined per project
