jobs.description:
About Perle
Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises. Our partners include xAI, Samsung, ELM, and Unisys. Headquartered in San Francisco with experts across more than forty markets, we specialize in the work that requires real human judgment: domain expertise, linguistic nuance, and cultural fidelity that generic data vendors cannot deliver.

Apply here:

The Role
We are hiring expert Ukrainian transcribers to convert audio recordings of native speakers into precise, conventionally formatted written transcripts. The work powers speech recognition, dialogue, and evaluation systems for major AI labs. Audio ranges from clean studio recordings to natural conversational speech in real-world acoustic conditions.

You will be working at the level of expert linguistic judgment. This is not data entry. Decisions about orthography, code-switching, speaker attribution, disfluencies, and non-speech events shape the quality of every model trained on your output.

Dialect and Scope

Ukrainian in its standard form and regional varieties, including distinct Western (Galician) dialects. Project audio captures both formal and conversational speech with awareness of the surzhyk register where Ukrainian and Russian mix.

Primary speaker regions: Kyiv, Lviv, Kharkiv, Odesa, Dnipro.

What You Will Do

  • Transcribe audio recordings into accurate, time-aligned written text following Perle's project-specific style guide
  • Apply correct conventions for speaker identification, overlapping speech, disfluencies, fillers, false starts, and non-speech events such as laughter, background noise, and music
  • Make principled orthographic decisions for dialectal, colloquial, and code-switched speech
  • Flag ambiguous segments, uncertain speakers, and audio quality issues using project conventions
  • Self-review every submission against Perle's quality bar before delivery
  • Engage with QA reviewers on edge cases, calibration sessions, and style guide updates

Must Have

  • Native fluency in Ukrainian with lifelong residence or deep immersion in Ukraine
  • High accuracy reading and writing in Ukrainian Cyrillic
  • Ability to distinguish Ukrainian from surzhyk and from Russian in mixed audio
  • Strong ear for regional accents from Western, Central, and Eastern Ukraine
  • At least two years of professional transcription, captioning, court reporting, broadcast, translation, or linguistic annotation experience
  • Demonstrated accuracy at the word level under deadline pressure
  • Comfortable with web-based annotation platforms and variable-speed audio playback
  • Reliable high-speed internet, quality headphones, and a quiet workspace
  • Ability to commit to defined volume per week during active project phases

Nice To Have

  • Background in Ukrainian linguistics, journalism, translation, or education
  • Prior experience annotating Slavic-language speech data
  • Working knowledge of Russian or Polish for cross-lingual audio
  • Familiarity with IPA or other phonetic transcription systems
  • Experience with verbatim versus clean-verbatim transcription conventions

How We Work With You

  • Paid pilot task before full onboarding so both sides can calibrate
  • Per-task or per-minute compensation, with rates tied to audio complexity and turnaround
  • Flexible scheduling, with volume scaling up and down based on active client projects
  • Direct working relationship with Perle's linguistic leads and QA team
  • Eligible for invitation to additional Perle expert projects across related domains

How To Apply

Apply through Winnow, Perle's job portal at winnow.perle.ai. Find the role for your language under Open Jobs, set up your candidate profile, and complete the fully automated interview, which takes about 25 minutes. We review applications within 24 hours and invite passing candidates straight to the project.

Apply here:

Equal Opportunity

Perle hires experts on the basis of skill, language proficiency, and demonstrated quality. We welcome applicants from every background and every region where our target languages are spoken.

jobs.description:
Risepoint is an education technology company that helps regional universities launch and grow online programs for modern learners. Risepoint supports more than 100 universities and colleges across five countries, with programs concentrated in high-demand fields including nursing, healthcare, teaching, business, technology, and public service. Our suite of products and services supports the full student journey and each university’s long-term goals. Together, we increase access to affordable education that delivers a strong return on investment for learners and meets employer and community needs. Learn more at risepoint.com.

About This Opportunity

Risepoint partners with leading universities to expand access to high-quality online education, and Partner Strategy & Analytics team sits at the center of how those partnerships grow and perform. We're looking for a Strategy & Analytics Manager who can turn complex, full-funnel partner data — from lead generation through yield — into the strategic narrative that shapes how Risepoint invests in and grows its portfolio of partner institutions.

This role is built for someone who thrives at the intersection of rigorous analysis and cross-functional leadership. You'll own analytical workstreams end-to-end, from framing the right question to delivering the insight that moves a decision, while partnering closely with Integrated Marketing, Channel Marketing, Partner Management, and Operations teams. You'll be expected to spot the data quality issue before it becomes a stakeholder problem, build the pipelines that make partner performance monitoring reliable, and use AI-assisted tools like Claude and Databricks Genie to work faster without ever outsourcing your judgment. As the team grows, you'll also start building and coaching the analysts around you — this is a role with real room to grow into people leadership.

If you want a seat where your analysis directly informs how a national portfolio of university partnerships is managed and grown, this is that seat.

The Impact You Will Make

  • You'll be the analytical backbone behind partner growth strategy. Your work on enrollment funnel performance — lead gen through yield — will directly shape the conversations and decisions that determine how Risepoint supports long-term partner growth.
  • You'll protect the integrity of the data leadership relies on. By catching errors, discontinuities, and reconciliation gaps before they surface downstream, you'll build a level of trust in the numbers that lets stakeholders move faster and with more confidence.
  • You'll build infrastructure that outlasts any single analysis. The pipelines and reporting workflows you design — in partnership with BI and data engineering — will become the foundation partner performance monitoring runs on well beyond your own day-to-day work.
  • You'll set the pace for how the team works. By embedding tools like Claude and Databricks Genie into daily practice, you'll help define what an AI-first analytical function actually looks like at Risepoint — faster analysis, sharper communication, same rigor.
  • You'll turn data into decisions. Through the KPIs you establish and the insights you translate into clear recommendations, you'll give executives and department heads a direct line from performance data to action.
  • You'll grow the people around you. As the team expands, your coaching and project leadership will shape how new analysts think about partner data — building capability that compounds over time, not just output for the moment.

How You Will Bring Our Mission to Life

What You Will Do

  • Cross-Functional Initiative Leadership: Drive and coordinate multi-stakeholder analytical initiatives across departmental boundaries, serving as a thought partner and initiative lead for Integrated Marketing, Channel Marketing, Partner Management Team, and other operations teams; own workstreams end-to-end from problem framing through insight delivery with minimal direction.
  • Strategic Data-Driven Analysis: Handle highly detailed and complex partner performance data across the full enrollment funnel, from lead generation through yield, and facilitate internal stakeholder conversations that build strategies supporting long-term partner growth.
  • Data Quality and Diagnostic Rigor: Proactively surface errors, discontinuities, and reconciliation gaps in partner data before they reach stakeholders, approaching each inconsistency as a signal worth tracing to its source rather than an edge case to dismiss.
  • Analytical Infrastructure: Build and maintain the analytical pipelines and reporting workflows that underpin partner performance monitoring, collaborating with BI and data engineering teams to ensure data access, consistency, and appropriate governance
  • AI-Assisted Productivity: Contribute to Risepoint's AI-first analytical practices by incorporating tools like Claude and Databricks Genie into day-to-day workflows to accelerate analysis and communication; AI is a productivity tool here, not a replacement for analytical judgment, and the expectation is full ownership of and accountability for the work product
  • Strategic Planning: Work closely with senior management to define analytical strategies aligned with organizational goals and objectives, identifying opportunities for improvement across the partner portfolio
  • Performance Measurement: Establish and monitor key performance indicators to track the effectiveness of partner programs and analytical initiatives; surface actionable opportunities from performance data and translate them into recommendations leadership can act on
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Communicate findings and insights to diverse stakeholders, including executives, department heads, and operational teams, through compelling presentations, structured briefings, and data visualizations that connect technical analysis to strategic
  • People Management: Build a strong team with other team members some are expected to report to the Manager eventually by coaching, instructing, and drive projects as a team

What Success Looks Like

  • Analytical Rigor and Intellectual Curiosity: The ability to conceive and execute quantitative analysis independently, pressure-test your own findings, and approach data inconsistencies as questions worth answering.
  • Communication and Influence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; the ability to translate complex technical findings into strategic recommendations for stakeholders at all levels, including those with no data background, and to drive alignment without direct authority
  • Cross-Functional Mindset: Collaborative instinct and comfort operating across teams; you function as a connector between data infrastructure and business strategy, and you bring a service orientation to stakeholder relationships
  • Structured Thinking Under Ambiguity: You bring frameworks to unstructured problems, communicate your reasoning transparently, and know when to move forward with imperfect information versus when to escalate uncertainty.
  • Attention to Detail: Strong ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and maintain analytical accuracy under time pressure; you validate before you publish and catch discrepancies before they reach stakeholders.

How Impact Will be Measured

  • Partner performance improvement is the ultimate impact measurement. Partner Strategy & Analytics team strives to impact partners by supporting internal stakeholders with data-driven strategic insights and recommendations
  • Trust thought partnership with internal leaders is another key success indicator as a Manager of Strategy & Analytics

Experience That Matters Most

  • 5+ years’ experience in an analytical or strategy leadership role (strategy, business analytics, business operations, corporate finance, business transformation) and/or in a professional services organization (consulting, private equity, investment banking)
  • Strong proficiency in Databricks and advanced SQL, including CTE structuring, query performance optimization, and fundamental window functions, with foundational knowledge of data governance and data engineering principles.
  • Familiarity with AI productivity tools like Claude and Databricks Genie, prompt engineering, and natural language query interfaces
  • Advanced Excel skills, including Power Query M for data transformation workflows and DAX for calculated measures.
  • Working experience with business intelligence and data visualization platforms such as Power BI or Tableau
  • Demonstrated ability to conceive and execute quantitative analysis and deliver data-driven insights with strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Bachelor’s degree with proven record of achievement and quantitative proficiency

Experience That’s Great to Have

  • Proven track record in using Databricks, SQL, AI tools and data analysis to clean data, extract insights, and communicate takeaways to leadership in a professional setting
  • Agile workstyle to meet evolving business needs in a dynamic and fast-paced work environment that
  • Master's degree or equivalent experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or data science is a plus.

Senior Accounting Manager – Multi-Entity Accounting & Financial Reporting

Full-Time | Remote | U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients — a rapidly growing U.S. plumbing and home services company — is hiring a Senior Accounting Manager to own month-end close, financial reporting, reconciliations, and accounting controls across multiple entities.

The company is scaling from $20M+ toward $50M+ in annual revenue, making this a high-impact role focused on building accurate, scalable, and private equity-ready accounting processes.

Reporting to the VP of Accounting, you’ll have significant ownership and a clear growth path toward Corporate Accounting Manager.

What You’ll Own

Month-End Close & Financial Reporting

  • Own the full month-end close across multiple entities and locations
  • Prepare accurate financial statements and supporting schedules
  • Manage P&L reporting by business unit
  • Investigate variances and unusual financial trends
  • Maintain reporting in accordance with U.S. GAAP

General Ledger & Reconciliations

  • Perform and review bank, credit card, and balance sheet reconciliations
  • Maintain accurate general ledger accounts and supporting schedules
  • Complete balance sheet tie-outs
  • Identify and resolve accounting discrepancies quickly

AR & Payroll Analysis

  • Oversee accounts receivable and outstanding balances
  • Review weekly multi-location payroll reports
  • Analyze payroll, labor costs, trends, and discrepancies
  • Support accurate financial planning and reporting

Audit, Controls & Process Improvement

  • Support internal and external audits across revenue, AR, inventory, fixed assets, AP, debt, equity, and payroll
  • Prepare audit schedules and supporting documentation
  • Evaluate and test internal controls
  • Identify financial risks and potential misstatements
  • Build stronger, more scalable accounting processes as the company grows

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of progressive accounting experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field
  • Proven ownership of the full month-end close
  • Strong multi-entity or multi-location accounting experience
  • Expert-level QuickBooks Online proficiency
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP
  • Experience preparing financial statements and P&L reports
  • Strong general ledger and balance sheet reconciliation experience
  • Experience reviewing accounts receivable and payroll
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and English communication skills
  • Comfortable working independently during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • CPA or equivalent accounting qualification
  • Public accounting or external audit experience
  • Internal controls and audit testing experience
  • Private equity-backed or high-growth company experience
  • Construction, plumbing, HVAC, home services, or field-service industry experience

What Success Looks Like

  • Accurate and timely month-end closes
  • Reliable financial statements across all entities
  • Clean balance sheet and GL reconciliations
  • Strong audit readiness and internal controls
  • Accurate AR and payroll reporting
  • Fewer accounting discrepancies and reporting issues
  • Scalable processes that support continued company growth

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High ownership over a growing multi-entity accounting function
  • Direct exposure to the VP of Accounting and company leadership
  • Help build a PE-ready accounting infrastructure
  • Join a business scaling toward $50M+ revenue
  • Clear growth path into a Corporate Accounting Manager role
  • Fully remote opportunity

Interview Process

  1. Initial Recruiter Screening
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Qualified candidates will receive a Spark Hire invitation to complete a short Intro Video. This gives the hiring team an opportunity to learn more about your accounting experience, communication style, and background with month-end close and multi-entity financial reporting.

Please check your inbox and spam/junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’ve personally owned month-end close, have strong QuickBooks Online and U.S. GAAP experience, and enjoy building accurate, scalable accounting processes, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
*Role is eligible to be remote*

We are Lennar

Lennar is one of the nation's leading homebuilders, dedicated to making an impact and creating an extraordinary experience for their Homeowners, Communities, and Associates by building quality homes and providing exceptional customer service, giving back to the communities in which we work and live in, and fostering a culture of opportunity and growth for our Associates throughout their career. Lennar has been recognized as a Fortune 500® company and consistently ranked among the top homebuilders in the United States.

Summary of Position:

The Mortgage Paralegal supports the Legal and Compliance teams by coordinating litigation and regulatory matters in a highly regulated financial services environment. Responsibilities include managing subpoena/civil investigative demand intake and response workflows, organizing and producing documents (including redactions), tracking deadlines and regulatory/production requests, and maintaining matters in case management and document management systems. The Paralegal assists with consumer complaint and contested matter correspondence, conducts legal and factual research using statutes, agency guidance, and related sources, and helps prepare draft filings, memoranda, and internal reports. This role also supports contract lifecycle management, legal e-billing administration, and legal inbox management. The Paralegal works closely with the Chief Legal and Risk Officer and partners with internal stakeholders and outside counsel as needed in a remote setting.

This position requires deep paralegal experience, strong knowledge of mortgage industry practices, and the ability to manage high-volume, time-sensitive matters in a regulated environment, with ability to adapt quickly and incorporate technology where appropriate.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Review pleadings and related filings (e.g., summons, complaints, affidavits, answers, motions, orders, and judgments).

  • Coordinate intake, logging, and timely responses to subpoenas, garnishments, and other legal requests in partnership with internal stakeholders and outside counsel.

  • Support audits, regulatory exams, and internal reviews by compiling documentation and responding to information requests.

  • Liaise with outside counsel to coordinate matter intake, status updates, and documentation requests, and to facilitate communication among Legal, Compliance, and business teams.

  • Maintain matters in case management systems by analyzing complaints and claims, conducting fact-gathering and legal research (e.g., statutes, agency guidance, seller guides, judicial decisions), and synthesizing findings to support filings, correspondence, memoranda, and internal reports.

  • Maintain matter databases and electronic files by organizing and tracking case documents in accordance with retention policies.

  • Support settlement administration by gathering and organizing settlement data, preparing approval requests, requesting payments, reviewing agreements and releases, and coordinating signature routing.

  • Manage consumer complaint and contested matter correspondence by performing intake and logging, supporting investigations, drafting responses (e.g., CFPB, BBB, direct), and producing trend, risk, and management reports.

  • Support contract lifecycle management by coordinating intake, tracking, execution, and storage; preparing summaries, issue spotting, and redlines under attorney supervision; and maintaining templates, repositories, and version control.

  • Administer legal e-billing (e.g., Legal Tracker/Serengeti) by reviewing and coding invoices, tracking accruals, ensuring compliance with outside counsel guidelines, resolving discrepancies with firms, and monitoring legal spend and budgets.

  • Manage shared Legal inboxes and intake channels by routing inquiries, responding to routine requests, and escalating high-risk or sensitive matters.

  • Update policies, procedures, and internal documentation in coordination with Legal and Compliance leadership.

  • Handle routine legal issues under the direction of internal counsel.

  • Provide administrative support as needed, including proofreading drafts, obtaining execution signatures, and distributing fully executed documents to internal teams and outside counsel.

  • Contribute to ongoing and special legal projects and perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Education and Experience Requirements:

  • A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience as a Paralegal required, preferably in the financial services industry or a firm that provides services to companies in the financial services industry.

  • Paralegal Associate Degree, Bachelor’s Degree, and/or Paralegal Certification strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting in-house legal teams or law firms.

  • Familiarity with corporate governance and risk management oversight preferred.

  • Previous experience as contract administrator preferred.

Physical Requirements:

This is primarily a sedentary office position which requires the Mortgage Paralegal to have the ability to operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. Finger dexterity is necessary. Primarily remote; prolonged periods of sitting and computer use are expected.

Additional Requirements:

  • Ability to support contract, vendor, and policy management activities.
  • Ability to use Microsoft applications (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams) and Adobe Acrobat (PDFs); proficiency in AI tools preferred.
  • Ability to work with or learn NMLS-related processes and requirements.
  • Ability to work with or learn loan origination systems (e.g., Encompass).
  • Ability to apply knowledge of mortgage regulatory frameworks (e.g., RESPA, TILA, ECOA, CFPB requirements).
  • Ability to use Legal Tracker (Serengeti) or similar legal e-billing platforms.
  • Ability to recognize and support legal and regulatory compliance needs in the financial services industry.
  • Ability to communicate clearly in writing and verbally, including editing/proofreading with strong grammar and spelling.
  • Ability to organize, manage time, and multitask with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to take initiative, resolve inquiries independently, and exercise sound judgment.
  • Ability to remain poised and effective in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, including under stressful situations.
  • Ability to handle highly confidential information with discretion.
  • Ability to maintain a strong professional presence, including maturity and self-confidence.
  • Ability to prepare and format legal documents.
  • Ability to interact professionally with strong interpersonal skills and appropriate business demeanor.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with co-workers, supervisors, and management.
  • Ability to understand and follow posted work rules and procedures.

Travel Requirements:

Minimal travel required, if any, as needed for training or departmental needs.

This description outlines the basic responsibilities and requirements for the position noted. This is not a comprehensive listing of all job duties of the Associate. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Our Associates have access to robust health insurance plans, including Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage, ensuring their health needs are well taken care of. Job Title: Représentant(e) du service à la clientèle II / Client Services Rep 2

Job Location: Kanata, Ontario, Canada

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Mettez à profit vos solides compétences en communication, votre expertise en soutien de projets et votre capacité à obtenir des résultats concrets dans un rôle où vous pourrez avoir un impact immédiat. À titre de Représentant(e) du service à la clientèle II, vous intégrerez une équipe dynamique et énergique qui soutient des initiatives de marketing numérique pour des clients mondiaux du secteur des sciences de la vie.

Dans ce rôle, vous assumerez la responsabilité des livrables destinés aux clients, dirigerez des initiatives d'amélioration des processus, tirerez parti d'outils alimentés par l'intelligence artificielle afin d'accroître l'efficacité et collaborerez avec plusieurs équipes pour assurer des résultats exceptionnels pour les clients. Grâce aux ressources de formation de premier plan d'IQVIA et à une culture axée sur la collaboration, vous aurez l'occasion de développer davantage votre expertise et de contribuer à des initiatives stratégiques.

Aperçu du poste

Dans ce rôle, vous contribuerez à la réalisation de campagnes de marketing numérique pour des clients du secteur de la santé tout en agissant comme point de contact clé auprès des parties prenantes internes. Vous exécuterez diverses activités liées aux projets, identifierez des occasions d'amélioration des processus et contribuerez à maintenir l'excellence opérationnelle.

À titre de membre expérimenté de l'équipe, vous serez appelé(e) à diriger des initiatives visant à améliorer les flux de travail et l'expérience client, à utiliser des outils alimentés par l'IA pour accroître la productivité et l'efficacité, et à collaborer efficacement avec des équipes multidisciplinaires afin de résoudre des problèmes et d'assurer le succès des projets.

Vous vous joindrez à une équipe mondiale reconnue pour sa culture positive, son dynamisme et son engagement envers la réussite collective. Les membres de l'équipe sont encouragés à proposer des idées, à partager les meilleures pratiques et à participer à des initiatives d'amélioration continue visant à accroître la satisfaction des clients et la performance opérationnelle.

Ce poste soutient des clients partout en Amérique du Nord. Tous les membres de l'équipe travaillent selon les heures de l'heure normale du Centre (HNC/CST), depuis n'importe quel endroit au Canada.

Responsabilités principales

Soutien à la clientèle et communication

  • Collaborer avec les équipes internes concernant les besoins des projets, les échéanciers, les livrables, les changements, les ressources et la résolution des problèmes.
  • Développer et maintenir de solides relations avec les parties prenantes grâce à une communication efficace et à une grande réactivité.
  • Veiller à ce que les demandes de soutien et les préoccupations soient documentées avec précision, communiquées adéquatement et résolues dans les délais requis.
  • Formuler des recommandations et proposer des solutions visant à améliorer la prestation des services.

Soutien technique et coordination de projets

  • Participer à la réalisation des campagnes de marketing numérique en veillant au respect des jalons et des échéances.
  • Examiner les éléments de campagne, soutenir les activités d'assurance qualité (AQ) et de tests, coordonner les préparatifs de déploiement et contribuer aux activités de suivi et de production de rapports sur le rendement.
  • Effectuer des activités liées aux données, notamment la validation des données et les mises à jour des fichiers de préparation.
  • Utiliser des systèmes de gestion de projets, Excel et des outils alimentés par l'intelligence artificielle afin de simplifier les processus, améliorer l'exactitude et accroître l'efficacité.
  • Déceler et atténuer les risques, transmettre les enjeux lorsque nécessaire et contribuer à la réussite des livraisons de campagnes.

Collaboration d'équipe, amélioration des processus et innovation

  • Collaborer au sein d'une équipe mondiale multidisciplinaire afin d'atteindre les objectifs des projets et des clients.
  • Diriger ou soutenir des projets et initiatives axés sur l'amélioration des processus, l'efficacité opérationnelle, l'amélioration de la qualité ou l'expérience client.
  • Utiliser des technologies alimentées par l'IA, y compris des outils comme Microsoft Copilot, pour accroître la productivité, optimiser les flux de travail, soutenir l'analyse des données et améliorer la prestation des services.
  • Partager les connaissances, les meilleures pratiques et les leçons apprises avec les membres de l'équipe afin de favoriser leur développement et la réussite collective.
  • Analyser les processus existants et recommander des améliorations permettant d'accroître l'efficacité, la qualité et la satisfaction des parties prenantes.
  • Participer à des initiatives d'amélioration continue et soutenir l'adoption de solutions innovantes au sein de l'organisation.

Compétences et qualifications requises

  • Baccalauréat ou diplôme universitaire équivalent.
  • Au moins un (1) an d'expérience pertinente en service à la clientèle, soutien de projets, opérations de marketing numérique, services de santé ou dans un domaine connexe.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication écrite et verbale, avec la capacité d'interagir efficacement avec les parties prenantes internes.
  • Solides compétences en organisation et en gestion du temps, avec la capacité de gérer efficacement plusieurs priorités dans un environnement dynamique.
  • Maîtrise intermédiaire d'Excel et capacité à apprendre rapidement de nouveaux systèmes et technologies.
  • Excellentes aptitudes analytiques et de résolution de problèmes, avec la capacité de résoudre de façon autonome des situations complexes.
  • Expérience démontrée dans la direction de projets, d'initiatives organisationnelles, de projets d'amélioration des processus ou d'améliorations opérationnelles.
  • Expérience dans l'utilisation d'outils alimentés par l'intelligence artificielle, tels que Microsoft Copilot ou des technologies similaires, afin d'améliorer l'efficacité, la productivité, la prise de décision ou les processus d'affaires.
  • Capacité démontrée à collaborer efficacement avec diverses équipes, à établir des partenariats et à générer des résultats dans un environnement matriciel.
  • Capacité à travailler selon les heures d'affaires de l'heure normale du Centre (HNC/CST) depuis n'importe où au Canada.

Compétences privilégiées

  • Expérience dans les secteurs pharmaceutique, des soins de santé, des sciences de la vie ou du marketing numérique.
  • Maîtrise avancée des applications Microsoft Office, notamment Excel, PowerPoint et Outlook.
  • Expérience en gestion ou en coordination de projets et de campagnes destinés aux clients.
  • Connaissance des méthodologies de gestion de projet et des pratiques d'amélioration des processus.
  • Expérience de l'utilisation d'outils d'intelligence artificielle, de solutions d'automatisation ou de plateformes analytiques pour soutenir l'efficacité opérationnelle.
  • Connaissance de la terminologie liée aux soins de santé ou au marketing numérique.

Everlywell is a digital health company pioneering the next generation of biomarker intelligence—combining AI-powered technology with human insight to deliver personalized, actionable health answers. We transform complex biomarker data into life-changing insights—seamlessly integrating advanced diagnostics, virtual care, and patient engagement to reshape how and where health happens.

Over the past decade, Everlywell has delivered close to 1 billion personalized health insights, transforming care for 60 million people and powering hundreds of enterprise partners. In 2025, an estimated 1 in 94 U.S. adults received an Everlywell test, solidifying our spot as the #1 at-home testing company in the country. Fueled by AI and built for scale, we’re breaking down barriers, closing care gaps, and unlocking a more connected healthcare experience that is smarter, faster, and more personalized.

About DxS

DxS is Everlywell’s diagnostics services business that powers diagnostics‑driven programs for external partners. We work with diagnostic laboratories, telehealth and digital health platforms, life sciences and biopharma companies, and other enterprise clients to design and operate programs that use Everlywell’s clinical, operational, and technology infrastructure.

Our ambition is to make Everlywell the go‑to commercialization and clinical operations partner for advanced diagnostics—helping innovators bring new tests to market, integrate telehealth and clinical services, and scale high‑quality programs across thousands of patients and multiple channels.

Role Summary

We are hiring a VP, Sales & Business Development – Diagnostic & Telehealth Services (DxS) to lead the B2B2C commercial motion for Everlywell’s diagnostics services portfolio.

You will build and manage a proactive pipeline of consumer‑facing diagnostics brands,DTC digital-health companies, genetics companies with a consumer offering, virtual care providers, and innovative labs that can leverage Everlywell’s infrastructure to launch and scale diagnostics‑driven programs. Rather than selling standalone tests, you will sell the clinical infrastructure underpinning programs across diagnostics, virtual care, logistics/operations, and reporting into partner‑branded or white‑label experiences.

You will own the full DxS sales lifecycle—from prospecting and discovery through solution design, commercial modeling, contracting, and handoff to implementation—while partnering closely with Clinical Operations, Product, Finance, and Marketing to shape offerings and ensure programs are set up to scale. This is both a strategic and tactical role: you will help define the future of the DxS business while also carrying a quota and closing net‑new, multi‑stakeholder deals.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the DxS B2B2C new‑business pipeline for diagnostics, genetics, and enterprise programs—from prospecting and qualification through proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Lead discovery and program design with prospective clients, translating their needs into clear DxS proposals, pricing, and statements of work that bundle diagnostics, virtual care, logistics/ops, and reporting.
  • Partner with Finance, Product, and Clinical Operations to structure deals that meet Everlywell’s revenue, margin, and scalability targets, including consumer utilization and funnel assumptions.

  • Own DxS commercial contracting in partnership with Legal, including negotiating terms, aligning on scope, and ensuring operational readiness before signature.

  • Build and maintain executive‑level relationships with key client stakeholders (commercial, clinical, operations, finance) to drive adoption, expansion, and long‑term partnerships.

  • Develop and maintain an accurate DxS pipeline; forecast monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue and report performance and insights to executive leadership.

  • Represent the company and expand the pipeline by attending key conferences, seminars, webinars, and other external‑facing events.

  • Collaborate with Marketing to refine DxS positioning and build compelling pitch materials (decks, proposals, case studies) that clearly articulate our value proposition to telehealth and digital health partners.

  • Serve as the voice of the market for DxS, feeding structured insights back into product, pricing, and go‑to‑market strategy for telehealth and digital health use cases.

Who You Are:

  • Telehealth / digital health / B2B2C experience
      • 5-10 years in enterprise sales or business development in telehealth, digital health, consumer diagnostics, or adjacent health tech, with a strong track record of closing complex, multi‑stakeholder deals.

      • Direct experience selling B2B2C or platform programs through partners (e.g., telehealth platforms, virtual primary care, digital health brands, employers, payers, retailers)—not just hospital/IDN lab contracts.

      • Comfortable talking about consumer funnels, activation, utilization, and unit economics, not just test volume.

      • Quota‑carrying seller and builder
        • Demonstrated history of owning a personal annual quota (e.g., $5–20M+) and consistently meeting or exceeding targets.
        • Clear track record of net‑new logo acquisition and expansion, not just renewals or “relationship management.”
        • Has led multi‑month, multi‑stakeholder sales cycles involving product, operations, clinical, legal, and finance on both sides.
        • Program & platform mindset

        • Experience designing or selling integrated programs that bundle diagnostics, virtual care, logistics/ops, and reporting into a cohesive offering.

        • Partners naturally with product and operations on offer structure (tiers, bundles, workflows), pricing & margins, and implementation/performance management.

        • Stage and Operating style

        • Experience at growth‑stage health tech or diagnostics (Seed–Series E / PE roll‑up), not only large legacy incumbents.

        • Self‑starter who thrives in a fast‑moving, high‑growth environment and is comfortable balancing strategic thinking with hands‑on execution.
        • Understanding and use of AI in daily work to accelerate client research, value proposition tailoring, and opportunity identification.

ABOUT PERLE

Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises. Our partners include xAI, Samsung, ELM, and Unisys. Headquartered in San Francisco with experts across more than forty markets, we specialize in the work that requires real human judgment: domain expertise, linguistic nuance, and cultural fidelity that generic data vendors cannot deliver.

Apply here:

THE ROLE

We are hiring expert Swahili transcribers to convert audio recordings of native speakers into precise, conventionally formatted written transcripts. The work powers speech recognition, dialogue, and evaluation systems for major AI labs. Audio ranges from clean studio recordings to natural conversational speech in real-world acoustic conditions.

You will be working at the level of expert linguistic judgment. This is not data entry. Decisions about orthography, code-switching, speaker attribution, disfluencies, and non-speech events shape the quality of every model trained on your output.

DIALECT AND SCOPE

Kiswahili in its main standard form (Kiswahili sanifu) and regional variants across East Africa, including the Tanzanian standard, Kenyan Swahili, and urban varieties such as Sheng. Project audio includes formal and informal registers with natural English borrowing.

Primary speaker regions: Tanzania, Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda, eastern DRC.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Transcribe audio recordings into accurate, time-aligned written text following Perle's project-specific style guide
  • Apply correct conventions for speaker identification, overlapping speech, disfluencies, fillers, false starts, and non-speech events such as laughter, background noise, and music
  • Make principled orthographic decisions for dialectal, colloquial, and code-switched speech
  • Flag ambiguous segments, uncertain speakers, and audio quality issues using project conventions
  • Self-review every submission against Perle's quality bar before delivery
  • Engage with QA reviewers on edge cases, calibration sessions, and style guide updates

MUST HAVE

  • Native fluency in Swahili with lifelong residence or deep immersion in an East African country
  • Mastery of standard Swahili orthography
  • Ability to distinguish Tanzanian, Kenyan, and other regional Swahili varieties
  • Comfortable transcribing Swahili-English code-switching including Sheng where it appears
  • At least two years of professional transcription, captioning, court reporting, broadcast, translation, or linguistic annotation experience
  • Demonstrated accuracy at the word level under deadline pressure
  • Comfortable with web-based annotation platforms and variable-speed audio playback
  • Reliable high-speed internet, quality headphones, and a quiet workspace
  • Ability to commit to defined volume per week during active project phases

NICE TO HAVE

  • Background in Swahili linguistics, journalism, translation, or education
  • Prior experience annotating Swahili or other African-language speech data
  • Working knowledge of regional Bantu languages or Arabic loanword conventions
  • Familiarity with IPA or other phonetic transcription systems
  • Experience with verbatim versus clean-verbatim transcription conventions

HOW WE WORK WITH YOU

  • Paid pilot task before full onboarding so both sides can calibrate
  • Per-task or per-minute compensation, with rates tied to audio complexity and turnaround
  • Flexible scheduling, with volume scaling up and down based on active client projects
  • Direct working relationship with Perle's linguistic leads and QA team
  • Eligible for invitation to additional Perle expert projects across related domains

HOW TO APPLY

Apply through Winnow, Perle's job portal at winnow.perle.ai. Find the role for your language under Open Jobs, set up your candidate profile, and complete the fully automated interview, which takes about 25 minutes. We review applications within 24 hours and invite passing candidates straight to the project.

Apply here:

Perle hires experts on the basis of skill, language proficiency, and demonstrated quality. We welcome applicants from every background and every region where our target languages are spoken.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT PERLE Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises.
jobs.description:
ABOUT PERLE

Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises. Our partners include xAI, Samsung, ELM, and Unisys. Headquartered in San Francisco with experts across more than forty markets, we specialize in the work that requires real human judgment: domain expertise, linguistic nuance, and cultural fidelity that generic data vendors cannot deliver.

Apply here:

THE ROLE

We are hiring expert Malay transcribers to convert audio recordings of native speakers into precise, conventionally formatted written transcripts. The work powers speech recognition, dialogue, and evaluation systems for major AI labs. Audio ranges from clean studio recordings to natural conversational speech in real-world acoustic conditions.

You will be working at the level of expert linguistic judgment. This is not data entry. Decisions about orthography, code-switching, speaker attribution, disfluencies, and non-speech events shape the quality of every model trained on your output.

DIALECT AND SCOPE

Standard Malay (Bahasa Melayu) as used in Malaysia, Brunei, and Singapore, with regional and ethnic variation. Project audio includes natural code-switching with English (Manglish) and lexical influence from Hokkien, Tamil, and other regional languages.

Primary speaker regions: Kuala Lumpur, Johor Bahru, Penang, Kota Kinabalu, Bandar Seri Begawan, Singapore.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Transcribe audio recordings into accurate, time-aligned written text following Perle's project-specific style guide
  • Apply correct conventions for speaker identification, overlapping speech, disfluencies, fillers, false starts, and non-speech events such as laughter, background noise, and music
  • Make principled orthographic decisions for dialectal, colloquial, and code-switched speech
  • Flag ambiguous segments, uncertain speakers, and audio quality issues using project conventions
  • Self-review every submission against Perle's quality bar before delivery
  • Engage with QA reviewers on edge cases, calibration sessions, and style guide updates

MUST HAVE

  • Native fluency in Malay with lifelong residence or deep immersion in Malaysia, Brunei, or Singapore
  • Mastery of Rumi (Latin) script orthography and awareness of Jawi where it appears
  • Ability to distinguish Malay from Indonesian in transcription decisions
  • Comfortable transcribing Manglish and other natural code-switching patterns
  • At least two years of professional transcription, captioning, court reporting, broadcast, translation, or linguistic annotation experience
  • Demonstrated accuracy at the word level under deadline pressure
  • Comfortable with web-based annotation platforms and variable-speed audio playback
  • Reliable high-speed internet, quality headphones, and a quiet workspace
  • Ability to commit to defined volume per week during active project phases

NICE TO HAVE

  • Background in Malay linguistics, translation, journalism, or education
  • Prior experience annotating Malay or Indonesian speech data
  • Working knowledge of Indonesian, Tamil, Mandarin, or Hokkien for cross-lingual audio
  • Familiarity with IPA or other phonetic transcription systems
  • Experience with verbatim versus clean-verbatim transcription conventions

HOW WE WORK WITH YOU

  • Paid pilot task before full onboarding so both sides can calibrate
  • Per-task or per-minute compensation, with rates tied to audio complexity and turnaround
  • Flexible scheduling, with volume scaling up and down based on active client projects
  • Direct working relationship with Perle's linguistic leads and QA team
  • Eligible for invitation to additional Perle expert projects across related domains

HOW TO APPLY

Apply through Winnow, Perle's job portal at winnow.perle.ai. Find the role for your language under Open Jobs, set up your candidate profile, and complete the fully automated interview, which takes about 25 minutes. We review applications within 24 hours and invite passing candidates straight to the project.

Apply here:

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Perle hires experts on the basis of skill, language proficiency, and demonstrated quality. We welcome applicants from every background and every region where our target languages are spoken.

jobs.description:
Blue Rose Research helps Democrats win elections and advance progressive causes. We work with campaigns in battleground races up and down the ballot and major Democratic, progressive, and advocacy organizations across the country to produce the research and build the tools they use to decide what to say and where to spend.

We produce opinion research at a scale unmatched in politics, put it directly in decision-makers' hands, and build tools on top of that data that we distribute widely across the progressive ecosystem. You'll be joining a team of decorated engineers, data scientists, and political analysts who have quietly helped shape how the progressive ecosystem communicates for years.

We are hiring a Product Growth & Adoption Manager to own the usage and adoption of our products and the growth of our user base. We have built tools already used by many in the progressive ecosystem— and the gap between "we built it" and "everyone knows about it and is using it regularly" is the single highest-leverage problem in front of us. You will own that gap.

This is a product role that requires a political operative's instincts. We need someone who knows data, product, and the political community – someone who can sit in a product roadmap conversation on Monday, run a training for a state party on Tuesday, and explain the product in a user interview on Wednesday. You should have real roots in this community — multiple cycles of experience, people who take your call, and a working understanding of how campaigns actually make decisions under time pressure.

Your ultimate objective will be helping Democrats win the 2026 midterms and laying the groundwork for a successful presidential election in 2028. Timelines are tight, the work changes week to week, and the problems are often ambiguous.

We offer a competitive salary, medical, dental, and health benefits, and a work environment that will support your differences. While the work is remote, we do have an office in NYC and a number of folks who work in-person regularly – both in NYC and at shared workspace meetups in DC. Most of our work happens on East Coast time. This role involves some travel — conferences, client offices, trainings, and internal gatherings.

You will:

  • Own adoption and engagement outcomes for our products: who is using them, how deeply, and what it takes to bring on the next cohort.
  • Be a public face of our products across the progressive ecosystem — demos, trainings, conference panels, cycle kickoffs, and the group chats where campaign professionals actually ask each other what to use.
  • Grow the user base – bringing on new users across the ecosystem and evangelizing our products to new audiences.
  • Help our users build a habit of finding research and answers they need regularly with our tools, and help them incorporate our products into their regular workflows.
  • Build a product story for each audience we serve – from non-profits, to Senate and House campaigns, to state parties, to advocacy organizations – and translate a product into language a campaign manager or comms director can act on immediately.
  • Talk to users to understand why they adopt, stall, or churn, and translate that insight into growth tactics, messaging that drives adoption, and recommended product updates to our engineering team.
  • Build and maintain the materials that make our products spread: one-pagers, case studies, and training decks.
  • Build out email/lifecycle marketing programs that drive engagement, product adoption, and new customer acquisition.
  • Manage our marketing metrics and analytics, set targets, and report on progress to our acquisition and engagement goals.

Our ideal candidate likely:

  • Has worked multiple election cycles in Democratic or progressive politics — campaigns, committees, independent expenditures, labor, advocacy, or a consulting firm serving them.
  • Has 4+ years in product marketing, growth, adoption, or a client-facing role where they personally owned whether people used the product.
  • Is a genuinely good explainer. You can take something complicated, understand how it actually works, and come back with the version that makes it click for a busy person who did not ask for a tutorial.
  • Is fluent in product without being an engineer: understands how software goes from idea to beta to launch, can partner credibly with a product team, and knows the difference between a messaging problem and a product problem.
  • Is comfortable enough with survey research to be trusted by practitioners — can read a crosstab, explain what a message test does and doesn't tell you, and avoid overclaiming.
  • Is at ease being the face of something — on a panel, on a Zoom with a skeptical client, in a crowded conference hallway.
  • Actively experiments with AI tools and has built useful AI-assisted workflows, with real opinions about what works.
  • Is energized by ambiguous problems and off-cycle rhythms — translating "help win elections" into adoption bets and learning loops, without a clean quarterly metric to steer by.

We don't expect every applicant to have expertise in every area listed above. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the description. Many of our team members have taken an unusual path to get to where they are today, and our unique and diverse perspectives make us more effective. We also believe strongly in our team's ability to learn and grow. Join us!

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in content creation for B2B SaaS, healthcare technology, enterprise software, or similarly complex marketing organizations, with a track record of raising creative quality across a team's output.

Editorial strategy, messaging, and content planning are owned by the Editorial & Content Strategy function. This role owns the execution: the craft, review, and delivery quality that turns strategy into finished work, plus the production systems that support it.

Essential Job Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the quality gatekeeper for the Content Studio, reviewing and editing work before it moves forward to Brand, Editorial, or other stakeholders for final approval.

  • Push the team's execution to a consistently higher standard: catch weak work, sharpen rough drafts, and send work back until it meets the bar.

  • Set and maintain creative standards for tone, craft, and polish across all content produced by the studio, in alignment with brand guidelines.

  • Provide hands on editing and constructive feedback on copy, design, and other deliverables, modeling the level of quality expected from the team.

  • Coach and develop the creative judgment of content creators and freelancers, building their editing and craft skills over time, not just their throughput.

  • Identify recurring quality gaps across the studio and address them through training, tighter feedback loops, or changes to workflow.

  • Define and operationalize the enterprise Content Hub strategy, establishing scalable frameworks for content production, reuse, modular assembly, and omnichannel distribution.

  • Lead the evolution of the content supply chain with a focus on speed, quality, modularity, and AI enabled production.

  • Oversee production workflows across web, email, social, paid media, campaigns, customer marketing, product marketing, sales enablement, and events.

  • Establish intake models, prioritization frameworks, resource planning, and capacity management for the studio.

  • Establish review and approval workflows in partnership with Brand, Editorial & Content Strategy, Legal, and Privacy that balance creative quality, speed, and compliance.

  • Own administration of enterprise content libraries, including taxonomy, metadata standards, and content lifecycle management.

  • Ensure content libraries support tagging, version control, archiving, and retirement, in partnership with Marketing Operations and IT.

Additional Job Responsibilities:

  • Manage relationships with external agencies and production partners, holding them to the same creative bar as internal work.

  • Set and enforce delivery quality, timelines, and budget standards for agency produced work.

  • Partner with Procurement and Finance to optimize agency strategy and spend.

  • Define Content Hub KPIs and scorecards that measure creative quality alongside speed to market, production cycle times, and operational efficiency.

  • Establish reporting that communicates both quality trends and operational performance to Marketing leadership.

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high performing Content Hub organization, with a strong emphasis on raising the team's creative and editorial skill over time.

  • Foster a culture where craft and quality are treated as non-negotiable, alongside speed and efficiency.

  • Champion organizational change and adoption across a complex, matrixed marketing organization.

Expected Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Design, English, Journalism, or a related field required.

  • MBA or advanced degree preferred.

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in content production, creative operations, editorial, or content management, with direct experience reviewing and editing creative or written work.

  • At least 3 years leading multidisciplinary creative or content teams in enterprise scale marketing organizations.

  • Proven track record of raising the quality bar for a team's creative output, through editing, coaching, or direct creative leadership, not just managing operations.

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, healthcare technology, enterprise software, or similarly complex organizations preferred.

  • Sharp eye for copy and content craft, with the ability to give specific, actionable feedback that improves the work.

  • Strong understanding of brand voice, tone, and visual standards, and the judgment to know when work meets the bar and when it doesn't.

  • Comfortable pushing back on work, including from senior stakeholders or agencies, when quality falls short.

  • Hands on experience with DAM, CMS, Adobe Experience Manager or similar platforms, Adobe Creative Cloud workflows, and marketing automation platforms.

  • Understanding of AI enabled content operations, modular content strategies, and content reuse.

  • Experience managing operating budgets for content production and agency partners with measurable ROI.

  • Strong cross functional collaboration skills, including partnering with Brand, Editorial, Product Marketing, Legal, Privacy, IT, and executive leadership.

  • Excellent executive communication and organizational change leadership.

The Account Executive is a field sales role responsible for client retention and growth. Account Executives build trust-based relationships with C-Level Executives and their teams. They understand the mission-critical priorities of their clients and ensure clients receive the value from the Gartner relationship that they expect, while also identifying opportunities for stronger value delivery with alternative product offerings.

Account Executives will be given a territory of Large Enterprise clients.

In our End-User Large Enterprise segment, Account Executives work with clients who have +$1bil in annual revenue.

In our Tech Vendor Large Enterprise segment, Account Executives work with clients who have +$500mil in annual revenue.

What you will do:

  • Identify, cultivate, qualify and close client growth opportunities through cross-sell and upsell

  • Continually build a pipeline of high-quality opportunities to deliver against your sales metrics, ensuring KPI’s are met.

  • Quota responsibility for your assigned territory.

  • Manage complex high-revenue sales across matrix and diverse business environments.

  • Own forecasting and account planning on a monthly/quarterly/annual basis.

  • 5-8+ years' B2B sales experience, preferably within complex, intangible sales environments

  • Experience selling to and/or influencing C-Level Executives

  • Proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales targets.

  • Proven ability to own, manage, and forecast a complex sales process.

  • Willingness to conduct travel as needed.

  • Bachelor's degree preferred

  • Competitive salary, generous paid time off policy, charity match program, and more!

  • World-class sales training programs and skill development programs

  • Annual “Winners Circle” event attendance at exclusive destinations for top performers

  • Collaborative, team-oriented culture that embraces inclusion

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:
CrowdStrike is seeking a Corporate Sales Engineer passionate about the cybersecurity space to support both pre-sales and account management within our SLED (State, Local, and Education) segment. You'll partner closely with Account Executives to acquire new customers — and just as importantly, to retain, grow, and deepen relationships with the customers we already serve. That means presenting our platform to prospective clients to increase the likelihood of closing sales, then staying with those accounts as their trusted technical advisor to drive adoption, expansion, and renewal.

You'll be part of a team dedicated to changing customer perception of endpoint technology by articulating the limitations and failures of legacy security solutions and demonstrating the value of our next-generation offering — including how organizations securely adopt AI, from the models, agents, and data they deploy to the AI-powered adversaries now targeting them.

SLED customers are unlike any other segment. You'll work with security teams of one or two people protecting an entire school district, with CISOs navigating grant funding cycles, and with state agencies balancing modernization against strict compliance mandates. The technical work is challenging and the impact is tangible.

This position offers the flexibility of 100% remote work for candidates located within the United States.

What You'll Do:

  • Be the expert across the Falcon endpoint portfolio – eg. next-gen AV and behavioral prevention, EDR/XDR detection and response, real-time response and forensics, IT hygiene and exposure/vulnerability management, device and firewall control, file integrity monitoring, and endpoint data protection

  • Extend the conversation beyond the endpoint – Falcon Next-Gen SIEM as a legacy SIEM replacement, cloud and workload security across AWS, Azure, and GCP including containers and Kubernetes, SaaS security posture management, identity threat detection and response across Active Directory, Entra ID, Okta, and MFA, data protection, and adversary intelligence

  • Position managed services where they fit – MDR, managed threat hunting, and incident response retainers for customers who cannot staff a 24/7 SOC, paired with agentic AI and SOAR automation to extend a small team's reach

  • Articulate how to secure AI adoption – eg. AI security posture management, protecting AI models, agents, and workloads, shadow AI discovery, and defending against AI-driven adversary tradecraft

  • Maintain a comprehensive understanding of Windows, macOS, and Linux operating systems

  • Conduct demonstrations and proof of values with the ability to present technical concepts to a variety of external audiences up to C-level executives

  • Lead competitive displacement and agent consolidation efforts against legacy AV and incumbent platforms

  • Communicate fundamental security challenges to a wide range of stakeholders, from hands-on analysts to superintendents and state CIOs

  • Own the post-sales technical relationship for assigned accounts: drive onboarding, module adoption, health checks, and technical business reviews that surface expansion opportunities and mitigate renewal risk early

  • Partner with Account Executives on account planning, renewals, and whitespace strategy across the existing SLED base

  • Work collaboratively with Sales, Marketing, Support, and Engineering; the Sales Engineer should be the technical bridge between CrowdStrike and prospects/customers

  • Enable and mentor peers and channel partners

  • Work independently as a strong self-starter, with effective time management and organizational skills

What You'll Need:

  • Bachelor's degree in technical studies or equivalent practical experience, with 2+ years of relevant experience in IT, security, system engineering/administration, sales engineering, or technical account management

  • Customer-facing experience, comfort leading presentations, and a track record of managing long-term technical relationships

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency, and drive business outcomes

  • Proficient understanding of Active Directory and modern identity providers such as Entra ID and Okta

  • Familiarity with AI/LLM concepts and their associated risks – prompt injection, model and training data exposure, agentic identity and access, and emerging AI governance frameworks

  • Knowledge of malware, threat intelligence, and/or sandbox analysis

  • Ability to write and modify basic scripts. Preferred languages are PowerShell, Python, and Bash

  • Experience with virtualization/VDI technologies

  • Experience with large-scale cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.

  • Ability to travel minimally as required (potentially 2-3 trips a year to the annual GTM Offsite, Fal.Con, and customer visits)

  • Bonus: familiarity with public sector compliance frameworks (StateRAMP, CJIS, FERPA, NIST CSF/800-171); understanding of SLED buying motions such as cooperative purchasing vehicles and cybersecurity grant funding; certifications such as CEH, CISSP, OSCP, and SANS or participation in security events such as capture the flag

Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:

Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit Sales, Produkt, Data und Automation zusammen und kannst Deine Expertise in SEO, GEO, CRO und Content gezielt einbringen und weiterentwickeln. Wenn Du Lust hast, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Dinge datengetrieben voranzutreiben und in einem professionellen Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen zu arbeiten, bist Du bei uns genau richtig.   • Themen- und Intent-Cluster für Bikeleasing und Probonio baust Du auf und erstellst und optimierst organische Content-Formate (Ratgeber, Glossar- und Erklärseiten, Vergleichs-Content). Dabei sorgst Du für eine solide Onpage-Basis, die SEO und GEO gleichzeitig unterstützt
  • Du entwickelst und steuerst eine integrierte Content-Strategie – inklusive Themen-Backlog, Intent-Logik (Awareness → Consideration → Conversion), Content-Standards und Erfolgskriterien – und machst Output und Wirkung damit skalierbar
  • Du konzipierst Lead-Assets wie Whitepapers und Webinare, koordinierst deren Umsetzung und sorgst für konsequentes Content-Repurposing in Website-Module, organische Formate und Sales-Enablement-Materialien

deine stärken

  • Du bringst mindestens 5 Jahre nachweisbare Erfahrung in der experimentellen Steigerung von Website-Performance durch A/B-Tests mit – und kannst konkrete Ergebnisse und Metriken benennen
  • Du hast mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Optimierung von Websites im Organic-Search-Kontext (SEO + GEO) und weißt, wie man Sichtbarkeit messbar aufbaut
  • Du leitest Content-Strategien datengetrieben und SEO- bzw. GEO-geleitet ab – von der Zielgruppenanalyse bis zur Priorisierung von Themenfeldern
  • Du verfügst über Erfahrung im Einsatz von Content Management Systemen wie z.B. TYPO3, Tracking-Lösungen wie Google Analytics, AB-Testing-Tools bzw. Optimizely / ABTasty und SEO-Software wie AHREFS oder Otterly.ai
  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch (C2) und Englisch (C1) und kannst komplexe Inhalte klar und zielgruppengerecht aufbereiten
  • Operative Erfahrung in Paid Search oder Paid Social ist ein Plus – kein Muss, aber hilfreich für die enge Zusammenarbeit im Team

warum zu uns?

  • Du bist Teil eines stark wachsenden Unternehmens, kannst vieles vorantreiben und aktiv mitgestalten – gemeinsam schaffen wir eine langfristige Karriereperspektive
  • Zurück ins Office? Nicht bei uns! Stattdessen erwartet Dich maximale Flexibilität – unterstützt durch unser modernes Gleitzeitmodell sowie unsere Workation-Policy
  • Wir leben echtes Sparring: offene Kommunikation, ehrliches Feedback und Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe
  • Über Probonio erhältst Du monatlich einen 50-Euro-Gutschein Deiner Wahl – plus 60 Euro jährlich zu Deinem Geburtstag
  • Neben starken Versicherungsbedingungen für Deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge profitierst Du zusätzlich von vermögenswirksamen Leistungen
  • Und selbstverständlich kannst Du bis zu zwei Fahrräder oder Pedelecs über uns als Arbeitgeber leasen

Wir sehen Vielfalt als Bereicherung für unser Team. Darum freuen wir uns über alle Bewerbungen und möchten besonders Menschen mit Behinderung oder anderen Herausforderungen dazu ermutigen, sich bei uns zu bewerben.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT PERLE Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises.
jobs.description:
ABOUT PERLE

Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises. Our partners include xAI, Samsung, ELM, and Unisys. Headquartered in San Francisco with experts across more than forty markets, we specialize in the work that requires real human judgment: domain expertise, linguistic nuance, and cultural fidelity that generic data vendors cannot deliver.

Apply here:

THE ROLE

We are hiring expert Tunisian Arabic transcribers to convert audio recordings of native speakers into precise, conventionally formatted written transcripts. The work powers speech recognition, dialogue, and evaluation systems for major AI labs. Audio ranges from clean studio recordings to natural conversational speech in real-world acoustic conditions.

You will be working at the level of expert linguistic judgment. This is not data entry. Decisions about orthography, code-switching, speaker attribution, disfluencies, and non-speech events shape the quality of every model trained on your output.

DIALECT AND SCOPE

Tunisian Arabic (Tounsi / Derja), a Maghrebi variety with substantial Berber, French, and Italian lexical influence. Project audio reflects everyday Tunisian speech with frequent code-switching to French.

Primary speaker regions: Tunis, Sfax, Sousse, Kairouan, Bizerte, Gabes.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Transcribe audio recordings into accurate, time-aligned written text following Perle's project-specific style guide
  • Apply correct conventions for speaker identification, overlapping speech, disfluencies, fillers, false starts, and non-speech events such as laughter, background noise, and music
  • Make principled orthographic decisions for dialectal, colloquial, and code-switched speech
  • Flag ambiguous segments, uncertain speakers, and audio quality issues using project conventions
  • Self-review every submission against Perle's quality bar before delivery
  • Engage with QA reviewers on edge cases, calibration sessions, and style guide updates

MUST HAVE

  • Native fluency in Tunisian Arabic with lifelong residence or deep immersion in Tunisia
  • Strong command of Modern Standard Arabic for orthographic decisions on Derja speech
  • Working knowledge of French sufficient to transcribe French loanwords and code-switching
  • Familiarity with regional Tunisian variation across coastal and inland areas
  • At least two years of professional transcription, captioning, court reporting, broadcast, translation, or linguistic annotation experience
  • Demonstrated accuracy at the word level under deadline pressure
  • Comfortable with web-based annotation platforms and variable-speed audio playback
  • Reliable high-speed internet, quality headphones, and a quiet workspace
  • Ability to commit to defined volume per week during active project phases

NICE TO HAVE

  • Background in Maghrebi Arabic linguistics, translation, or journalism
  • Prior experience annotating Tunisian or Maghrebi speech data
  • Working knowledge of Tamazight or Italian for additional lexical cases
  • Familiarity with IPA or other phonetic transcription systems
  • Experience with verbatim versus clean-verbatim transcription conventions

HOW WE WORK WITH YOU

  • Paid pilot task before full onboarding so both sides can calibrate
  • Per-task or per-minute compensation, with rates tied to audio complexity and turnaround
  • Flexible scheduling, with volume scaling up and down based on active client projects
  • Direct working relationship with Perle's linguistic leads and QA team
  • Eligible for invitation to additional Perle expert projects across related domains

HOW TO APPLY

Apply through Winnow, Perle's job portal at winnow.perle.ai. Find the role for your language under Open Jobs, set up your candidate profile, and complete the fully automated interview, which takes about 25 minutes. We review applications within 24 hours and invite passing candidates straight to the project.

Apply here:

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Perle hires experts on the basis of skill, language proficiency, and demonstrated quality. We welcome applicants from every background and every region where our target languages are spoken.
